title: Senior Software Engineer - ZTC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, London, Austin</strong></p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Zero Trust Connectivity team builds the hub that connects Cloudflare One and Zero Trust products such as Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare One Client, Cloudflare Tunnels, Gateway and Workers VPC. Powering this hub is a set of Rust-based services operating on every one of the data-centers that Cloudflare runs. These services route all of Cloudflare One traffic end to end. By leveraging Cloudflare's incredible infrastructure and programming languages such as Rust, this critical service is safe, performant and secure.<br>As Cloudflare Zero Trust set of features evolves, this team is responsible for evolving these hub services to deliver those new capabilities while guaranteeing scalability and reliability as top priority.</p> <p>We are a team of engineers who obsess over building reliable services which leverage Cloudflare's unique architecture and global network footprint.</p> <p>You can read more about what we work on here:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/</a></li> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/</a></li> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/</a></li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a software engineer on the Zero Trust Connectivity team, you will contribute across a wide range of technologies and systems to deliver new solutions that connect Cloudflare One products together. You will build connectivity in a user-space service that can identify and route flows across our global network. This work requires close collaboration with other teams while leveraging powerful frameworks and libraries that power many Cloudflare products. Our technology stack includes Rust, Linux networking, Clickhouse, SaltStack, Prometheus, AI harnesses, and our own Cloudflare Workers platform. We're looking for determined, curious, empathetic engineers to join our team!</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Programming experience in Rust</li> <li>Familiar with Layer 3 and Layer 4 Networking</li> <li>Systems-level programming experience in Linux</li> <li>Experience building large-scale, reliable, highly distributed systems</li> <li>Attention to detail and ability to solve complex customer problems</li> <li>Own solutions end-to-end and driving the design, development, and deployment process</li> <li>Able to work across teams and level common, sustainable solutions</li> <li>Creative, open-minded, collaborative problem solver</li> <li>Focus on clarity in written and verbal communication</li> <li>Leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-83,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

Wenn es dir hilft (und keinen anderen stört), kannst du auch gerne Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen. Konzeption & Design von User Interfaces Du erstellst (oder bist beteiligt an der Erstellung von) Wireframes und Prototypen in Figma – für unsere Haupt-Websites, Landingpages und Apps. User Journey Mapping & Optimierung Du analysierst die komplette Customer Journey – vom ersten Klick bis zur erfolgreichen Einbürgerung und Kundenbewertung – und sorgst dafür, dass unnötige Reibungspunkte, Kontaktanfragen und Bedenken verschwinden. Conversion Rate Optimization Du planst, implementierst und analysierst A/B-Tests (z. B. zur Optimierung von Formularen oder Call-to-Actions), um die Abschlussrate zu steigern. Design System Management Du baust unser zentrales Design System in Figma weiter auf, pflegst es und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Frontend-Team weiter, damit alles konsistent und skalierbar bleibt. Entwicklung mobiler Erlebnisse Du stellst sicher, dass alle Interfaces auf mobilen Geräten perfekt funktionieren – mit Mobile-First-Ansatz, Fokus auf Touch-Interaktionen und optimaler Performance (Kann die Website auch von einem User, der gerade zur Arbeit pendelt, zufriedenstellend genutzt werden?) Usability-Testing & Research Du bist der Ansprechpartner für Usability-Testing (Eye-Tracking-Analysen, User-Interviews, regelmäßige Gespräche mit anderen kundennahen Teams), damit unsere Design-Entscheidungen auf echten Daten und Nutzerfeedback basieren. Kollaboration mit Marketing & Content Du arbeitest mit dem Marketing-Team zusammen, um visuell starke Landingpages, Kampagnen und Social-Media-Grafiken umzusetzen. Du weißt, was Nutzer anspricht und bewegt und wo ihre Bedenken liegen. Tracking & Datenanalyse Du richtest Tracking-Events (z. B. via Google Analytics, Hubspot) ein oder wertest sie mit aus, um aus echten Nutzungsdaten Designentscheidungen abzuleiten. Prozessoptimierung & UX-Standards Du entwickelst Standards, Templates und Workflows, die die Design-Arbeit für das gesamte Team effizienter machen. Dein Profil Kein Zertifikat der Welt ersetzt echte Erfahrung und Know-How aus der Praxis. Genau die suchen wir. Ob du dein Können im Job, in eigenen Projekten oder auf eigene Faust unter Beweis gestellt hast – uns interessiert, was du wirklich kannst und wie du denkst. Direkte Kommunikation und Hand-on-Erfahrung sind uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss. Wir suchen nach Kollegen, die im besten Fall mehrjährige Erfahrung mitbringen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Sicherer Umgang mit UX-Methoden Du beherrschst User-Centered Design - und denkst nicht, dass UX ein Synonym für “schönes Design” ist. Erfahrung im UX-Research Du hast bereits Interviews, Usability-Tests oder Auswertungen begleitet. Bestenfalls erste Erfahrungen mit Figma Auto-Layout, Komponenten, Prototyping und Design-System-Elemente sind für dich tägliches Handwerkszeug (oder du hast keine Schwierigkeiten, sie zu lernen). Praxis im UI/UX-Design Du hast Websites oder Web-Apps gestaltet und kennst die typischen Herausforderungen digitaler Produkte (oder kannst dir dieses Wissen selbstständig aneignen). Design-Sensibilität Du erkennst gute Typografie, klare Layouts, starke Kontraste und ein modernes Look-and-Feel auf den ersten Blick. Verständnis für Microinteractions Du weißt, wie kleine Animationen und Interaktionen das Nutzererlebnis verbessern können. Grundkenntnisse im Frontend Kein Muss, aber hilfreich – du verstehst HTML/CSS/JS so weit, dass du Designs technisch durchdacht planen kannst. Teamspirit & Humor Du arbeitest am liebsten gemeinsam, denkst nutzerzentriert – und bringst eine ordentliche Portion gute Laune mit. Keine formellen Voraussetzungen Du musst kein Studium oder 30 Weiterbildungen haben. Wir wollen Talente und fähige neue Kollegen finden. Selbst wenn du nicht alle Punkte hier erfüllst - wir sind auf der Suche nach erfahrenen und verantwortungsbewussten Kollegen, idealerweise bist du schon viele Jahre in dem Bereich aktiv und konntest viele Learnings mitnehmen. Denn genau daran sind wir interessiert: saubere, langfristig robuste Problemlösungen. Und die hat man meist erst, nachdem man es einige Zeit auf die harte Tour lernen musste. Einfache Kommunikation Du bist kommunikativ und offen. Eigentlich wollen wir hier keine generischen Sachen schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist wichtig. Gute Zusammenarbeit schlägt oft reines Know-how. Ein Kollege, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos ist, kann im Alltag wertvoller sein als jemand mit mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber eher schleppend ist. Deutsch oder Englisch Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch oder am besten beides (ca. B2-Level). Keine Sorge, wir erwarten keinen Nachweis des Sprachniveaus. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Lead AI Enablement Engineer
description: <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Lead AI Enablement Engineer</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Belfast</p> <p><strong>Department: </strong>Engineering Enablement</p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> VP Enablement</p> <p><strong>Employment Type: </strong>Full time</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About EverQuote</strong></span></h2> <p>EverQuote’s vision is to make it more efficient to shop for and buy insurance with confidence. We use data, technology and marketplace expertise to connect insurance shoppers with providers and help our customers grow their businesses.</p> <p>As AI becomes part of everyday work across the organisation, we want every colleague, technical or not, to get real value from it. Our enablement teams make that possible by turning new AI capabilities into reliable, trusted services.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the team</strong></span></h2> <p>The Lead AI Enablement Engineer sits within Engineering Enablement and owns the integration, usability and adoption of EverQuote’s enterprise AI services.</p> <p>You will also partner with IT, Security and Platform Engineering on service support and controls, and with data owners on access, privacy and auditability.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the role</strong></span></h2> <p>Help everyone across our organisation get more value from AI. We are looking for a hands-on Lead AI Enablement Engineer to make our AI products and services connected, reliable and useful in everyday work across Finance, Operations, HR, Sales, Engineering and beyond.</p> <p>We already use Claude, and there is significant opportunity to improve the experience through relevant features, connectors, skills and access to trusted knowledge. You will turn that opportunity into working services and practical ways of working that colleagues adopt and value, while evolving our capabilities as AI technology advances.</p> <p>You will lead the technical integration and continuous improvement of these services, combining engineering depth with curiosity about LLMs and a strong customer focus. The role combines hands-on delivery with technical leadership and mentoring.</p> <p>You will shape how an entire organisation works with AI. You will have the opportunity to explore new capabilities, turn promising ideas into dependable services and see the impact directly in colleagues’ daily work. Your technical decisions and customer insight will help define a new AI capability and how it evolves.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></span></h2> <h4><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the AI service roadmap:</span></h4> <ul> <li>Understand how colleagues work and identify friction.</li> <li>Prioritise improvements with department leads.</li> <li>Treat technical and non-technical employees as customers, and test changes with them.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Integrate AI into everyday work</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Configure and administer enterprise AI products.</li> <li>Work closely with other enablement teams to make sure the tooling is fully integrated.</li> <li>Work closely with InfoSec to make sure risks and standards have been met.</li> <li>Build connectors, MCP integrations, APIs and lightweight services that connect approved tools, business systems and knowledge sources.</li> <li>Keep permissions and data access aligned with users’ existing entitlements.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Turn new capabilities into useful services</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Track model releases, product features and emerging tools.</li> <li>Evaluate quality, usability, cost and risk against real tasks.</li> <li>Recommend, pilot and roll out improvements with clear guidance and a way to reverse unsuccessful changes.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Create reusable capabilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Make skills, shared instructions, workflow templates and agents discoverable, with clear owners, testing and version control.</li> <li>Help teams adapt proven approaches to their own work.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Show colleagues what is possible</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Run practical demonstrations, workshops, office hours and hands-on sessions using real business workflows.</li> <li>Build a network of departmental champions.</li> <li>Make guidance accessible to different confidence and skill levels.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Own the end-user experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Monitor integration health, answer quality and user feedback.</li> <li>Investigate failures and recurring friction.</li> <li>Coordinate fixes, vendor escalations, change communications and support arrangements with IT, Security and Platform Engineering.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Provide technical leadership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Establish integration and evaluation standards.</li> <li>Mentor others and shape vendor decisions.</li> <li>Continuously keep up to date with the latest LLM releases and harnesses to better inform the direction of the organisation.</li> <li>Partner with Security and data owners on access, privacy, auditability and safe tool use.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10 years experience in software development with 3+ years in AI</li> <li>Strong hands-on engineering experience building and supporting integrations, internal tools or enterprise services: you write maintainable code, work with APIs and authentication, and diagnose problems across connected systems.</li> <li>Practical experience applying LLMs and AI tools to real workflows used by other people, with an understanding of context, retrieval, tool use and evaluation, the limits of model outputs, and when human review is needed.</li> <li>A sustained interest in AI tooling, demonstrated through experimentation and working solutions. You follow developments actively and can explain which changes are worth adopting, which need more testing and which add little value.</li> <li>A customer-focused approach: you listen, observe how work happens and stay involved until the solution is useful. You can support a non-technical colleague and discuss integration trade-offs with an engineer.</li> <li>Evidence of technical leadership, prioritisation and cross-functional delivery: you can turn broad needs into a practical roadmap, set standards and bring others with you through coaching and clear communication.</li> <li>Experience delivering reliable services with appropriate access controls, testing, monitoring and documentation, and taking ownership of how a capability performs after launch.</li> <li>You do not need experience with every product or tool listed, but experience in several would be valuable:</li> </ul> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Claude Enterprise or similar enterprise AI products.</li> <li>MCP, reusable skills and agent workflows.</li> <li>Enterprise search and knowledge integration.</li> <li>Python or TypeScript.</li> <li>AWS.</li> <li>SaaS administration, SSO and OAuth.</li> <li>AI adoption programmes and communities of practice.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>How you work</strong></h3> <p><strong>You put customers first: </strong>You observe how work actually happens, test changes with the people who will use them and stay involved until the solution is useful.</p> <p><strong>You are evidence-led: </strong>You evaluate new capabilities against real tasks, establish baselines with users and use evidence to improve or retire capabilities.</p> <p><strong>You stay curious: </strong>You experiment, follow developments in AI and separate changes worth adopting from those that add little value.</p> <p><strong>You own the outcome: </strong>You take responsibility for how a capability performs after launch, not only for getting it live.</p> <p><strong>You bring others with you:</strong> You mentor, set standards and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues, with departmental champions and with vendors.</p> <h3><strong>What success looks like:</strong></h3> <p>In your first 90 days, you will have:</p> <ul> <li>Assessed our current AI services, feature availability, integration gaps and user experience.</li> <li>Agreed a prioritised roadmap.</li> <li>Delivered a small set of valuable integrations and reusable workflows across several departments.</li> <li>Established practical enablement sessions and a feedback loop.</li> </ul> <p>Over time, success means:</p> <ul> <li>Sustained adoption across business functions.</li> <li>Reliable integrations.</li> <li>Better user satisfaction.</li> <li>Measurable improvements in task time or output quality.</li> </ul> <p>You will establish baselines with users, track cost alongside benefit, and use evidence to improve or retire capabilities. Feature launches and licence activation alone are not measures of success.</p> <h3><strong>Our values</strong></h3> <p>At EverQuote, how we achieve results matters as much as the results themselves.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Tenacious: </strong>We aim high, move quickly and persist through difficult technical and organisational problems.</li> <li><strong>Help Customers Win: </strong>We prioritise work that creates meaningful and sustainable value for our customers.</li> <li><strong>Follow the Data: </strong>We use evidence to guide decisions and measure outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strengthen Our Team: </strong>We communicate directly, share knowledge and leave teams and systems stronger than we found them.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></span></h2> <p>EverQuote is committed to equal opportunity employment and to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and consider qualified candidates without regard to characteristics protected by applicable law.</p> <p><strong>Reasonable Adjustments</strong></p> <p>We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations at any stage of the interview process, please let us know and we will work with you to arrange them.</p> <p>or more information, visit <a href="https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=6XmzUHfuQ-i5S31_qCIpcQCQtcZ6e1ZCg-K9ZDUrOSjhU2y_ydujWqUSk1qbf0g08qVEJgBQCRrYN_rQ6s8R1bQPdaN9iF-VnAt04umDr2dE8nv

title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>Job Title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>Reporting to: Director of Sales, UK & Ireland</p> <p>Direct Reports: None</p> <p>Location: UK (remote)</p> <p>Travel expectations: Approximately 50%</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>As an Account Executive at Axon, you will play a key role in helping police forces across the UK adopt technology that saves lives, reduces risk to officers and the public, and enhances transparency and public trust. You will be supporting the adoption of Axon's ecosystem of products - including body-worn and in-car cameras, TASER devices, and cloud-based software platforms including our digital evidence management system - across forces in the UK. Your success will be measured by your ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships, drive large, complex opportunities through public sector procurement, and align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK policing. This is a quota-carrying, external field position.</p> <p> </p> <p>At Axon, our goal is to make each individual feel valued for their contribution to the company's mission to protect life. We are looking for intelligent people who want to do remarkable things. We strive to create an environment where people can succeed and enjoy coming to work every day. Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. You will constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Develop and Execute Account Strategies:</strong> Create comprehensive account strategies that align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK police forces, focusing on officer safety, operational efficiency and digital transformation. This will require close collaboration with other internal members of the account team(s).</p> <p><strong>Drive Complex Sales Engagements:</strong> Manage long sales cycles, leading to high-value, multi-year agreements with forces and police-led collaboratives. Facilitate discovery meetings, present Axon's value propositions, and lead customer negotiations.</p> <p><strong>Help increase market share and achieve Axon's strategic objectives</strong> by maximising revenue and customer satisfaction within your designated forces and regions.</p> <p><strong>Support Public Safety Innovation:</strong> Partner with internal teams to present Axon's innovative public safety technologies - such as TASER 10, Axon Body 4, Axon Fleet, Axon Evidence, Axon Respond, Axon Fusus and Axon VR training - demonstrating how these solutions transform force operations and support national productivity and efficiency priorities.</p> <p><strong>Manage Customer Relationships:</strong> Cultivate relationships with both executive and operational leaders within police forces - including Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, Police and Crime Commissioners and their offices, Chief Finance Officers, Heads of Digital/IT and operational commanders. Ensure seamless customer experiences through proactive engagement and problem-solving.</p> <p><strong>Champion Public Safety Outcomes:</strong> Position Axon as a key enabler of UK policing priorities, helping forces meet their operational and safety goals while enhancing transparency, accountability and public confidence.</p> <p><strong>Collaborate with Internal Teams:</strong> Work closely with Axon's customer success, engineering and programme management teams to ensure that customer projects are delivered on time and that forces derive measurable value from Axon's solutions.</p> <p><strong>Navigate UK Public Sector Procurement:</strong> Work with force commercial and procurement teams, national frameworks and police-owned commercial routes to structure compliant, competitive routes to market, and manage the associated governance and approvals.</p> <p><strong>Accurate CRM Management:</strong> Maintain up-to-date records of customer interactions, opportunities and forecasts in Salesforce. Use this data to drive proactive sales strategies and ensure visibility for internal stakeholders.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Key Performance Indicators</strong></p> <p><strong>Revenue Growth:</strong> Achieve or exceed annual revenue targets by closing high-value opportunities with UK police forces.</p> <p><strong>Market Penetration:</strong> Lead the expansion of Axon's solutions across UK policing.</p> <p><strong>Strategic Solution Selling:</strong> Collaborate with forces to identify and address their pain points through Axon's full suite of products, including Axon Records, Fleet and Evidence.com. Develop tailored solutions that result in improved officer safety, enhanced force transparency and streamlined workflows.</p> <p><strong>Executive Relationships:</strong> In conjunction with Axon UK leadership and other team members, establish and maintain high-trust relationships with senior leaders (Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, PCCs, CFOs, CIOs, etc.) within assigned forces, positioning Axon as a long-term partner in public safety technology.</p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership and Collaboration:</strong> Lead a cross-functional Axon team, including product, engineering and sales engineers, to ensure customer success and satisfaction, delivering 100% on all project commitments for assigned accounts. Develop strong relationships within the UK team and across other divisions throughout Axon to serve as an advocate for our UK customers.</p> <p><strong>Contract & Negotiation Leadership:</strong> Lead the proposal and negotiation process for contracts, ensuring competitive positioning and successful long-term engagements, including through framework call-offs and direct award processes where applicable.</p> <p><strong>Customer Feedback Loop:</strong> Gather actionable insights from assigned forces to inform Axon's product development and ensure that Axon's solutions meet UK policing needs. Contribute at least 5 pieces of actionable product feedback per quarter in partnership with our Customer Success team.</p> <p><strong>Forecasting Accuracy:</strong> Deliver accurate, data-driven forecasts with a 90%+ accuracy rate, maintaining transparency and proactive communication with senior management about your pipeline and expected deal closure.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p> <p><strong>Track Record of Success:</strong> Proven experience exceeding sales targets in a complex, consultative sales environment, particularly in public safety, SaaS or cloud-based solutions.</p> <p><strong>Public Sector Sales Experience:</strong> Deep understanding of UK public sector procurement and the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals.</p> <p><strong>Solution-Oriented Mindset: </strong>Ability to translate complex customer needs into innovative Axon solutions, helping forces enhance public safety, officer accountability and efficiency.</p> <p><strong>Technical Acumen:</strong> Familiarity with cloud computing, SaaS solutions and (preferably) digital evidence management systems. Experience working with police IT and digital leaders to drive cloud and digital transformation initiatives.</p> <p><strong>Collaborative Leadership:</strong> Proven ability to work cross-functionally within an organisation to deliver comprehensive, high-impact customer solutions. Leadership experience in managing multi-stakeholder projects is a plus.</p> <p><strong>Law Enforcement/Public Safety Knowledge:</strong> Experience working with UK police forces or wider public safety agencies is a strong plus. Ability to connect Axon's mission and products to the unique challenges of UK policing - including the regulatory, ethical and data protection scrutiny that surrounds police technology.</p> <p><strong>Travel Flexibility:</strong> Willingness to travel up to 50% to meet with key customers and stakeholders across the UK.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.</p> <p>Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.</p> <p><strong>Important Notes</strong></p> <p><em>The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.</em></p> <p><em>Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.</em></p> <p><em>We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at <strong data-stringify-type="bold"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" ----- target="_blank" ----- ----- via our <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://privacyportal.onetrust.com/webform/0efc1702-9321-4119-bc9d-a06c3a1d3e4e/ca57cc26-a159-4193-9f6e-58ffe3fd2509" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://privacyportal.onetrust.com/webform/0efc1702-9321-4119-bc9d-a06c3a1d3e4e/ca57cc26-a159-4193-9f6e-58ffe3fd2509" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Axon Privacy Web Form</a>. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.axon.com/candidateprivacypolicy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.</a></em></p> <p><em>Axon’s mission is to Protec

title: Senior Manager, New Business DACH & Benelux
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are </strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://customers.twilio.com/" data-sk="tooltip_parent"> hundreds of thousands of businesses </a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p> <p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! </p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. <br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Sales Senior Manager, New Business Accounts DACH & Benelux.</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>This position is needed to lead one of our New Business Account Executive teams selling into DACH & Benelux within the EMEA Region. Reporting into our EMEA Regional Vice President for South & DACH, the right person for this role is an experienced sales leader who is adept at building high-performing teams of solution-selling Account Executives disciplined in driving new logo acquisition and expanding market presence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Build and manage a high performing team of account executives focused on acquiring new enterprise customers and driving new logo growth.</li> <li>Coach and lead a team to identify and execute targeted outbound prospecting strategies across the entire portfolio of Twilio Products.</li> <li>Enable and coach your team around how to engage across various levels of customer maturity and segmentation.</li> <li>Work closely with our Marketing, Professional Services & Partner teams to build a robust pipeline and accelerate time-to-value for new prospects.</li> <li>Forecast your team overachieving on their goals, and deftly present your guidance to your management</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications </strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p><strong>*Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of managerial experience within a high performing CPaaS, Communications or API based company. </li> <li>Experience in building teams, driving pipeline creation, managing monthly forecasting, supporting fiscal planning, and tracking revenue for new business accounts.</li> <li>Experience managing a remote team spread across different countries. </li> <li>Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets and business objectives.</li> <li>Industry experience in selling CPaaS or SaaS and managing complex sales negotiations. </li> <li>Highly analytical and data driven; an innovative thinker and creative problem solver who is naturally curious.</li> <li>A self-starter who can work with minimal supervision to drive results.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity and working cross-functionally in a high growth business landscape.</li> <li>BA/BS degree or equivalent required. </li> <li>Energy and enthusiasm with a willingness to travel. </li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong executive presence. </li> <li>Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organisation.</li> <li>Fluent in German or Dutch</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain.</p> <p><strong>Travel </strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. </p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p> <p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p> <p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p> <p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Office Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Als Office Manager (w/m/d) bist du das Herzstück unseres Berliner Offices. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert und sich Kolleg*innen, Kund*innen und Gäste rundum wohlfühlen. Du denkst voraus, behältst den Überblick und packst selbst mit an – vom täglichen Office-Betrieb über Events bis hin zu größeren Projekten wie Umzügen oder Umbauten. Was machst du dabei konkret? Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltung, Handwerker und Dienstleister und kümmerst dich um alles, was einen reibungslosen Office-Alltag ausmacht – von Meetingräumen, Bestellungen und Post bis zu Dokumentationen, Reisebuchungen, Rechnungen und Belegen. Auch ausgewählte Themen für unser Münchener Office liegen bei dir. Du bist Gastgeber*in und bringst Menschen zusammen. Du empfängst Kund*innen und Gäste, bereitest Meetings und Catering vor und sorgst dafür, dass unser Office ein Ort ist, an dem man gerne zusammenkommt. Dazu gehören auch unsere internen Events, All Hands sowie die kleinen Dinge, die unsere Office Culture ausmachen – von Geburtstagen bis Merchandise. Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit. Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. title: Head of Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
description: Your Mission: Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft. As Head of Propulsion Battery System (PBS), you will lead VÆRIDION’s PBS department and hold overall technical accountability for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. The propulsion battery system encompasses the battery cells and packs, the battery management system, high-voltage power distribution and protection, thermal management, charging, and all interfaces to the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the ground infrastructure. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. You will set the technical direction, build the organisation and its development processes, and take the propulsion battery system from concept through development, qualification and certification to production readiness. You will also own the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system, represent VÆRIDION on technical matters towards authorities, industrial partners and funding bodies, and contribute your expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner. Your Day-to-Day: Hold overall technical accountability for the propulsion battery system across its full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through development, validation & verification, qualification and certification to entry into service. Define and maintain the propulsion battery system architecture together with the Electrical Systems Architect, ensuring that requirements are correctly allocated, interfaces are controlled, and trade-offs between safety, mass, energy, power, cost and certifiability are made deliberately and documented. Lead, develop and scale the Energy Storage System department, comprising the Airborne Electronics, Airborne Software, Cell Technology, HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration and Thermal Management teams. Recruit, coach and develop team leads and engineers, define clear roles and responsibilities, and align resourcing and hiring plans with the needs of the Microliner programme. Take ownership of key technical decisions, chair design and gate reviews, and escalate programme-level technical risks to the CTO with clear options and recommendations. Own the safety-driven design of the propulsion battery system, including thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and fault tolerance, and work closely with Safety and Systems Engineering on FHA, PSSA, SSA and common-cause analyses. Establish and maintain development processes in line with ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, ensuring traceability, configuration control and verification evidence appropriate to the allocated Design Assurance Levels. Own the integration of the propulsion battery system with the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the charging and ground infrastructure, including the definition and control of all associated interface requirements. Sound technical understanding of lithium-ion cell technology, battery management systems, high-voltage electrical systems, thermal management and the mechanical integration of battery packs, with the ability to make well-founded decisions across these disciplines. Experience with thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and functional safety concepts for battery systems. title: Head of Product – SAP (m/f/d)
description: Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades. That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on. We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz. The role We are looking for our first Head of Product. You own what Qorelo builds and why, and you build the product function around it. You lead our solution architects, the people who carry our SAP domain depth, you work hand in hand with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you report directly to the C-level. This is a leadership role at an early-stage company, which means two things at once. You set product strategy and make the big roadmap calls together with the founders, and you still write the spec, sit in the customer workshop and draw the cut line when it matters. Your decisions show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe. What you'll own • Product strategy. Where Qorelo goes across the transformation lifecycle, which problems we solve first and which we deliberately leave to others. You turn that into a roadmap the whole company understands. • The roadmap and the calls behind it. You prioritise with evidence from customers, Proofs of Value and the market, and you can defend every call to the founders, to sales and to engineering. • The product team. You lead our two solution architects today and grow the product team as we scale: hiring, coaching and setting the bar. • Discovery with real users. Consultants, SAP leads and transformation teams use Qorelo inside live programmes. You and your team sit with them, see where the product wins and where it falls short, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes. • Product in the sales cycle. You join key customer and partner conversations, shape Proofs of Value with sales, and make sure what we promise matches what we ship. • The bridge between SAP and AI. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost, and together with our solution architects you make sure what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct. • Shipping and outcomes. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines and success metrics. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed. What you need • 6+ years of professional experience, with deep hands-on SAP experience: S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area such as FI/CO, SD, MM or PP. Whether you come from SAP consulting, solution architecture or product at an SAP ecosystem software company, all of it counts. • 4+ years in product: you've owned a B2B product and its roadmap end to end, prioritised with engineering and shipped to enterprise users. Title doesn't matter, ownership does. • Experience leading people: you have led product managers, solution architects or consultants, and you want to keep building a team. • A command of the SAP transformation lifecycle and SAP Activate deep enough to be credible with CIOs, Heads of SAP and senior consultants at enterprise clients. • Strong AI curiosity: you've actually built or worked hands-on with LLM tooling and formed opinions about where it breaks. • Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, hands-on work alongside strategy. • Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base, but not expected. You might be a fit if • You've sat inside an S/4HANA programme and thought "half of this should be software", and you can name which half. • Consultants trust you on module questions and engineers trust you to write a clear spec. You've taken a product from its first enterprise customers to something repeatable, and you know what you would do differently next time. • You know the SAP tool landscape, from Cloud ALM to Signavio and LeanIX, and where the gaps between them are. • You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters. What we offer • Real ownership. A seat at the leadership table, meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one. • Competitive salary, benchmarked for product leadership in Berlin. • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. Your roadmap runs at the core of companies most product leaders only read about. • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the founders, engineers and architects who build what you define. • 25 days paid vacation plus German public holidays. • Company offsites with the whole team. • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg. This role works from the office, because product decisions here happen in the room with the architects and engineers. • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools. On-site workshop: a product strategy exercise with the team, including our solution architects and our Head of Product Design 4. title: Pentester senior
description: Mobeta est une société de cybersécurité offensive qui combine pentesters humains, agents IA et éditeur de Rigma (plateforme de sécurité offensive continue). Nous réalisons des tests d’intrusion ponctuels ou continus sur les surfaces externes et les environnements internes, avec Rigma pour piloter les vulnérabilités, suivre leur remédiation et revérifier les corrections dans le temps. Nous recherchons un/une pentester senior afin de diriger techniquement notre équipe de pentest. Selon le profil, ce poste peut permettre d'accéder au capital de la société via des BSPCE. Vos missions Missions pentest / Red Team Réaliser de nombreux pentests sur divers environnements et applications : externes, web, internes, Cloud, etc. (vous n'aurez pas d'audit organisationnel) ; Réaliser et encadrer nos campagnes de Red Team ; Automatiser vos attaques dans notre plateforme Rigma. Management de l'équipe pentest Encadrer et faire monter en compétence les pentesters de l'équipe ; Participer au recrutement des pentesters afin de construire une équipe cohérente avec notre ADN. Rayonnement technique de Mobeta Encadrer les sujets R&D de l'équipe pentest (blog posts, outils, recherche de 0-day) ; Représenter Mobeta en conférences (talks). Outillage technique & IA Industrialisation et automatisation des phases répétitives du pentest ; Veille active, capitalisation ; Exploitation maximale de l'IA ; Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe produit et participer aux développements à intégrer dans Rigma. La partie Missions Pentest / Red Team est prioritaire et indispensable, elle représentera, surtout au début, la majorité de votre temps de travail. Les autres tâches seront intégrées au fur et à mesure de la montée en responsabilité. Vos compétences Expérience confirmée en pentest / Red Team ; Maîtrise d’un langage de scripting ainsi que des principes de développement sécurisé ; Capacité à encadrer et faire progresser une équipe ; Passionné par la sécurité informatique et le pentest (challenges, CTF, etc.) ; Utilisation intense de l'IA pour les usages concrets, notamment appliqués au pentest ; Sens de l'organisation et de la rigueur, avec de fortes capacités d'analyse et rédactionnelles ; Capacité à apprendre rapidement ; Aisance à l’oral et capacité à restituer clairement des sujets techniques ; Humble et fiable ; Présence physique au moins partielle dans nos locaux à Paris. Ce qui est apprécié : Certifications en sécurité offensive (OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, CRTE, prolabs HTB, etc.) ; Contributions publiques à l’écosystème : blog technique, outils open source, etc. Avantages Selon le profil, ce poste peut permettre d'accéder au capital de la société via des BSPCE ; Intégrer une équipe passionnée ; Monter en compétence dans un environnement stimulant, axé vers la performance des pentesters ; Participer activement au développement d’une startup avec un produit innovant ; Avantages classiques (mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant) ; Télétravail possible. title: Senior Project Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><span style="color: rgb(102, 110, 153);">What Cognite is:</span> <span style="color: rgb(0, 41, 255);">Relentless</span> <span style="color: rgb(102, 110, 153);">to achieve</span></span></h1> <p></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Cognite operates at the forefront of <strong>industrial digitalization, building AI</strong>, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our <a href="https://www.cognite.com/en/company/newsroom/cognite-s-industrial-ai-momentum-soars-driving-ecosystem-impact-at-global-conference">Moonshot</a> is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.</span></p> <p><br><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 100%;" width="708"></p> <p> </p></div><div> <h1>How you’ll demonstrate <span style="color: rgb(0, 41, 255);"><strong>Ownership</strong></span></h1> </div> <div>At Cognite, we're transforming the world's most asset-intensive industries through Industrial AI. Our customers rely on us to turn complex industrial data into meaningful business outcomes—and this is where you come in.</div> <div> </div> <div>We're looking for a Project Manager who enjoys solving complex challenges, takes ownership of outcomes, and is motivated by delivering measurable value. This role goes beyond managing timelines; you'll lead transformational AI implementation projects that help some of the world's largest industrial organisations modernise the way they operate.<br><br>From contract signing through deployment and value realisation, you'll partner with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver successful projects that create lasting business impact.<br> <h1>The <span style="color: rgb(0, 41, 255);">Impact</span> you bring to Cognite</h1> <ul> <li> <div>As the Project Manager, you'll be accountable for the successful delivery of complex Industrial AI implementation projects by:</div> </li> <li>Leading end-to-end project delivery from kickoff through deployment, adoption, and value realisation.</li> <li>Owning project scope, schedule, budget, quality, customer outcomes, and commercial performance.</li> <li>Collaborating with Solution Architects, Software Engineers, Data Scientists, Product teams, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality solutions.</li> <li>Translating customer objectives into measurable success metrics and facilitating Value Realisation Workshops to demonstrate business impact.</li> <li>Managing project financials, including forecasting, revenue recognition, profitability, cost management, and reporting.</li> <li>Building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, and providing clear communication throughout the project lifecycle.</li> <li>Identifying and managing risks, dependencies, and scope changes while ensuring appropriate governance and transparency.</li> <li>Supporting customer adoption through change management, enablement, and training while recognising opportunities to expand customer value.</li> <li>Contributing to the continuous improvement of delivery practices by applying Cognite's PMO methodologies, playbooks, and lessons learned.</li> </ul> <h4>Required Qualifications:</h4> <ul> <li>A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.</li> <li>5+ years of experience delivering complex software, SaaS, cloud, or enterprise technology implementation projects.</li> <li>Experience managing enterprise or industrial digital transformation programmes involving multiple stakeholders and technical workstreams.</li> <li>Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data architecture, and enterprise systems, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams and informed decision-making.</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial acumen, including forecasting, revenue recognition, margin management, and project profitability.</li> <li>Experience within Life Sciences.</li> <li>Experience working with Agile delivery methodologies and project governance frameworks such as Scrum, PMP, or PRINCE2.</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently across technical teams, customers, and executive stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, or Smartsheet.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 25% as required.</li> </ul> <h4>Preferred skills:</h4> <ul> <li> <div>We're particularly interested if you also bring experience in:</div> </li> <li>PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification.</li> <li>Cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.</li> <li>Industrial IoT, SCADA, MES, or Operational Technology (OT) environments.</li> <li>AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, or Analytics implementation projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Cognite?</strong></p> <p>At Cognite, you'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of Industrial AI, partnering with some of the world's leading industrial organisations to solve complex, real-world challenges.<br><br>You'll join a collaborative, inclusive, and fast-moving environment where innovation, curiosity, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value diverse perspectives and believe great ideas come from people with different experiences and backgrounds.<br>If you're excited by technology, enjoy working with customers to solve meaningful problems, and want to help shape the future of industry, we'd love to hear from you.</p> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><div> </div> <div> </div> <div> </div> <div><span style="color: rgb(102, 110, 153); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Learn more about us</strong></span></div> <div> </div> <div> </div> <div><img style="max-width: 100%;"></div> <div> </div> <div> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><a href="https://www.cognite.com/en/resources/blog/key-highlights-from-impact-2025">Impact 2025</a></span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><a href="https://www.cognite.com/en/company/newsroom/cognite-s-industrial-ai-momentum-soars-driving-ecosystem-impact-at-global-conference">Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot</a></span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.</span></li> </ul> </div> <div> </div> <div> </div> <div><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></em></span></div> <div><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><em>Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.</em></span></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Machine Learning Fellow - Human Frontier Collective (UK)
description: <h3>About the Collective</h3> <p>The <strong>Human Frontier Collective (HFC)</strong>’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.<br>We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including <em><a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.10718" target="_blank">SciPredict</a></em>, <a href="https://scale.com/research/propensitybench" target="_blank"><em>PropensityBench</em></a>, and <em><a href="https://scale.com/research/prbench" target="_blank">Professional Reasoning Benchmark</a>.</em></p> <p> </p> <h3>Why join the HFC</h3> <p>HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Join a unique and exclusive expert network: </strong>You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.</li> <li><strong>Participate in AI/ML projects:</strong> Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.</li> <li><strong>Co-author selected research publications:</strong> Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Who should apply</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Background</strong>: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.</li> <li><strong>Skills</strong>: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Professional</strong> <strong>Mindset</strong>: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>How it works</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Duration</strong>: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.</li> <li><strong>Work authorization</strong>: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows. To participate in the HFC Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the country they reside in.</li> <li><strong>Community Network</strong>: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channels, virtual sessions, IRL events, and much more.</li> <li><strong>Projects Logistics</strong>: </li> <ul> <li>Project selection: You’ll regularly get matched to carefully selected projects from our partners. Depending on the partner, projects range from evaluating AI models to designing experiments, building RL environments, co-authoring research papers, and more. </li> <li>Flexible schedule: There's no minimum commitment – you decide whether to take on a project. Most fellows spend 10–25 hours per week, on a schedule they set themselves.</li> <li>Competitive pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to: projects, scope, skillset, and location. You’ll receive the pay information upon receiving project matching notifications.</li> </ul> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Application process</h3> <ol> <li><strong>Apply: </strong>We review applications on a rolling basis.</li> <li><strong>Interview:</strong> Candidates will get to discuss their research experience, professional background, and alignment with our mission to advance human-centered AI. <strong><em>Note: If we invited you directly, your invitation will say whether this step applies.</em></strong></li> <li><strong>Join the Collective:</strong> Successful candidates will receive an invitation to join the Human Frontier Collective Fellowship.</li> </ol> <p> </p> <p>------</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE: </em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, </em><em>Ernst</em><em> </em><em>&</em><em> Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. </em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux. Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux. Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée. Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.). Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation. Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux. Ce que tu vas faire concrètement 1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME) Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients. Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement. Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives. 2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration. Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution. 3) Satisfaction & rétention Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur. Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires. Indicateurs de réussite CSAT sur ton portefeuille. Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL. Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux. Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.
