title: Growth Engineer - Data & Tracking
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! Your impact Great growth decisions start with reliable data. At Pennylane, we're building the financial operating system for European businesses. As we grow and expand into new markets, understanding how users discover, interact with and adopt our product is becoming increasingly important. That's where Growth Engineering comes in. We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong data and tracking expertise to help us build reliable, scalable tracking and analytics foundations across our digital acquisition journeys. You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead , within the Marketing Website squad. Your mission ? Make sure we collect the right data, trust what we measure and turn insights into better growth decisions. What you'll do Build reliable tracking foundations You'll own the technical implementation and reliability of tracking across our website and acquisition funnels. Design, implement and maintain tracking plans across key user journeys. Build and improve event tracking, user identification and data collection. Work with tools such as Segment, Amplitude and Google Tag Manager. Ensure tracking consistency, accuracy and reliability across our digital ecosystem. Identify and resolve tracking issues before they impact business decisions. Connect data across our growth ecosystem You'll help build the technical connections between our website, internal systems and analytics tools. Develop and maintain APIs and integrations between platforms. Ensure reliable data flows between our acquisition, product and analytics tools. Collaborate with Data teams to improve data quality and consistency. Support the evolution of our tracking architecture as Pennylane scales internationally. Power experimentation and conversion You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to understand user behavior and improve acquisition performance. Implement the technical foundations for A/B testing and experimentation. Help measure acquisition funnels and identify opportunities for improvement. Ensure experiments are properly tracked and measurable. Translate business questions into clear technical tracking requirements. Support data-driven decisions through reliable instrumentation. Contribute as an engineer This is an engineering role, not a reporting or dashboarding position. You'll be expected to bring strong technical fundamentals and take ownership of your work. Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code. Build scalable and reliable technical solutions. Investigate complex tracking and data issues. Improve existing systems, processes and documentation. Collaborate with engineers across Growth, Engineering and Data teams. Contribute to technical decisions and engineering best practices. Who are you? We're looking for an engineer who understands both how data is collected and why it matters. Someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with different teams and making sure that business decisions are based on data people can trust. You don't need to be a data scientist or a marketing specialist. But you should be comfortable working at the intersection of software engineering, analytics and growth. We'd love to meet you if... You have a software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to tracking, analytics or data integrations. You have implemented and maintained event tracking across websites, applications or acquisition funnels. You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high. You're familiar with tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Google Tag Manager or similar platforms. You understand event schemas, data layers, user identification and tracking consistency. You're comfortable working with JavaScript and APIs to implement and troubleshoot tracking. You care about code quality, reliability and maintainability. You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects, from design to production. You're comfortable working in French and English. Bonus points if you have experience with: Ruby on Rails, Vue.js or Nuxt.js. SQL and data warehouses. Server-side tracking and conversion APIs. A/B testing and experimentation platforms. Attribution, conversion measurement or acquisition analytics. Privacy-conscious tracking and consent management. International websites and multi-market acquisition funnels. Our technical environment Our Growth Engineering team works with: Frontend: JavaScript, Vue.js, Nuxt.js Backend: Ruby on Rails Database: PostgreSQL Development: Git, GitHub Analytics & Tracking: Segment, Amplitude and other analytics tools, depending on the project You'll collaborate closely with our Data teams and contribute to the evolution of our growth tracking infrastructure. Why you'll love this role Real impact: Your work will help teams understand how users discover and adopt Pennylane. Technical ownership: You'll contribute to the architecture and reliability of our tracking ecosystem. Engineering standards: You'll work on technical challenges that require the same level of rigor as our other engineering teams. Cross-functional exposure: You'll collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Engineering and Data. International scale: You'll help build the data foundations needed to support our expansion across Europe. Continuous improvement: You'll have room to challenge existing implementations, propose better solutions and improve how we measure growth. If you enjoy building reliable data foundations and want to see your engineering work directly influence growth decisions, we'd love to meet you. What do we do to make your work life easier 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment 🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…) We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. WHO YOU ARE You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts. You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else. You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it. THE OPPORTUNITY Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend. The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the commercial model Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation. Drive the rollout across the ecosystem With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets. Build the measurement Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision. Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's. Build and lead the team Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour. WHAT YOU BRING Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale. Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses. Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself. A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals. Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel. Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work. Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach. English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred. WHAT WE OFFER Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India. Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it. Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem. Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have. Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer
description: Our software decides every 15 minutes what a battery should do. You own the layer that makes it happen: our EMS, the interface between our optimizer and every battery we connect. Whether we build our own EMS or integrate existing ones is a call you'll help us make. Own our EMS integration layer: one clean interface that connects any storage system (inverter, BMS, site controller) to our optimizer Onboard new vendors over Modbus, MQTT and vendor APIs, so the next battery is a config, not a project Commission systems on site until the battery follows the plan to the kW Build our own edge box on standard hardware (think Raspberry Pi on a DIN rail) You Will Have Fun If You Are Builder with agency Get-shit-done mentality: you'd rather drive to the site than wait for a support ticket High ownership: the EMS interface is yours, from the vendor call to go-live Mission-driven Passionate about energy transition and climate impact Thrive in early-stage chaos (e.g. "Can you be in Ingolstadt tomorrow at 8?") You Won't Have Fun If You Like to follow processes. We don't have any. Want to work remotely. We're in the office 5 days/week, and regularly on site at customers. Want to stay on one side of the wall. This is half software, half hardware. Qualifications Hands-on experience with energy management systems (EMS) for battery storage, PV or C&I sites. Ideally you've built or integrated one yourself, whether at work, in your thesis or during an internship. Similar experience counts too (e.g. battery management systems (BMS), SCADA, EV charging, building automation or industrial controls): a lot of that knowledge transfers directly Solid Python and embedded Linux (networking, VPN, remote updates) Industrial protocols: Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, REST Electrical basics: inverter, BMS, grid connection point. Bonus: PV/battery commissioning Fluent German, because installers and customers speak German Fresh out of university? Very welcome. Experience from your thesis, internships or side projects counts just as much as a job title. Don't worry if you don't tick every box: we prefer fast learners over years of experience. Perks Super small team, super early: you shape the culture You own the EMS and the hardware: how we connect batteries and which box we ship is your call Direct customer access: see your code move a megawatt-hour battery €70–100K salary + equity as full time · €24/h as working student Compensation: €70K – €100K • Offers Equity • €70K – €100K • Offers Equity Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Recruiting Coordinator (11-month contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Singapore</strong></p> <h4>About the Role</h4> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to be a cornerstone of our hiring engine in Singapore. This isn't just about managing calendars; you'll be a key player in bringing structure to our hiring efforts, ensuring an exceptional global candidate experience, and supporting the high-quality hiring decisions that drive our mission forward.</p> <p>If you're someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced setting, possesses a keen eye for detail, and is dedicated to delivering positive experiences, we want to hear from you. You'll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and interviewers, ensuring every candidate interaction truly reflects Cloudflare's best. This is a fantastic opportunity to launch or pivot into a career in Talent Acquisition, where your organizational skills and candidate-centric approach will directly influence our ability to attract top talent and shape their perception of Cloudflare. </p> <h4>Responsibilities</h4> <ul> <li>Manage interview logistics across various formats (video, phone, and in-person) with precision and efficiency, ensuring a seamless experience for all participants.</li> <li>Deliver an exceptional candidate experience, both virtually and in-person, demonstrating empathy and a customer/candidate-oriented approach.</li> <li>Utilize applicant tracking system, scheduling tools, dashboards, and candidate trackers to ensure accuracy and maximize efficiency for Cloudflare’s Interview Experience program.</li> <li>Handle sensitive and confidential information with the utmost professionalism. </li> <li>Communicate clearly, directly, and transparently with candidates, recruiters, and internal stakeholders</li> <li>Partner with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to streamline processes and contribute to cross-functional recruiting operations projects and improvements. </li> <li>Actively identify opportunities for process enhancements and suggesting solutions, as well as supporting program initiatives where bandwidth allows.</li> <li>Collaborate with and provide mutual support to team members on shared tasks and challenges.</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <ul> <li>Experience in a fast-paced environment where exceptional <strong>organizational skills</strong>, <strong>high-volume coordination</strong>, or extensive <strong>client/customer support</strong> were essential.</li> <li>Proven ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively.</li> <li>Maintain meticulous attention to detail, even under pressure.</li> <li>Consistently meet deadlines and service standards.</li> <li>A resourceful and proactive approach to identifying and resolving routine challenges independently.</li> <li>Quick to learn and adapt to ambiguous or changing situations.</li> <li>View mistakes as opportunities for growth.</li> <li>Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.</li> <li>Able to engage professionally and empathetically with diverse stakeholders.</li> <li>Possess a strong collaborative spirit.</li> <li>Build positive professional relationships and contribute to a supportive team environment.</li> <li>A genuine passion for delivering positive experiences.</li> <li>Lead with empathy and assume good intentions in all interactions.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: HR Operations Specialist, Singapore (12-months contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What You Would Do Here:</strong></p> <p>Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Champion key employee lifecycle process:</strong> Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.</li> <li><strong>Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries:</strong> Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration:</strong> Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Ensure data integrity and governance: </strong>Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.</li> <li><strong>Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence:</strong> Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.</li> <li><strong>Support strategic HR initiatives and projects:</strong> Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills/experience</strong> </p> <ul> <li>2+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.</li> <li>Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills. </li> <li>Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.</li> <li>Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.</li> <li>Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.</li> <li>Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel. Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function. But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene. Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective. Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital. Your mission Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own. ✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly Investigating and fixing bugs across the Travel services, reproducing each scenario before changing any code Handling day-to-day technical requests from customers and colleagues, and explaining what went wrong in plain terms Adding logging and metrics to what you build, and following runbooks when alerts fire 🧭 Unlocking the product roadmap / by shipping well-defined features end to end Building features across the frontend (React, Next.js) and backend (NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma) in Linear sprints Breaking work into clear steps, surfacing assumptions early, getting feedback on technical decisions and keeping progress and blockers visible Writing unit and integration tests, and acting on code review feedback 📈 Building depth in a sensitive domain / by growing into ownership of Travel services Learning how flight bookings, fares and travel aggregation work, and how they connect to crew changes Taking ownership of a Travel service module over time, including its uptime, bug rates and resolution times Sharing what you learn through clear pull request descriptions and team documentation You should have Experience: early-career professional experience as a software engineer, building web applications across both frontend and backend. Experience: working knowledge of TypeScript and React, and some exposure to Node.js backends. Familiarity with any of Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma, Apollo Client, React Query, ShadCN, AWS (Lambda, SQS, RDS, ECS), Jest or Playwright is useful; we don't expect all of it. Experience: exposure to GDS systems (like Amadeus) or travel aggregator platforms is a plus. A high degree of ownership: you take a task from ticket to production and see it through. Sound engineering fundamentals: readable code, sensible tests, and systematic debugging. Technical depth and curiosity: you want to understand how the wider system works, not only the part in front of you. A genuine interest in travel and flight booking, and a willingness to learn the industry in depth. The ability to explain technical issues simply to customers and non-technical colleagues. Clear, proactive communication about progress, risks and blockers. A collaborative approach: you work well with other engineers, ask for help when it's the quicker route, and act on feedback. Experience or interest in early-stage or growth-stage startups. Fluency in English. Other languages are a plus. Based in EMEA or LATAM, with good working-hours overlap with the rest of the Travel team. Why Join Us? Tackle a unique industry challenge with global impact Be part of an international, mission-oriented, supportive and fun team Do your best work, with leading-edge AI tools for all team members Benefit from support and budget for your learning and development We believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success at Tilla. We make hiring decisions based on your experience and skills. Therefore, we welcome applications from all members of society, regardless of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief. title: Engineering Manager
description: We have real traction and proven scale, and we're now setting up how engineering works for our next wave of European growth. You would lead one of the teams doing it, and shape the practices the others follow. ABOUT THE ROLE You would lead one of our product engineering teams: what it ships, how it runs, and how the people in it grow. Product and engineering together are ~25 people, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach. It's a hands-on role. One week you're in a design review, the next - in a few Claude-enabled contributions, the next - in performance conversations, and most weeks - all of that combined. You should love zooming in and out, from feedback on an API spec to a quarter's priorities. Your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. Beyond your team, you would shape how engineering works at Insify together with the other Engineering Managers, a Staff Engineer and the VP Engineering: architecture, product discovery, how engineers grow. What you'll be doing Leading a team of product engineers end to end: what you ship, how it performs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there Bringing architecture and product thinking into the team's daily work, so that new product demands turn into platform capabilities that scale across countries and insurance products, rather than one-off builds Running product discovery with your team: working with the Insurance, Operations and Growth teams on what to build, and saying no when the answer is no Shaping company-wide engineering practices alongside the other Engineering Managers: ways of working, architecture & technology practices, the growth framework Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. description: About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. About The Role About the role We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is. What You'll Do What you'll do Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones. Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs. Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows. Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules. Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop. What You Bring What you bring Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review. Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend. BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar. Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience. Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked. Nice To Have Nice to have Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid. Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide. Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus. Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases. What You Will Get In Return Make a genuine impact on the product Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product. Work in the EU Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. Become a stock options holder Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders. Receive unwavering support and care Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling. Work & Swim program Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views. Equal Opportunity Statement At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role:</strong></h3> <p>We are on the lookout for a <strong>Principal Software Engineer</strong><span style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px;"><strong> </strong></span>to join our <strong>Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team </strong>and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. description: <p><strong>Who/What is Artefact?</strong><br>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible<br>business impact.<br>With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <p> </p> <div><strong>The role:</strong></div> <div> </div> <div>We are looking for a Senior Data & AI Architect who combines business strategy and technology across Data and GenAI. You will design the operating model and the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE, define the target architecture, and steer data products from demand through to rollout.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></div> <div> </div> <div>Operating model and organization</div> <ul> <li> <div>Design the Data & AI operating model (centralized, federated, hub-and-spoke) following Data Mesh principles: roles, responsibilities, domain ownership and governance mechanisms.</div> </li> <li> <div>Define the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE: scope, service catalogue, skills, sizing and engagement model with business domains.</div> </li> <li> <div>Design end-to-end processes for demand management, use case prioritization, funding and value tracking.</div> </li> </ul> <div>Architecture and technology choices</div> <ul> <li> <div>Define the target data platform architecture on cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and Databricks, including GenAI components (RAG, agents, vector stores, LLMOps).</div> </li> <li> <div>Run make-or-buy analyses and vendor selections: scouting, evaluation criteria, business case, TCO and final recommendation.</div> </li> <li> <div>Check that architecture, security and data governance choices are consistent with enterprise standards and with the operating model.</div> </li> </ul> <div>Data products: from demand to rollout</div> <ul> <li> <div>Gather and formalize functional requirements with the business, translating them into data products with owners, consumers, SLAs and quality metrics.</div> </li> <li> <div>Design data products from both a functional angle (use cases, KPIs, impacted processes) and a technical one (data model, pipelines, interfaces, serving layer).</div> </li> <li> <div>Act as design authority during implementation: review system integrator solutions and oversee quality, progress and risks of the rollout.</div> </li> </ul> <div><strong>Requirements:</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>At least 4 years of professional experience in IT.</div> </li> <li> <div>At least 2 years on projects focused on AI/GenAI, Data Mesh and functional requirements gathering.</div> </li> <li> <div>Consulting experience, ideally in strategy consulting, combined with experience at a system integrator or delivery firm.</div> </li> <li> <div>Hands-on experience designing operating models, Data/AI organizations or CoEs.</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience with make-or-buy analyses, vendor selection or target architecture definition.</div> </li> <li> <div>Excellent written and spoken English.</div> </li> </ul> <div>Technical and functional skills:</div> <div>You will not be expected to write code, but you need to know the technologies well enough to assess them, challenge vendors and spot a flawed setup.</div> <ul> <li> <div>Data Mesh and governance: domain ownership, data products, federated governance, data contracts, catalogues and lineage (e.g. Unity Catalog, OpenMetadata, Collibra).</div> </li> <li> <div>Cloud: data and AI PaaS services on at least one of Azure, AWS and GCP; security, networking and FinOps principles.</div> </li> <li> <div>Databricks: Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows; ability to assess design and cost.</div> </li> <li> <div>GenAI: RAG and agentic architectures, LLMOps, model evaluation, platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI and Bedrock.</div> </li> <li> <div>Operating model: Data/AI organization, CoE, roles (data owner, data steward, product owner), demand and portfolio processes.</div> </li> <li> <div>Requirements and delivery: requirements gathering, user stories, process modelling, agile methods, programme governance.</div> </li> <li> <div>Business: business cases, TCO, value tracking, and the ability to translate technical choices into economic impact.</div> </li> </ul> <div>Nice to have:</div> <ul> <li> <div>German not strictly required.</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience with clients in pharma sector.</div> </li> <li> <div>Cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g. Azure Solutions Architect, Databricks Data Engineer or Solutions Architect).</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience in tech due diligence or post-merger transformation projects.</div> </li> <li> <div>Prior technical background as an engineer or developer.</div> </li> </ul> <div><strong>What we offer:</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>A role bridging strategy and technology, with direct impact on client decisions.</div> </li> <li> <div>International projects on Data Mesh, data platforms and GenAI.</div> </li> <li> <div>Close collaboration with the Project Lead and a growth path towards programme leadership roles.</div> </li> <li> <div>Location and working model: (Hybrid) Zurich or Lausanne.</div> </li> <li>Highly competitive compensation package</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This position is based in <strong>Zürich</strong>.</p> <p><em>Don’t worry if you don’t meet all the criteria! We value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else. We’d love to hear from you and learn more about your passion for driving the AI revolution.</em></p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.</strong></p> <p>Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über <strong>10.000 Unternehmen weltweit</strong> - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.</p> <p>Inzwischen laufen täglich <strong>Millionen von Nachrichten</strong> über Superchat.</p> <p>Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox - ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.</p> <p>Heute sind wir ein Team von rund <strong>100 Mitarbeitenden</strong>, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt <strong>18 Millionen Euro Funding</strong> eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück - seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).</p> <p>Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin. </p> <p><em>In diesem Praktikum im AI & Automation Squad hilfst du unseren Kund:innen, unsere KI-Features wirklich einzusetzen, hältst die operativen Abläufe im Hintergrund am Laufen und unterstützt unser Product Marketing. KI-Expert:in musst du dafür nicht sein - genau das lernst du hier.</em></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Das Praktikum ist in Vollzeit, dauert 6 Monate und startet so bald wie möglich in Berlin.</strong></p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Want</strong></span></h4> <p data-lfile-container="d64d8663-7ac9-42d2-a1b9-4217c33bcd2e" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Customer-facing at heart.<br></strong>Du bist gerne im direkten Austausch mit Kund:innen, ob am Telefon oder im Meeting. Du hörst zu, verstehst, was dein Gegenüber braucht, und stellst dich auf jede Person individuell ein.</p> <p><strong>Explains tech in plain language.</strong><br>Du kannst technische Themen so einfach erklären, dass sie auch Menschen verstehen, die nicht in der Tech-Branche arbeiten.</p> <p><strong>Hands-on, not just interested.</strong><br>Du probierst ein Tool lieber aus, als nur darüber zu lesen. Wenn etwas Neues kommt, klickst du dich rein, testest herum und findest heraus, wie es funktioniert.</p> <p><strong>Takes ownership.</strong><br>Du wartest nicht auf Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen. Du übernimmst Aufgaben, treibst sie selbst voran und stellst Fragen, wenn du sie brauchst.</p> <p><strong>Fluent German.</strong><br>Du sprichst fließend Deutsch, denn die meisten deiner Kundengespräche finden auf Deutsch statt.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Who We Don’t Want</span></h4> <ul data-lfile-container="d64d8663-7ac9-42d2-a1b9-4217c33bcd2e" data-pm-slice="3 3 []"> <li>Du kommst nicht vom Fachjargon los - du sprichst in Anglizismen und Tech-Begriffen und tust dich schwer, dich auf eine:n SMB-Inhaber:in am Telefon einzustellen</li> <li>Du willst reine Marketing- oder Content-Arbeit machen und Calls oder Customer-Success-Meetings lieber vermeiden</li> <li>Du brauchst ständige Anleitung und wartest auf Schritt-für-Schritt-Vorgaben, statt Verantwortung zu übernehmen</li> <li>Du redest viel über den KI-Hype, hast die Tools aber noch nie selbst genutzt oder etwas damit gebaut</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Your Day To Day</span></h4> <p data-lfile-container="d64d8663-7ac9-42d2-a1b9-4217c33bcd2e" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">AI Adoption & Customer Success (~50%)</span><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li data-lfile-container="d64d8663-7ac9-42d2-a1b9-4217c33bcd2e" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <p>Du führst Customer-Success-Meetings mit unseren Kund:innen und unterstützt sie dabei, das Beste aus den KI-Features von Superchat herauszuholen.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div> <div> <div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">AI Operations (~20%) </span></p> <ul> <li>Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die operativen Prozesse rund um unsere KI-Features und sorgst dafür, dass alles reibungslos läuft. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Product Team zusammen und bekommst tiefe Einblicke, wie unsere AI Agents funktionieren.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Product Marketing (~30%) </span></p> <ul> <li>Du unterstützt unser Product Marketing über Social Media, E-Mail-Kampagnen, Intercom und HubSpot und sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI-Launches auch wirklich bei unseren Kund:innen ankommen.</li> </ul> <h4>Why People Choose Us</h4> <ul> <li>Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag</li> <li>Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit</li> <li>Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln</li> <li>Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu</li> <li>Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits & culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents</li> <li>Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht</li> <li>Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung</li> </ul> <p><strong>We want to build a community, not just a company.</strong></p> <p>Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!</p> <p><strong>Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Diversität Unternehmen besser macht. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerber:innen. Unabhängig von Gender, Herkunft, Nationalität oder Glaube. Fühl dich frei und schicke uns gerne deine Bewerbung!</strong></p> <p><strong>Mit deiner Bewerbung stimmst du unseren Datenschutzrichtlinien zu.</strong></p> <p><strong>Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! 🙂</strong></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><img src="https://i.imgur.com/Uicf3C7.jpg" alt="" width="800" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Trading Operations Analyst - Instrument Operations
description: Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Today, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €50 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years. The role We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Graduate Trading Operations Analyst to join our Berlin team. You will help run and improve the operational processes that support our trading platform and the instruments available to customers. The role covers a broad range of topics - from investigating operational issues and supporting complex cases to understanding how processes, systems and data fit together. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning how things work and finding better ways of working. We are looking for curiosity, sound judgment and the motivation to develop. What you’ll do Execute and monitor essential daily and event-driven Trading Operations processes. Help manage the instruments available to customers in collaboration with Trading and Corporate Actions. Investigate operational discrepancies and identify their underlying causes. Support the development of reliable, efficient and scalable operational processes. Use data and appropriate digital tools to analyse issues and improve recurring activities. Collaborate with Product, Customer Service, Trading and Development teams to resolve problems. Create and maintain clear procedures and operational controls. Develop the knowledge required to support complex instrument and trading-related queries. Contribute to team projects and wider operational improvements. What you need to have Currently completing or recently completed an undergraduate degree. We welcome applicants from a broad range of academic backgrounds. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Curiosity about how trading processes, systems and data work together. The ability and motivation to learn unfamiliar concepts and tools quickly. Good attention to detail and a methodical approach to work. Clear written and verbal communication skills. A proactive mindset and willingness to take responsibility. The ability to work effectively both independently and with others. Nice to have An interest in financial markets, investing, instruments or financial technology. Exposure to data analysis, automation or technical tools through university, an internship, extracurricular activities or personal interest. Knowledge of SQL, Python, APIs or similar tools. German language skills at C1 level or above. What we offer Challenges that will help you develop and realise your potential quickly. Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact early in your career. The chance to improve services used by millions of investors. Smart, high-performing colleagues who share a common goal. An environment where ideas are valued and existing processes can be challenged. A generous remuneration package. Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker! We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. title: Security Associate - Internship
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ SECURITY ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐ Six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris. Looking for an end-of-studies internship where you do real cybersecurity work, not a side project nobody uses? Alan protects the health data of more than 1M members, and keeping it safe is part of everyday work here. You join the Security team as a full member for six months. Topics span from compliance and certifications to vulnerabilities, detection and incident response, and you have room to pick the ones where you can have the most impact. A dedicated coach guides you and supervises your thesis. The goal at the end is a full-time job at Alan. ⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐ Alan is opening new countries, and each one brings more audits, certifications and customer security reviews. Possible topics span from governance and compliance to hands-on technical work. You won't do all of them: with your coach, you choose the ones that matter most for Alan and for you. Governance, risk and compliance: ISO 27001 and HDS (French health data hosting) certifications, statutory IT audit, customer security reviews, risk management Vulnerability management: triage reports and scanner findings, drive fixes with engineering teams, improve our tooling Detection and response: write detection rules, investigate alerts, support the team on incidents Build: technical projects you own from framing to adoption. Past projects: an internal pentest for an audit, code scanning and remediation, an HDS internal audit, tooling proofs of concept Automate what repeats , so the team spends its time where the risk is ⭐ KEY OUTCOMES ⭐ By the end of the internship, you will have: Owned a recurring security campaign end to end and left it cheaper for the next round Shipped one technical project to real users Written your end-of-studies thesis on a real security subject Worked with engineers and senior people across the company ⭐ PROFILE & COMPETENCIES ⭐ End of studies: engineering or security track, looking for a six-month internship Security foundations: solid basics in security and IT, and you can apply them to a concrete case You code: Python at least, and you automate the repetitive part Curiosity: you dig into topics you don't master yet, and you are curious about compliance, not only offensive security Risk sense: you know not every risk is equal, and some trade-offs are worth taking Collaboration: you work with engineers, not against them, and look for solutions that work for both sides Clear communication: structured and written, in English (French is a plus) Bonus: CTFs, personal security projects, a previous security internship, cloud or SaaS experience 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits. Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance. We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change. We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision-making processes and challenge the status quo. The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are: Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). At the same time, Finance is taking over the Solvency 2 balance sheet, which will be audited from 2028. We’re looking for a rigorous, ownership-driven insurance finance professional to own our prévoyance technical flows and the production of the Solvency 2 balance sheet. You’ll join the Financial Controlling team (within Financial Reporting) and act as the hub between Risk, Actuarial, Ops, Data and Strategy, as well as the main contact for our reinsurers and external auditors. You’ll know these numbers inside out: how they’re produced, what business reality they reflect, and how to defend them to auditors, the ACPR and the Board. You read the source texts yourself (accounting rules, Solvency 2 regulation, treaty clauses), form your own view, and know when to escalate. ⭐️ What you will do ⭐️ Prévoyance flows: own premiums, claims, technical provisions (mathematical and claims reserves) and related reinsurance, from P&L through balance sheet and cash Reinsurance accounting: manage reinsurance accounts, quarterly settlements and profit-sharing clauses, making sure the books reflect what our treaties actually say Solvency 2 balance sheet (solo and group): restate French GAAP to Solvency 2, challenge actuarial best estimates and risk margin, and track own funds quarter to quarter Regulatory reporting: prepare balance sheet and own-funds QRTs and write the balance-sheet section of the SFCR Audit readiness: be the single point of contact for auditors on Solvency 2, starting with the 2027 dry run, with documentation and controls always ready Monthly review: analyse and comment on your scope (P&L, balance sheet, variances, loss ratio and other insurance KPIs) Automation: turn manual computations into clear specs for our Finance Data team, and use data and AI to make closing faster and more reliable Business partnering: flag the accounting and solvency impact of new products, treaties or markets early and follow through to implementation ⭐️ What we’re looking for ⭐️ At least 5 years in insurance accounting, ideally Big 4 insurance audit followed by finance or reporting at an insurer Strong command of French GAAP insurance accounting (technical provisions, reinsurance, insurance P&L) Hands-on experience with the Solvency 2 balance sheet and QRTs Strong analytical skills: reconciling large datasets, bridging French GAAP to Solvency 2, spotting inconsistencies; comfortable with SQL and AI tools Organised, rigorous and comfortable building structure from ambiguity; you close the loops and can explain technical topics to actuaries, auditors and non-finance stakeholders alike Fluent in English and French Big pluses: prévoyance experience (long-term reserves, mortality/disability tables, profit-sharing), having built a Solvency 2 production process, actuarial knowledge, IFRS 17. 🌍 How we work Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France. The role is based in Paris. Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration. 🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.
