title: Senior Sales Manager, AI & Enterprise (all genders)
description: About the Role You will win and grow our largest client relationships: enterprise and upper Mittelstand companies in DACH that want to run their commercial processes on one platform and automate them with AI agents. You open doors at C level, understand the business problem better than anyone else in the room, shape the solution together with our engineers and consultants, and close deals of six figures and more. We are not looking for a classic sales profile. We are looking for someone clients trust because they know what they are talking about: processes, data, integrations and what AI can and cannot do. Someone who listens first, asks the second and third question, and is comfortable saying "we are not the right partner for this". In a team of around 30 people, without Konzern overhead, and with direct access to our CEO. What You'll Do Own large enterprise deals end to end, from the first conversation with a C level sponsor to signature and handover to delivery. Open new accounts in our focus industries, especially manufacturing (machinery and industrial tech) and construction and building materials, often companies that sell through dealers, partners and installers. Lead discovery: understand the client's processes, data and systems, and turn a vague "we need something with AI" into a clear business case. Sell our full model: paid Discovery, a fixed price build (portals, CPQ, field service, CRM, AI agents) and ongoing operation of the solution. Shape solutions together with our solution architects and AI engineers, and sell only what we can deliver. Grow accounts after go-live with new use cases, entities and agents. Build your own pipeline through your network, the HubSpot partner ecosystem, referrals and targeted outreach. Use AI tools in your own daily work for research, preparation and proposals. What You Bring Must-haves At least eight years in B2B solution or services sales, including at least three years personally owning enterprise deals. A track record of deals of EUR 100k and more that you originated and closed yourself, with several decision makers, procurement and IT involved. A solid technical or process background (for example IT, engineering, business informatics or consulting) and real interest in AI, digitalisation and business processes. You don't code, but you can follow an architecture discussion and explain a trade-off to a CFO. A consultative way of selling: you listen more than you talk, and clients describe you as helpful, not pushy. Native or C2 level German and fluent English, written and spoken. Within commuting distance of Böblingen and happy to travel to clients in DACH. Nice-to-haves Experience at an IT consultancy, system integrator or B2B software vendor selling CRM, ERP, CPQ, PIM, field service, data or AI projects. Experience selling to machine builders or building materials companies with dealer or service networks. Knowledge of HubSpot, Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics at enterprise scale. Experience with structured qualification such as MEDDPICC from real deals. Your Team You'll be part of our Sales Function and report directly to our CEO. You'll work alongside our Sales Manager and Senior Account Executive, and on every deal closely with solution architects, AI engineers, consultants and project managers from our Practices in Böblingen and Lisbon. Tech Stack HubSpot Sales Hub, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, PandaDoc, Confluence, Jira, Microsoft Teams, Claude. On the solution side you'll meet HubSpot, ERP integrations, custom portals and AI agents built on large language models. What We Offer Attractive package with a fixed salary and a variable component that rewards good deals, not just more deals. 31 vacation days per year: 30 days plus one extra company day for Christmas or a holiday of your choice. Baden-Württemberg public holidays come on top. Hybrid working with two office days per week at our Böblingen HQ. Company pension plan (Allianz) with an employer contribution from your second year that grows with tenure. Business Bike leasing with the 0.25 percent tax advantage, full insurance, annual service and free brand choice. Lunch subsidy of 5 EUR tax-free per working day, up to 100 EUR per month. Corporate Benefits discount platform covering travel, tech, fashion, mobility and insurance. Direct impact. Flat hierarchy, direct line to the CEO, and the chance to shape how a growing AI consultancy sells. About Thorit Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software that acts on goals instead of waiting for clicks. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients in DACH and the Nordics, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them. Ready to Apply? Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but please include a short description of the largest deal you personally originated and closed: what the client bought, rough deal size, how many people were involved in the decision, and what made the difference. ISMS processes : run security incident management and change management in Jira (workflows, fields, records), and the business continuity part of customer requests (ISO 22301-type questionnaires). AI governance : maintain the AI systems inventory, review the AI features of tools before use, and follow regulatory changes (EU AI Act). title: Systems Engineer - Database Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong> Available Locations: Austin, New York, San Francisco, Remote</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>We manage an internal, multi-region PostgreSQL platform that enables engineers to rapidly build, deploy, and operate services. Our mission is to provide a highly available, stable, and self-service platform with clear operational visibility. As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with database engineers, developers, and infrastructure teams to evolve our database architecture and automation. You will be instrumental in scaling our PostgreSQL infrastructure and enhancing database reliability. If you are passionate about PostgreSQL, automation, reliability, and database tooling, let's connect!</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, deploy, and manage PostgreSQL database clusters in production environments. </li> <li>Develop and maintain database tooling for automation, monitoring and performance tuning.</li> <li>Implement high availability, backup and disaster recovery solutions. </li> <li>Work closely with Infrastructure and Applications teams to integrate database tools. </li> <li>Implement proactive solutions using observability tools to monitor database health. </li> <li>Optimize database performance, indexing strategies, and query tuning. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with building, scaling, and managing large-scale multi-tenant PostgreSQL database clusters, encompassing high availability failover, and disaster recovery strategies.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible or Salt) .</li> <li>Experience in scripting languages (Python, Bash) for automation. </li> <li>Experience building and maintaining database tooling for automation and monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Experience optimizing database performance and query tuning.</li> <li>Experience with alerting and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience developing software in Go, Ruby or C/C++</li> <li>Contributions to PostgreSQL or relevant open-source projects.</li> <li>Expertise in database schema migrations and automation using tools like Flyway, Liquibase or goose. </li> <li>Experience with connection pooling solutions such as PgBouncer, HAProxy.</li> <li>Experience with non-relational data stores such as Distributed & time-series databases (ex. Cassandra, Timescale) and key-value stores (eg., Redis) </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $196,000</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $187,000 </span></li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Über Vestlane Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Du hast schon ein paar Jahre B2B-Marketing gemacht und willst jetzt Kanäle wirklich verantworten statt nur zuzuarbeiten? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne selbst in einem Fonds zu sitzen? Du kannst schreiben, denkst in Zielgruppen statt in Posts und findest es reizvoll, aus GwG und CSSF-Rundschreiben Inhalte zu machen, die Compliance-Verantwortliche tatsächlich lesen? Du betreibst Marketing mit KI-Tools und Daten statt mit der Gießkanne? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! Als Marketing Manager arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Go-to-Market verantwortet, und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO. Du übernimmst die Marketing-Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Content und SEO über LinkedIn und Newsletter bis Website und Events – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die unsere Positionierung bewegt. Kolleg:innen aus Regulatory, Design und Customer Success liefern dir Fachwissen, Grafiken und Kundenstimmen. Echte Verantwortung für eigene Kanäle ab Tag eins, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, keine Agenturschleifen. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Office in Bonn, mit flexiblen Home-Office-Regelungen. Deine Aufgaben Content, der gelesen wird: Du planst und schreibst Blogartikel, Landingpages und Fachbeiträge zu KYC/AML, AMLR, Fondsregulierung und unseren Produktfeatures – auf Deutsch und Englisch, fachlich sauber, verständlich und mit Haltung. SEO und GEO verantworten: Du baust auf unseren bestehenden Rankings auf, entwickelst die Keyword-Strategie weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Vestlane auch dort gefunden wird, wo heute gesucht wird. LinkedIn und Newsletter fahren: Du bespielst die Company Page, bereitest Posts für die Geschäftsführung vor und verantwortest unseren Regulatory- und Product-Newsletter von der Themenplanung bis zum Versand. Website weiterentwickeln: Du pflegst und erweiterst vestlane.com in unserem CMS (Storyblok), briefst Design, testest neue Seiten und misst, was funktioniert. Success Stories und Events: Du sammelst Kundenstimmen gemeinsam mit Customer Success, machst daraus Case Studies und verantwortest das Pre- und Post-Marketing von Events, Webinaren und Partner-Announcements. Die Marketing-Maschine bauen: Du strukturierst Contentplanung, Tracking und Reporting, baust KI-Workflows für Recherche, Entwürfe und Distribution und zeigst mit Zahlen, welche Maßnahmen Pipeline bringen. Dein Profil 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise SaaS, Finanz- oder Legal-/RegTech-Umfeld. Du hast schon mindestens einen Kanal eigenständig verantwortet (Content, SEO, LinkedIn oder Newsletter) und kannst zeigen, was dabei herausgekommen ist. Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch: klar, präzise, ohne Buzzword-Nebel. Du kannst einen komplexen Sachverhalt in drei Sätzen erklären und in einem Post zuspitzen. Solide SEO-Kenntnisse (Keyword-Recherche, On-Page, Content-Struktur, Tracking) und echtes Interesse an Generative Engine Optimization. Erfahrung mit einem CMS, LinkedIn Company Pages und einem Newsletter-Tool. Du nutzt KI-Tools im Alltag selbstverständlich für Recherche, Entwürfe und Analysen und weißt, wo du selbst nachschärfen musst. Du magst Zahlen: Du willst wissen, ob dein Artikel rankt, ob der Newsletter geöffnet wird und was davon im CRM ankommt. Interesse an Finanzregulierung und Compliance. Du musst kein GwG-Profi sein, aber du musst Lust haben, dich einzuarbeiten – Fachwissen bekommst du von Kolleg:innen, die täglich damit arbeiten. Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Content-Lieferant:in. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust. Deine Benefits Eigene Kanäle und Themen ab Tag eins, mit klarem Entwicklungspfad hin zu mehr Verantwortung im Marketing Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit COO und CEO, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Agenturschleifen Vollzeit, unbefristet, Start ab sofort möglich Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 30 Tage Urlaub Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen Arbeitsplatz in unserem Bonner Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen Moderne Tools und KI im täglichen Einsatz Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor Abschluss Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (Artikel, Posts, Landingpages, Newsletter – was zeigt, wie du arbeitest). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht; ein paar Sätze dazu, warum Marketing für ein RegTech dich reizt, reichen. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung. Fragen vor der Bewerbung? title: Stage - Chargé(e) de missions IA
description: SOGECLAIR Training & Simulation conçoit des simulateurs de formation à la conduite ferroviaire, logiciels et matériels, autour de sa plateforme OkSyGen. La société compte environ 125 personnes réparties dans cinq pays : France, Inde, Australie, Canada et Royaume-Uni. Elle est engagée dans un programme de transformation, qui touche ses métiers, ses méthodes et ses outils. L'IA en est l'un des leviers. Des outils sont déjà déployés et l'équipe de transformation digitale du groupe SOGECLAIR travaille sur le sujet. Ce que nous recherchons, c'est une personne qui fasse le lien entre ces possibilités et le quotidien des équipes : comprendre les besoins réels, prouver la valeur par des cas concrets, et donner envie à chacun de s'en emparer. MISSIONS : Votre rôle : être le catalyseur de l'adoption de l'IA dans toute la société. Vous travaillerez en lien étroit avec l'équipe de transformation digitale du groupe. Comprendre le terrain. Mener des entretiens dans toutes les équipes (ingénierie, projets, commerce, support client, etc..) pour identifier les irritants réels et les cas d'usage à fort potentiel. Poser un cadre. Cartographier les données par niveau de sensibilité et proposer des règles d'usage claires : quel outil pour quelle donnée. Prouver par l'exemple. Concevoir et déployer des POC sur les cas d'usage prioritaires, définir les indicateurs de gain et les mesurer. Embarquer les équipes. Rendre l'IA compréhensible et utile pour chacun : démonstrations sur le travail réel des équipes, ateliers, formations. Construire la feuille de route. Élaborer une feuille de route IA couvrant toutes les équipes et la présenter au CODIR. En 6 mois : une feuille de route IA pour toutes les équipes, des POC déployés et utilisés, et un CODIR qui maîtrise réellement les possibilités de l'IA. Mois 1 : immersion et diagnostic. title: KYC & AML Operations Manager (m/w/d)
description: Über Vestlane Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm. Du machst seit Jahren fundierte und pragmatische KYC- und AML-Arbeit und bist bereit, mehr zu verantworten, als die Karriereleiter über dir zulässt? Du möchtest mit modernen Tools und KI am Puls der Zeit in einem dynamischen Team arbeiten? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! “KYC/AML Services” ist Vestlanes jüngstes Team, das die operative KYC- und AML-Arbeit für Fonds- und Asset Manager-Kunden in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg erbringt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of KYC & AML Operations zusammen und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und hast direkten Investoren- und Kundenkontakt. Deinen Entwicklungspfad gestaltest du aktiv mit, erfolgsabhängig, statt getrieben vom nächsten Beförderungszyklus. Deine Aufgaben Investorenakten von A bis Z: Du führst KYC-Prüfungen, Risikobewertungen und Enhanced Due Diligence für Investoren und Assets in Fondsstrukturen in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg durch – mithilfe unserer KI-gestützten, digitalen Plattform. Screening-Treffer bearbeiten: Du bewertest und dokumentierst Treffer aus Namens-, Sanktions- und Adverse-Media-Screening und bereitest klare, entscheidungsreife Bewertungen vor – mithilfe nativer KI-Agenten. Geldwäschebeauftragte der Kunden unterstützen: Du erstellst Eskalationsvermerke und Reportings, damit Geldwäschebeauftragte und Responsables du Contrôle unserer Kunden auf solider Grundlage entscheiden können. Die Maschine mitbauen: Du wirkst an Policies, Checklisten, QA-Standards und Tooling unserer Abteilung aktiv mit. Du hinterfragst kritisch, denkst Prozesse neu. Du willst KYC/AML als Geschäftschance verstehen und nicht als Last. Das Produkt verbessern: Du zeigst auf, wo die Vestlane-Plattform KYC-Arbeit schneller und sicherer machen kann, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam um. Dein Profil Mindestens 3 Jahre operative KYC/AML- oder vergleichbare Erfahrung, etwa bei einer Big-4- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, einem Fondsadministrator, einer KYC/AML-Beratung oder in der AML-Funktion eines Fonds oder Finanzinstituts. Sichere Kenntnisse des deutschen und des Luxemburger Rechtsrahmens: GwG und BaFin-Auslegungspraxis auf der einen Seite, CSSF-Anforderungen und das Luxemburger AML-Gesetz auf der anderen. Du kennst beide Welten und weißt, wo sie sich unterscheiden. UK-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit Fondsstrukturen und ihren Investoren (Institutionelle Anleger, Gesellschaften, Trusts, verschachtelte UBO-Ketten). Private-Markets-Erfahrung ist ein starkes Plus. Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) sind willkommen, keine Voraussetzung. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Französisch hilft in Luxemburg, ist aber keine Bedingung. Präzision und Urteilsvermögen: Du dokumentierst sauber, eskalierst im richtigen Moment und willst, dass deine Arbeit jeder Prüfung standhält. Gleichzeitig bist du pragmatisch, du weißt, dass Risiko aus “Impact” und “Likelihood” besteht. Du siehst dich als Unternehmer innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als reiner Checklisten-Abhaker. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust. Benefits bei Vestlane Teammitglied mit klarem Entwicklungspfad, wenn der Kundenstamm wächst Direkter Kundenkontakt ab Tag eins, keine fünf Ebenen zwischen dir und den Menschen, für die deine Arbeit zählt Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 30 Tage Urlaub Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) Büro in Bonn Flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor Abschluss Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges Anschreiben. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen. Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag der Abteilung, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung. Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Melde dich bei uns! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Designer, Web3
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who we are </strong></h4> <p>We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.</p> <p> </p> <p>Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!</p> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Your mission </strong></p> <p>As a Senior Product Designer on Bitpanda’s Web3 team, you will architect the user experiences that power our next-generation crypto ecosystem, from asset-backed loans in the Bitpanda app to tokenised structured products in the Vision Wallet. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day. What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day. What you'll do You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with. Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket. Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved. Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on. Ship, then check. title: Electrical Engineer II
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Please submit your application in English 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing. You’ll work closely with our engineering team based in Manchester as we look to expand our engineering and operations in Germany and across Europe. Together, the team takes an integration project from the very early information stage, designs how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turns that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset. The Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware & Software) and other connectivity technologies with their protocol engineering are owned by our UK-based team, who will support you in becoming configuration literate. Over time you will carry out configuration, deployments and testing for sites yourself, and feed back what you learn about hardware, connectivity and grid operator requirements for European countries so the wider team can build on it. Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing, they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing ones. 🚀 What you'll own Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches for German sites, mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar). When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives in German and English through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members. Market access & prequalification support: Support the technical work needed for assets to enter ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and to meet Redispatch 3.0 requirements. With guidance from senior engineers, help prepare the telemetry and control evidence for prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; our focus is enabling market access, telemetry and dispatch.) Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team. Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include German grid connection rules and TSO-specific requirements, ancillary services, Redispatch 3.0, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on. Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the Gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get Gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time. Hardware and software deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing of sites with guidance from the senior engineers. Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team. Hardware handling & dispatch: Berlin is planned as our stock base for our hardware going out to sites across Europe, so the role includes some hands-on work. This covers preparing units before they ship, such as flashing and configuring our industrial PCs and running pre-shipment tests, and helping to prepare and coordinate shipments. Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning, initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand in Germany and other parts of Europe grows. Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties, but occasional hands-on support in Germany may be needed before or after a deployment. Incidents & support: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English , needed for technical documentation and for working with customers, grid operators and our UK-based team. Understanding of the German connection landscape: Working knowledge of the TSO/DSO hierarchy, the connection/integration process, and the technical connection rules (such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120) a grid-connected asset must meet before it can participate in the energy markets. Understanding of the German energy markets: Working understanding of the German ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR), what prequalification involves, and the Redispatch 3.0 framework. Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution. Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation. Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control. Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation. Hardware and networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support. Hands-on hardware preparation: Comfortable working at the bench with our panels and industrial PCs. This includes safely powering panels up and down using our test setup, flashing operating system images, and following a set procedure for pre-shipment checks. Full training is provided. Industrial communication protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus. CAD, diagrams and tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion. Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with a team that is partly based in another country. Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them. Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration. A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time. Location and travel: Ideally based close to Kraken’s Berlin office . Willingness to travel to customers and sites in Germany, and occasionally to our Manchester team, although travel is kept to a minimum. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote. ⭐️ Bonus points Wider knowledge of German grid compliance (VDE-AR-N 4110/4120, TSO-specific technical requirements) and where the Kraken system fits in. Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures. Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows. Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness; IEC 62443 a plus). Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany. title: Sr. Director, Developer GTM
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. description: Lieu : Nantes sud (44) Salaire : 50 K€ annuel brut Rythme : 1 journée de télétravail par semaine Nous recherchons pour notre client, un Product Owner Data Technico-Fonctionnel (H/F) dans le cadre d'une création de poste en CDI. Conception et mise en valeur des produits data Industrialiser les flux : Concevoir les pipelines de données et superviser l'alimentation continue du datalake. Soutenir l'innovation IA : Préparer et structurer les jeux de données nécessaires aux cas d'usage portés par l'équipe IA Factory. Animer les rituels de livraison : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les data engineers et les intégrateurs, rythmer les cérémonies agiles et valider les mises en production. title: Product Engineer (Frontend) (m/f/d)
description: Hi, we are Particula, the prime rating provider for digital assets! Our mission? To make the market for digital assets more accessible, secure and transparent for institutional investors. We support issuers, trading facilities, banks and asset managers to create trust, minimize risks and allocate capital effectively. Join our team and shape the future of the financial world with us! 👋 About the Role We are looking for a product engineer to own our user-facing applications end to end. We operate without dedicated designers or product managers. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders as well as backend & AI engineers to turn high-level goals into shipped, well-measured features. This is not a ticket-closing role. You spot user friction, propose a fix, build it, measure the outcome and iterate quickly. You will also help shape how we build software with AI agents, translating requirements into working code and establishing the guardrails, automated tests and review habits that keep quality high when code is AI-assisted. You remain responsible for every line you ship, whether you or an agent wrote it. What you will do Ship features end to end: Take concepts from conversation to production, covering UX design, frontend implementation, API integration and deployment. Act as a product builder: Spot friction points yourself, pitch improvements and make sure every feature solves a real user need. Make decisions with data: Implement analytics, track feature adoption and iterate on the numbers. Work directly with users: Talk to internal teams as well as external stakeholders, and turn unstructured feedback into clear technical plans. Own AI-assisted delivery: Use and orchestrate coding agents daily. Write the specs and plans, choose the patterns and approach, and review generated code before you push it. Review your peers' work: Be one of the main reviewers of frontend pull requests, and keep a balance between delivering working functionality and keeping the review workload manageable. Own the design system: Maintain and extend the shared component library and UI guidelines so the product stays consistent. An external design agency will help set the visual language. Own quality and testing: Propose and set up the QA and testing strategy for your area, using automated E2E and component tests to ensure reliability, performance and security. How we work These are fixed parts of the job, and we ask candidates to read them as requirements. Delivery process: Work follows a defined delivery process. Inside it, you own the open decisions in your area, including solution design and implementation approach. Decision rights: Architecture, API contracts and design system direction are set centrally because they are shared across teams. You change them through a written proposal. Once a decision is made, everyone follows it. Backend engineers own the security and performance of services. Team rhythm: A daily stand-up and a biweekly Friday demo. Attendance is expected. Speed: We ship small and often and iterate on the interface quickly. Quality comes from tests and reviews, not from polishing before release. Requirements Must have 5+ years of commercial software engineering, with evidence of owned product work: features you took from problem to production and measured. Experience in a fast-paced startup is a plus. Strong frontend expertise: Deep proficiency in TypeScript and a modern component framework (Vue 3 / Nuxt preferred). Product and UX sense: A track record of designing clean, functional interfaces and delivering features without dedicated PMs or designers. Data-driven mindset: Hands-on experience setting up and using analytics tools (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar). Daily use of AI coding agents: Active experience with agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot), a clear method for guiding them, and a clear method for checking what they produce. Testing and review habits: Experience with automated E2E and UI testing (Playwright, Cypress, Vitest), the ability to define a testing strategy, and the discipline to review code, yours and others', before it merges. title: Intermediate Backend Engineer , Security Factory
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you'll help developers find and fix security issues in their code by contributing to the static analysis engine that finds them.</p> <p>Your work spans both the engine and the tools we use to evaluate it. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You'll also build and apply tooling to test its findings against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, measuring both false positives and missed vulnerabilities.</p> <p>We build the engine with artificial intelligence (AI) agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. You'll implement component specifications within the team's architecture, working with engineers and AI agents. Good judgment about when to trust agent output, and when to bring it to human review, is central to the role.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Extend the program model, including parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis, to support new languages and frameworks.</li> <li>Build and apply AI-assisted tooling to implement, review, and validate engine changes and findings, in collaboration with the team's technical leadership. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.</li> <li>Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.</li> <li>Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.</li> <li>Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.</li> <li>Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, and identify and address technical debt that slows the team down.</li> <li>Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to assess when their output is trustworthy.</li> <li>Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Rust or Go. Our engine is written in Rust, the analyzer wrapper in Go, and the monolith integration in Ruby. You'll be willing to work across them.</li> <li>An interest in static analysis and application security, including parsing, intermediate representations, taint and data-flow analysis, and how vulnerabilities arise in code. Deep expertise isn't required; we'll help you grow it.</li> <li>Organize and progress your work independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to communicate technical problems clearly and concisely and propose iterative solutions.</li> <li>Helpful but not required: experience with performance optimization, Docker and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), web or mobile frameworks, guardrails for agent-written code such as mutation testing and fuzzing, or program analysis and security research through publications or open source contributions. Willingness to learn performance optimization and containerized workflows is also welcome.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab's SAST capabilities for customer software repositories. We work closely with the Code Security team on scanning rules and flows, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.</p> <p>At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Network Security Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX</p> <h4><strong>About the Department</strong></h4> <p>The Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, our team is always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - to help build a better service and future product development.</p> <h4><strong>About the Role</strong></h4> <p>Do you love solving complex technical problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced Network Security Engineer to join our team and support our largest and most technically sophisticated customers in resolving technical problems, threats or attacks on their infrastructure at OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7. This will span the range of Cloudflare products from Magic Transit Infrastructure Protection, Argo Smart Routing, DDoS mitigation and Network Firewall, to using the Web Application firewall (WAF), Spectrum and Rate Limiting to help customers.</p> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Communicate with customers via chat, email, and phone </li> <li>Compare traffic signatures and attributes including IP addresses, cookie variations, HTTP headers, and JavaScript footprints to determine what is good traffic and what is malicious</li> <li>DDoS mitigation for OSI layers 3,4, & 7: advise customers on how to filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare tools like Magic Transit, Network Firewall, WAF, IP reputation lists, packet inspection, blocklisting, allowlisting, and rate limiting</li> <li>Work with Engineering and Operations teams to mitigate attacks, suggest steps to mitigate, and apply the appropriate mitigation when applicable</li> <li>Work with Engineering and Product teams to improve products and tools</li> </ul> <h4>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h4> <ul> <li>Fluent English speaker is a requirement</li> <li>Minimum 3 years working within a Technical Support team solving various technical issues </li> <li>Self-driven and capable of learning new technologies / systems / features with little guidance</li> <li>Fundamental understanding how the Internet works (OSI Model)</li> <li>Advanced understanding of internet protocols like TCP and UDP</li> <li>Computer Networking fundamentals, experience with iptables and looking glass</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting network connectivity issues, BGP routing, and GRE tunnels</li> <li>Packet capture analysis</li> <li>Experience in command line and tools, including curl, dig, traceroute, openssl, git</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting DNS, SSL / TLS, HTTP</li> <li>Experience in a web development and / or hosting environment such as installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, Caddy and IIS</li> <li>Experience writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript or other scripting language</li> <li>Experience in working as part of a team in a customer-facing role</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You are familiar with Cloudflare and are actively using our platform</li> <li>You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL, and other database servers</li> <li>You are fluent and can troubleshoot in other languages beyond English and Spanish</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Availability and Schedule Requirements</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Flexibility to work varying work schedules including: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM Pacific Time Zone, Tuesday through Saturday, Sunday through Thursday, holidays, weekends, more than 5 days in a row, or additional hours on occasion.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>Mission Brief</strong> </p> <p>You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds. </p> <p>We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. You own our secure access and network security controls, our endpoint and identity security stack, and our detection content, and you operate them yourself rather than directing from the sidelines. You wear two hats: the Builder who implements and runs the controls that keep us safe, and the Adversary who keeps testing whether those controls and detections actually fire. </p> <p>This is a senior engineering role with the spirit of an architect. You are expected to design what you operate, not just configure it: pick the pattern, write it down, and make it hold at fleet scale. A versatile engineer with real depth, comfortable switching from a firewall rule set to a detection query to a directory hardening sprint in the same week, and a technical anchor others lean on. </p> <p><strong>Your Role in Our Space Mission</strong> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>SASE and Network Security</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Own and operate our SASE platform</strong>, including revamping Internet Security policies and redefining Private Access policies. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Drive firewall security with the network team: </strong>own network security engineering and segmentation strategy, analyze rule sets, identify gaps, and see remediation through together with network engineering, who own the devices. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Coordinate firewall-adjacent controls: </strong>IPS, AV, sandboxing and DDoS protection. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Manage our DNS security and WAF solutions</strong>, including our edge and CDN-based protection services. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Posture and Hardening</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Apply CIS Benchmarks </strong>to raise posture across firewalls, endpoints, our cloud identity platform and our cloud productivity suite. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Lead the clean-up and hardening of our on-premises and cloud identity directories </strong>together with the infrastructure team, then keep both hardened on an ongoing basis. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Drive our phishing-resistant MFA and privileged access programme, </strong>including just-in-time elevation and the remediation of the attack paths we find. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Own certificate lifecycle and PKI operations: </strong>key ceremonies, automated renewal, and input to our post-quantum migration plan. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Detection and Visibility</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage and tune our IPS/IDS platforms; </strong>write and maintain custom IDS signatures, and operate network sensors for NTA appliances. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Build and maintain detections in our SIEM </strong>and apply MITRE ATT&CK to detection engineering and use-case design in support of the SOC. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Extend visibility into OT </strong>with purpose-built OT monitoring tooling. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Act as an L3 incident responder </strong>for escalated security events, and turn every finding into a fix, a new detection or a hardened configuration. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Stack and Automation</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Own our endpoint detection and response, data protection and CASB platforms</strong> as their technical owner. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Script and build internal tooling </strong>in PowerShell and Python, so controls and checks run themselves. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Design and Engineering Partnership</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Design what you operate: </strong>run threat modeling and attack-path analysis on the systems you own, choose the pattern, and document standards others can execute against. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Evaluate tooling and support vendor selection </strong>and renewal decisions in your domain, with a clear view of what each control costs us and what it buys. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Embed security with engineering: </strong>partner with IT, infrastructure, manufacturing and mission teams to implement and validate controls in their environments across both IT and OT, respecting launch-window and change-freeze constraints and producing the evidence our audits depend on. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualification Checklist</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience: </strong>10+ years in security engineering, with real ownership of production security tooling, not policy or advisory work. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Architect Spirit: </strong>you can step back from the console, design the target state, write the pattern down, and then go build it yourself. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>SASE: </strong>hands-on experience administering an enterprise SASE platform end to end, not just consuming it. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Hardening: </strong>experience applying CIS Benchmarks to firewalls, endpoints, cloud identity and cloud productivity platforms in production, plus experience rolling out phishing-resistant MFA or privileged access management. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Networking and Firewalls: </strong>solid fundamentals, enough to own segmentation strategy and to drive rule set analysis and gap remediation with a network team that owns the devices. Experience with CDN-based WAF and edge protection services. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Security Stack Depth: </strong>strong background across endpoint detection and response, data protection, SIEM and detection query languages, cloud identity and on-premises directory hardening, certificate lifecycle and PKI operations, ideally including a large-scale directory clean-up or remediation effort. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Detection Engineering: </strong>practical MITRE ATT&CK-driven detection work, and experience writing custom IDS/IPS signatures. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Operational Depth: </strong>strong capability in detection, incident response and vulnerability management, with time spent on escalated incidents. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Automation: </strong>scripting ability in PowerShell and Python, plus infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code experience. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>IT and OT: </strong>comfortable working across both. Working knowledge of OT protocols such as EtherNet/IP, OPC UA and Modbus, and familiarity with OT network monitoring, is a strong plus. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Autonomy: </strong>operates with very high autonomy as an internal expert, taking full ownership of their work and guiding others. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Mentoring: </strong>mentors engineers and analysts on the team, and acts as technical lead in cross-functional projects. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>clear communication and collaboration skills, able to translate technical risk for a range of audiences and to work controls through other teams. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Education: </strong>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or the equivalent through relevant certifications and hands-on experience. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Skills</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Experience in aerospace, defense, energy, manufacturing or other OT-heavy, safety-critical environments. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Prior SOC or incident response team experience. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Cloud security depth in a major public cloud and its native security services. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Relevant certifications, defensive or engineering (e.g., Security+, GCIA) and offensive (e.g., OSCP or equivalent), are both valued. </li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Real Ownership: the security tooling that protects a
