title: Chief Marketing Officer, Factor Europe
description: <h2><strong>About Factor</strong></h2> <p>Factor is the #1 ready-to-eat brand for people who see personal health as a key ingredient to achieving their goals. Developed by chefs and dietitians, Factor makes healthy eating effortless, enjoyable, and full of flavor. Part of the HelloFresh Group, Factor is the fastest-growing business in the group, and we are now building the next chapter in Europe.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a senior marketing leader to own Factor's European growth. You will run the full marketing agenda across multiple markets: acquiring new customers efficiently, owning the P&L across countries, and building the partnerships and channels that will take Factor beyond direct-to-consumer. This is a lean, flat team that moves fast. You will have full accountability for European decisions, and you will work directly with the leadership team to shape where the business goes next.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scale new customer acquisition at efficient CAC.</strong> Own the social-first growth engine (Meta, influencers, and partnerships) and keep it efficient as spend grows significantly.</li> <li><strong>Own the P&L across multiple markets.</strong> Set and deliver marketing plans, targets, and budgets, and make the trade-offs between markets and channels.</li> <li><strong>Grow the partnerships network.</strong> Expand our rolodex of influencers and strategic partners that feed the acquisition engine.</li> <li><strong>Lead creative with a clear point of view.</strong> Oversee creative functions and set a direction for how Factor shows up for customers.</li> <li><strong>Partner with finance.</strong> Work with finance on business planning, forecasting, and end-to-end customer retention.</li> <li><strong>Prepare new growth channels.</strong> Build toward new distribution channels such as retail and B2B over the next 12 to 18 months, establishing revenue lines beyond direct-to-consumer.</li> <li><strong>Build and lead a lean, high-performing team.</strong> Create clear accountability and keep the organization flat, adding capacity only where the opportunity is clear.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Senior marketing leadership at a scaled European subscription or e-commerce brand</strong>, with a track record of growing new customer volume at efficient acquisition costs.</li> <li><strong>P&L ownership across several countries.</strong> You have been accountable for results, not only for marketing activity.</li> <li><strong>General management experience.</strong> This can come from business, strategy, or consulting roles, or from end-to-end management, including at a smaller company.</li> <li><strong>Multi-market exposure.</strong> You have led or covered several markets as part of your scope.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on leadership.</strong> You are comfortable diving deep yourself and are not only a manager of managers. Earlier-stage or high-growth experience is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven judgment.</strong> You are fluent in data and use it to make fast, clear decisions.</li> <li><strong>Speed and agility, relentless prioritization, and a growth mindset.</strong> You thrive in fast-moving environments and focus on what moves the business.</li> <li><strong>Customer centricity.</strong> You put the customer at the center and work well across functions, including operations and finance.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.</li> <li>Access the "Benefits at Work" platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA. </li> <li>You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop and phone.</li> <li>Build your future with a pension plan through Aegon Cappital (age-based rates, 50/50 split).</li> <li>Receive a 7,5% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis (2026), plus free access to Headspace and OpenUp.</li> <li>Get discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, plus free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam).</li> <li>Benefit from a flexible hybrid work setup with a €2.45 daily remote work allowance.</li> <li>Start with 24 days of annual leave (pro-rata), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).</li> <li>Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, and €0.23 per km for car/bicycle travel.</li> <li>Participate internal/external opportunities aligned with our Job Framework, and join our cross-market mentoring program.</li> <li>Enjoy fresh homemade lunches in the office (€20/month), weekly <em>vrij-mi-bo</em> (Friday drinks), quarterly strategy sessions, and team events.</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Analyst  (M/F/X)
description: <h3>Join a French Foodtech Superstar!</h3> <p>At HelloFresh, we're shaking up the way people eat in France with our meal kits!</p> <p>Our ambition? To revolutionise our subscribers' everyday lives by promoting a more sustainable way of cooking and introducing them to delicious, creative and balanced recipes. The perfect blend of technology and gastronomy, with plenty of flavour!</p> <p>HelloFresh operates in more than 15 countries. France is one of our youngest markets, launched in 2019, where we've experienced tremendous growth, establishing ourselves as the market leader. Joining our team means having a real impact within one of France's most promising scale-ups!</p> <p>How do we make all this happen? Through a talented and dynamic team, strong values rooted in kindness and diversity, and an inspiring, stimulating work environment.</p> <p>If you'd like to be part of this exciting human, international and entrepreneurial adventure, come and join us!</p> <h3><strong>The Role : What’s in the Box</strong></h3> <p>The France Marketing & Product Analytics team is a small team at the core of HelloFresh France's performance management. It measures marketing and product performance, keeps the underlying data reliable, and supports the Growth and Product teams with analyses that guide daily and long-term decisions. ROI and customer lifetime value (CLV) sit at the center of marketing decisions.</p> <p>The team works closely with Marketing, Product, Finance, Operations and Global Analytics (Berlin).</p> <p>The Senior Product Analyst divides their time equally between Product and Marketing. On the product side, they are the analytical reference for product decisions in France, working with the Culinary, Menu Planning and Strategy & Product Development (SPD) teams. On the marketing side, they shape growth strategy with data, weighing investment allocation and acquisition versus retention trade-offs, and explaining what drives marketing performance.</p> <p><strong>Cross-cutting responsibility</strong>: design and maintain internal analytical tools (scripts, dashboards, automations) that support the Culinary, Menu Planning, SPD and marketing workflows, and sponsor agentic analytics and AI tools across both areas.</p> <h3><strong>What You'll Do : The Recipe</strong></h3> <p><strong>Product responsibilities (50%)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Product performance reporting: present regular summaries on menu performance, recipe adoption and assortment rotation to feed management reviews, with key KPIs defined and tracked.</li> <li>Customer analytics through a product lens: analyze menu and recipe performance together with customer behavior and preferences (satisfaction, repurchase, retention by menu or recipe choice) to inform assortment decisions, and identify high-impact opportunities to feed the product strategy.</li> <li>Strategic projects: lead the analytical and operational side of strategic projects that improve the product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Marketing responsibilities (50%)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strategic analyses: collaborate closely with our CMO and marketing leadership to drive strategic decisions (analyses on growth strategy, investment allocation and acquisition versus retention trade-offs).</li> <li>Top line performance deep dives: investigate the root causes behind changes in marketing performance, and explain them from a customer and purchase behavior perspective (customer segmentation, discount applied, box taken, purchase behavior over time).</li> <li>Management summaries: turn these deep dives into concise, top-level insights for management review.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have graduated from a top-tier engineering or business school, or hold a university degree in Data, Statistics or a related field.</li> <li>You have at least 4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence or data science, ideally in an e-commerce, FMCG or food-tech environment.</li> <li>You have advanced SQL skills; Python is a plus.</li> <li>You have experience with BI tools (Tableau preferred) and excellent command of Google Sheets.</li> <li>You have experience using AI/ML tools for exploratory analysis (e.g. anomaly detection), as well as leveraging LLMs to boost analytical productivity.</li> <li>You can turn complex analyses into clear, concise and actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>You are organised, rigorous and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritise multiple topics while giving each the attention it deserves.</li> <li>You are proactive: you know how to ask the right questions, not just find the answers.</li> <li>You are fluent in French and have a good command of English, both spoken and written.</li> <li>Bonus: You have a genuine passion for food and an interest in culinary or FMCG-related topics.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer</strong></h3> <ul> <li>A dynamic and international environment, with a strong corporate culture and DNA</li> <li>Delicious discounts on HelloFresh meal kits</li> <li>A steep learning curve guaranteed!</li> <li>A supportive, passionate, proactive, and dynamic French team</li> <li>Central Paris offices (1st arrondissement)</li> <li>Employee benefits (Alan Blue healthcare, transport discount, Gymlib, training budget)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our recruitment process:</strong></h3> <p>We'll review your CV and cover letter. If your profile looks like a good match, we'll invite you to a series of interviews and ask you to complete a case study. We'll do our best to keep the process moving quickly, so we can hopefully welcome you to HelloFresh soon!</p> <h3><strong>Your first steps at HelloFresh:</strong></h3> <p>When you join us, we'll put together a tailored onboarding programme to help you meet each manager and get to know how HelloFresh works. You'll also have time to get to know your team before diving into your new role!</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <h2><strong>Job Description</strong></h2> <p>As our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you will uncover, test, and bring to life high-impact growth opportunities across Youfoodz direct-to-consumer ecommerce and product marketing. You will move with speed and agility effortlessly shifting from strategic go-to-market planning and commercial modeling to hands-on campaign execution. <br><br>This is an incredible opportunity to help shape how we evolve our growth playbook across Youfoodz, backed by genuine autonomy, real testing resources, and a team that champions fresh perspectives. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, data-driven marketer with sharp commercial acumen and a deep empathy for our customers, ready to collaborate across top channels, unlock game-changing partnerships, and explore new business ventures from day one. <br><br>This role is based in our Chippendale Head Office, Sydney (hybrid) and reports to the Director of Growth, Youfoodz. </p> <p><strong>You will…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor weekly channel performance against business plans, YoY, and monthly activation, reactivation, and referral targets to optimize media spend and ROI.</li> <li>Manage spend pacing, reallocations, discount structures, promotional campaign execution, and post-release testing and analysis.</li> <li>Steer agency, affiliate, SEO, and partner title: Director Minerva Frontline (All Genders)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">WHY JOIN US</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About the Team</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Minerva is STARK’s overarching Mission Operating System — the central cognitive backbone connecting all our unmanned platforms across air, land, and sea, while seamlessly integrating third-party systems and interfacing directly with national Battle Management Systems (BMS). Within this ecosystem, the <strong>Minerva Frontline</strong> organization owns the entire human-machine interface and operator experience on the ground. Our program brings together three specialized product pillars — <strong>Minerva Frontend Applications, Ground Control Stations (GCS), and Mission Simulation</strong> — distributed across Berlin and Munich. We operate with high autonomy, a mission-first mindset, and close collaboration between software engineers, hardware specialists, and operational experts to build reliable, intuitive systems that work when stakes are at their highest.</span></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Your Mission</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">As <strong>Director Minerva Frontline</strong>, you are the holistic Program Owner and external face of STARK’s customer-facing software and mission control suite. Reporting directly to the VP of Software, you will lead the departments across Command & Control (C2) Applications, Ground Control Stations, and Simulation, unifying their efforts into one cohesive, battle-tested product experience. You will set the visionary product roadmap internally while representing our capabilities externally to military stakeholders, procurement agencies, and partners across NATO nations.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Own the end-to-end Minerva Frontline program</strong>, taking full accountability for its strategic roadmap, program budget, commercial targets, and cross-functional delivery across all three product lines.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Lead, mentor, and empower three direct reports</strong> and scale the broader multi-disciplinary organization across Berlin and Munich in these teams.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Define and communicate a compelling product vision</strong> internally, aligning engineering and UX teams around operator needs so that software, ground station hardware, and simulation environments feel like one seamless system.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Serve as the primary external representative for Minerva Frontline</strong>, pitching and demonstrating our C2, GCS, and simulation capabilities to military end-users, defence ministries, and procurement bodies (e.g., BAAINBw).</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Drive seamless system interoperability</strong>, ensuring Minerva Frontline connects effortlessly with STARK’s physical unmanned platforms, third-party assets, and sovereign Battle Management Systems .</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Translate complex battlefield and customer requirements</strong> into structured, actionable engineering priorities, balancing rapid prototyping with mission-critical reliability and safety.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Establish and scale a lean Program Management Office (PMO)</strong> over time to professionalize program tracking, release planning, and cross-entity alignment.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Collaborate closely with Commercial, Marketing, and Physical Platform Leads</strong> to shape go-to-market materials, pricing models, and integrated system demonstrations at test ranges and customer sites.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Proven senior leadership and program ownership experience</strong> managing complex, multi-team software or cyber-physical product organizations, including responsibility for roadmaps, budgets, and delivery.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Strong technical background in building mission-critical software suites</strong>, ideally combining software engineering leadership with hardware-in-the-loop, robotics, C2 systems, or ground control interfaces.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Credibility and domain expertise in the defence or aerospace sector</strong>, with the ability to speak at eye level with military decision-makers, operators, and technical engineers alike.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Exceptional internal and external communication skills</strong> — you know how to inspire engineering teams with a crisp vision and persuasively represent complex technical products to B2G (Business-to-Government) customers.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>High organizational rigor and an owner’s mindset</strong>, capable of turning startup ambiguity into clear structure and driving execution under high tempo.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Willingness to travel regularly</strong> between our hubs in Berlin and Munich as well as to customer sites, military bases, and test ranges across Europe.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Fluency in English</strong> (written and spoken) is mandatory.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Nice-To-Have</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Prior military service</strong> (e.g., former officer or reservist in the Bundeswehr or a NATO allied force), particularly within IT, Cyber, C2, or Air Defence domains.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Fluency in German</strong>, enabling seamless direct engagement with German defence stakeholders and procurement authorities.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>An established network within the European defence ecosystem</strong>, military procurement agencies, or the NATO technology community.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Experience with tactical Battle Management Systems (BMS)</strong>, military simulation environments, or unmanned systems (UxV) operations.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><sp

title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer, Cyber Defense
description: <h2>About Nscale</h2> <p>Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.</p> <p>We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.</p> <p> </p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are hiring Detection & Response Engineers to decide what we detect, command the response when something is real, and automate everything in between, across enterprise, cloud, production, data centre, and operational technology environments.</p> <p>You will work in a three-person regional rotation. Roughly one week in three, you hold the operational slot: taking escalations, deciding fast, and acting. The other two weeks are engineering. You find where our detection coverage is thin and work with our AI agents to close it, build automation that removes human time from the response path, and make sure we are ready for the next incident. When a serious incident lands, you command it.</p> <p>If you have spent years closing the same ticket every Tuesday—and knowing exactly how to fix it for good, but never having the mandate—this is the job where that is the mandate.</p> <p> </p> <h2>What you'll be doing</h2> <h3><strong>Detection engineering</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Map our detection coverage against attacker tradecraft and the real estate, and find where we are blind.</li> <li>Turn coverage gaps, incidents, threat research, and recurring escalations into clear detection ideas, and work with our AI agents to build them.</li> <li>Assess and tune the detection ideas and rule logic our agents propose, which run as shadow rules before they go live. Judge what each one catches, what it misses, and what its noise will cost.</li> <li>Make the human call on promotion. You will rarely write a query from scratch, but nothing goes live without your judgement, and you are accountable for whether it is right.</li> <li>Retire or retune live detections that are noisy, stale, or no longer relevant.</li> <li>Identify telemetry gaps and make the business case for closing them.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Automation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Remove recurring toil from the response path: enrichment, triage, containment actions, case handling, and reporting.</li> <li>Improve the agents that hold the first tier, so they resolve more on their own and escalate with better context. Every gain here cuts the human time per alert and lets us cover more attack surface.</li> <li>Ship new capabilities in our internal security platform, such as response actions, integrations, and agent tooling, so every engineer and agent on the team gets faster, and prove each one works in production.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Incident command</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Command security incidents: set objectives, coordinate responders across engineering, infrastructure, and service owners, and keep leadership informed.</li> <li>Make containment calls under time pressure, knowing what you can do immediately, what requires authority, and what could disrupt production if handled incorrectly.</li> <li>Run post-incident reviews that end in engineering work, not just a document.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Incident preparedness</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and run tabletop exercises and recovery tests.</li> <li>Keep playbooks and runbooks honest, and turn the steps that do not need a human into automation.</li> <li>Make sure the evidence, access, knowledge, and authority we need in an incident are in place before we need them.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your operational week</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Take escalations from the agents and the managed provider, scope them against real asset and business context, decide, and act.</li> <li>Execute approved containment, including isolating devices, revoking sessions, restricting access, blocking activity, and preserving evidence.</li> <li>Ensure every escalation exits with a solve where one is warranted. Where the solve is a detection or automation, you build it with the agents. Where it is a control change, specify it clearly enough that the owning team can act without a second conversation.</li> <li>Close every case with a security disposition, an owner, the evidence, actions taken, and any required follow-up.</li> <li>Hold the managed provider to our standard for evidence, analysis, routing, and closure quality.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>First 90 days</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Learn the incident command, escalation, evidence, and handover model, and take a rotation slot.</li> <li>Independently own escalations across common classes, with defensible dispositions and evidence that stands up.</li> <li>Ship your first solve: a detection, automation, or control change that permanently retires a recurring alert class.</li> <li>Map coverage for one area of the estate, name its top gaps, and work with the agents to close at least one.</li> <li>Assess, tune, and promote your first agent-proposed detections to live.</li> <li>Add your first feature to the internal security platform.</li> <li>Shadow the incident commander on a real incident or exercise.</li> <li>Name one telemetry gap with a business case behind it. Extra credit if it is in operational technology or building management systems, both of which we currently cannot see.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>About You</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years in detection engineering, incident response, security operations, threat hunting, security engineering, or related roles.</li> <li>Detection judgement. You can read a rule and say what it catches, what it misses, and how noisy it will be in production. You think in coverage, not in individual alerts.</li> <li>Fluency in modern attacker tradecraft, including credential theft, session abuse, phishing, malware execution, persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement, command and control, and exfiltration, and in how each shows up in telemetry.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Windows, macOS, and Linux internals, including where attackers persist on each and what each one logs.</li> <li>Incident command experience. You have led, or been central to, a significant incident: running the bridge, setting priorities, and keeping leadership informed without losing the technical thread.</li> <li>Experience building in, and securing, public cloud environments like AWS and GCP</li> <li>You automate what you repeat, using query languages, scripting, APIs, or workflow automation. When you hit the same problem a third time, your instinct is to build—not add another step to a runbook.</li> <li>Hands-on investigation experience across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, network, or production workloads.</li> <li>Sound judgement on containment under time pressure.</li> <li>Willingness to challenge automated conclusions. You will work alongside AI agents every day, and their analysis and detection logic are inputs, not authorities. We expect you to validate them and notice when they are confidently wrong.</li> <li>You write investigations another engineer can follow, escalations a leader can act on in thirty seconds, and case notes that still make sense to someone reading them two years later in an audit.</li> <li>Calm and methodical when facts are incomplete or contradict each other.</li> <li>Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, and service owners who do not report to you.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Strong pluses</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Operational technology, industrial control systems, building management systems, or critical facilities experience.</li> <li>Cloud infrastructure, AI infrastructure, data centres, HPC, or other availability-sensitive environments.</li> <li>Detection-as-code, detection testing, adversary emulation, or purple teaming.</li> <li>Building, tuning, or evaluating AI agents or LLM-based security tooling.</li> <li>Response experience involving ransomware, identity compromise, destructive attacks, cloud intrusion, insider threats, or supply-chain incidents.</li> <li>Experience holding a managed monitoring or response provider to a standard while keeping decisions in-house.</li> <li>Experience working as part of a Follow-the-sun rotation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>This role may not be a fit if you:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Want a queue to work through all day. You hold it one week in three, and the job is making it smaller.</li> <li>Measure success in tickets closed.</li> <li>Close cases without a security disposition or evidence.</li> <li>Accept a vendor alert or an agent’s conclusion without validating it.</li> <li>Want to spend most of your time hand-writing detection queries. Here the agents draft the logic and you own whether it is right.</li> <li>Would rather not be the person in charge when an incident is live.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>What we can offer you</h2> <p>At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.</p> <ul> <li>Highly competitive UK compensation package (base + bonus + equity), with performance reviews every 12 months. 🚀</li> <li>Join one of the fastest-growing AI infrastructure companies — your chance to directly shape how global AI capacity is planned and deployed. ✨</li> <li>Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by leading critical cross-functional initiatives and shaping capital strategy — always with our full support.</li> <li>Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.</li> </ul> <h2>Equal Opportunities Statement</h2> <p>We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.</p> <p>If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.</p> <p>The responsibilities outlined in this job description are not exhaustive and are intended to provide a general overview of

title: Senior People & Recruiting Manager (w/m/d)
description: Hast du schon mal eine Person eingestellt und gewusst: Diese eine Entscheidung verändert die ganze Firma? Hast du schon mal erlebt, wie eine einzige falsche Besetzung ein kleines Team um Monate zurückwirft? Und hast du dir schon mal gewünscht, nicht die 30. Rolle des Jahres abzuarbeiten, sondern bei jeder Einstellung wirklich mitzugestalten, wohin ein Unternehmen wächst? Bei FINE DINE ist jede Einstellung genau das: ein Hebel. Wir sind heute 11 Leute und wachsen auf 15 bis 20. Bis 2030 wollen wir die FINE DINE Box in mehr als 100 Städte in Europa bringen. Jede Person, die du zu uns holst, entscheidet mit darüber, ob uns das gelingt. Du suchst aus, wer diesen Weg mit uns geht. Was uns wirklich ausmacht: Wir drei Founder denken seit Jahren an kaum etwas anderes als an FINE DINE. Bei uns zählt das Ergebnis, nicht wie viele Stunden jemand im Büro sitzt oder wie schön eine Präsentation aussieht. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Wege sind kurz, und du arbeitest direkt mit uns Foundern zusammen. Du arbeitest People & Culture bei uns nicht in einem bestehenden System ab. Du baust es auf. Bist du an Bord? 🎁🎟 Mit der FINE DINE® Box verbinden wir Top-Restaurants und Genießer. 🇩🇪🇨🇭 Bereits in 17 Städten in Deutschland und der Schweiz vertreten. 👨‍🍳😋 Wir vermitteln jährlich mehr als 250.000 Restaurantbesuche. 👔✍🏻 Erfolgreiche Finanzierungsrunde 2022 mit renommierten Investoren. 🏢🗞️ Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Deutschlands größten Medienhäusern (Süddeutsche Zeitung, F.A.Z. etc.). Aufgaben Recruiting Ownership: Du verantwortest das Recruiting für ca. 5 Rollen pro Jahr, strategisch und operativ. Von der Bedarfsklärung mit uns Foundern über Stellenanzeigen und strukturierte Interviews bis zum Angebot. Active Sourcing: Du findest Key-Hires per Direktansprache über LinkedIn und dein Netzwerk, in der Region Ulm und darüber hinaus. Recruiting-System: Du baust das Fundament für schnelles und nachhaltiges Recruitment auf: Pipeline, Scorecards, Interviewleitfäden und KPIs wie Time-to-Hire, Response-Rate und Conversion. Sparringspartner für die Founder: Du berätst deine Hiring Manager auf Augenhöhe und mit Daten. Employer Branding & Content: Du machst FINE DINE als Arbeitgeber sichtbar. Du baust unsere LinkedIn-Präsenz von null auf, postest regelmäßig über Team, Kultur und unseren Alltag, holst das Team mit ins Boot und schreibst Stellenanzeigen, die zeigen, wer wir wirklich sind. Onboarding & Ansprechperson: Du bist Ansprechperson für unser Team und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen schnell ankommen und ab Tag 1 produktiv sind. People Operations: Du stimmst dich mit unserem Steuerbüro und der Lohnbuchhaltung ab und bist die erste Ansprechperson für alle HR-Themen im Team. Qualifikation Recruiting-Erfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung im Recruiting mit, idealerweise in-house in einem Start-up oder Scale-up in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern oder in einer Personalberatung. Active Sourcing: Direktansprache ist dein Steckenpferd. Du schreibst Nachrichten, auf die Menschen antworten, und kennst deine Conversion-Raten von Outreach bis Hire. Lernbereitschaft: Du willst mehr als „nur“ Recruiting und hast Lust, dir neue Themen wie Employer Branding, Payroll oder Onboarding eigenständig zu erarbeiten. Eigenverantwortung & Speed: Du arbeitest schnell, hands-on und eigenverantwortlich. Du lieferst in Tagen, nicht in Wochen, und misst dich an Ergebnissen statt an Aktivitäten. Datenkompetenz & Kommunikation: Du steuerst nach Zahlen, nicht nach Bauchgefühl, und hast Zielwerte wie Time-to-Hire im Kopf. Stressresistenz: Du bleibst ruhig, wenn mehrere Prozesse und Projekte parallel laufen und ein Wunschkandidat kurzfristig absagt. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss LinkedIn & Content: Du hast erste Erfahrung mit LinkedIn-Content oder Employer Branding. Falls nicht, lernst du bei uns, wie man Content strategisch aufbaut. Branchenerfahrung: Du kennst D2C, E-Commerce oder Premium-Consumer-Brands und hast Marketing-, Sales- oder Tech-Rollen besetzt. HR-Admin: Du hattest schon Berührungspunkte mit Payroll, Arbeitsverträgen oder Onboarding-Prozessen. Aufbauerfahrung: Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich von null aufgebaut. Benefits Gehalt: 60.000 € fix + 10.000 € variabel bei klarer Zielerreichung, also 70.000 € OTE. Impact: Du übernimmst eine Schlüsselrolle in dem Bereich, der für unser Wachstum am wichtigsten ist. Team: Du arbeitest mit einem extrem ambitionierten Team und direkt mit den drei Foundern zusammen, mit echtem Entscheidungsspielraum ab Tag 1. Personal Growth: Du wächst über Recruiting hinaus in Employer Branding, People Ops und HR-Admin, mit Einarbeitung und direktem Sparring mit den Foundern. Du willst mit uns wachsen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Arbeite direkt mit unseren Gründern zusammen, treibe unser Geschäft weiter voran und komm in unser einzigartiges Team! Wir freuen uns über deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Nachricht, in der du beschreibst, warum du Lust auf den Job hast. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems
description: VisionSpace is a dynamic consulting, technology and engineering company delivering solutions and services for the Space and Defence sectors. We work across satellite operations, ground data systems, ground stations, automation, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. Our motto is Space and Beyond is Our Playground . We empower our customers to shape the future of satellite operations by bringing automation and intelligence into operational systems. About the Role We are looking for a Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems Engineer to join our team supporting activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, Germany . The position will support the CGSS project , an established operational project responsible for an application used to generate ground station pass schedules for EUMETSAT missions . The successful candidate will contribute to the development, maintenance, verification and evolution of the application and will work closely with engineers, operational teams and end users. This is a great opportunity for a professionals in applying their technical skills to operational satellite ground systems and mission planning. What You'll Be Doing Your responsibilities will include: Contributing to the development, maintenance and evolution of the CGSS application . Developing and maintaining software components, with a particular focus on Python-based development . Supporting the development and maintenance of web-based applications and interfaces . Analysing software requirements and translating operational needs into technical solutions. Performing software Verification & Validation (V&V) activities. Preparing and executing functional, integration, regression and acceptance tests. Investigating and troubleshooting software anomalies and supporting their resolution. Supporting the integration and deployment of software releases. Contributing to technical and user documentation. Working directly with end users and operational stakeholders to understand requirements, collect feedback and support effective use of the system. Contributing to the reliability and maintainability of software used within an operational space environment. Working closely with other engineering teams involved in mission planning, ground station systems and satellite operations. What We Look For You do not need to fulfil every requirement below . We are looking for candidates who combine several of these skills and are motivated to develop further within the space operations domain. Technical Experience Ideally, you will bring experience in several of the following areas: Software engineering and the software development lifecycle. Python development . Development of web-based applications . Software Verification & Validation , testing and quality assurance. Requirements analysis and software documentation. Version control and collaborative development environments, preferably using tools such as Git/GitLab . CI/CD, automated testing or software deployment processes. Linux-based development or operational environments. Space Domain Experience Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following would be highly desirable: Satellite or spacecraft operations . Mission Planning Systems or scheduling applications. Ground segment software and operational systems. Ground Station Monitoring and Control systems . Ground station scheduling, pass planning or contact planning. Integration of mission planning applications with other mission control or ground segment systems. Working with operational teams or end users in a mission-critical environment. Previous experience with EUMETSAT, ESA or comparable European space programmes would be an advantage, but is not mandatory . Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering , or another relevant technical discipline. Relevant professional experience in a similar role is a plus. Personal Skills We're looking for someone who: Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Enjoys working directly with technical and operational end users. Can communicate effectively with both software engineers and operational stakeholders. Takes a structured and reliable approach to development, testing and troubleshooting. Can work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary team. Is curious and willing to learn about mission planning and satellite ground operations. Has good attention to detail, particularly when working with operational software and verification activities. Has English language proficiency at C1 level or above, both written and spoken. Additional Requirements Candidates must have the right to work in the European Union . The role is expected to support activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt , so candidates should be willing and able to work from Darmstadt according to the operational needs of the service. Availability to start as early as possible in 2027 , ideally during the first quarter of the year and preferably no later than April 2027 . Ready to join us? If you are passionate about software engineering and would like to apply your skills to real-world satellite operations, we'd love to hear from you . Even if you don't tick every box, we encourage you to apply. A strong background in several of the areas above, combined with the willingness to learn, may be exactly what we're looking for. Apply today! VisionSpace Technologies is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status. title: Growth Marketing Manager (m/w/d)

Editorial Ownership übernehmen: Steuere AI-Workflows mit kritischem Denken, hohem Qualitätsanspruch sowie prägnantem & zielgenauem Output. Creator-Kooperationen, Videoprojekte: Identifiziere passende B2B-Creator und YouTuber, sprich sie direkt an, verhandle Kooperationen & begleite sie bis zum Livegang. Vor die Kamera treten: Entwickle spannenden Video-Content und Interviews und sei gerne, auch selbst vor der Kamera dabei. Cross-Channel-Projekte steuern: Organisiere eigenständig Marketingkampagnen und Kundeninitiativen/- cases Daten & Tools nutzen: Bewerte unsere AI Visibility mit Tools wie Rankscale, teste neue Ansätze und identifiziere zusätzliche Wachstumspotenziale. Was du mitbringst (Qualifikationen) Berufserfahrung & Skills 3+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in Marketing, Growth Marketing, Content-Marketing, PR oder Communications mit. Outreach-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits mit PR-Pitches, Publisher-Partnerschaften oder Creator-Kooperationen gearbeitet. GEO-Verständnis: Du kennst die Grundlagen von GEO und verstehst, wie AI-Suchmaschinen Informationen finden und als Quellen nutzen. Tools & Analytics: Du bist mit Visibility-Metriken und den gängigen Analyse-Tools vertraut oder motiviert, dich hier einzuarbeiten und dein Wissen kontinuierlich zu vertiefen. Auch der Umgang mit Content-Management-Systemen gehört für dich zum Arbeitsalltag. KI-Affinität: Du begeisterst dich für künstliche Intelligenz und setzt sie gerne täglich ein, um schneller zu besseren Ergebnissen zu kommen. Sprachen: Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und fließendes Business-Englisch . Mindset & Arbeitsweise Proaktive Kommunikation: Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, bringst Ideen ein und baust aktiv Beziehungen zu internen und externen Partnern auf. Konstruktives Hinterfragen: Du prüfst KI-Ergebnisse/-Output kritisch, gehst Themen auf den Grund und zeichnest dich durch Wissbegierde sowie einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch aus. Datenorientiertes Mindset: Du übersetzt Daten in konkrete Maßnahmen, testest Hypothesen schnell und lässt die Ergebnisse in deine nächsten Schritte einfließen. Positive Teameinstellung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, bringst Leidenschaft für deine Themen mit und unterstützt dein Team. Warum Crewmeister Werde Teil eines dynamischen Teams mit Fokus auf persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Genieß ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit flexiblem Zeitplan, das Homeoffice und regelmäßige Bürotage in München kombiniert. Arbeite in einem modernen Büro im Werksviertel Start-Up-Hub mit hauseigenem Barista. Coole Teamaktivitäten und Events und die Möglichkeit, an Yogakursen, Fußball Championships, u.v.m. teilzunehmen Benefits wie: Essensgutscheine, JobRad, Fitnessstudio-Rabatte, Freikarten, MacBook, vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket Unterstützung beim Visum, falls erforderlich Bei uns erhältst du nicht nur die Sicherheit eines finanzstarken Konzerns, sondern auch die Unternehmenskultur und Aufstiegschancen eines Start-ups. Du denkst Content weiter und willst echten Impact erzielen? Hilf uns Crewmeister noch sichtbarer zu machen - mit deinen Ideen, deinem Gespür für relevante Inhalte und deiner Umsetzungsstärke. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Hier geht es nicht nur um den Job, sondern um dich und dein Potenzial. title: Directeur de magasin H/F
description: Piloter notre agence à Marseille Nous recrutons un directeur de magasin H/F pour assurer la gestion de notre magasin à Marseille. Vous veillez à placer la satisfaction client au cœur de notre action en garantissant un service de qualité. Vos missions au quotidien Manager l'équipe du magasin au quotidien (4 personnes) et accompagner le développement des compétences. Piloter les indicateurs de performance et assurer la rentabilité de la structure. Garantir la qualité de service et la relation client auprès de notre clientèle. Capacité démontrée à fédérer autour des objectifs de service et de performance. Connaissance du secteur de la distribution appréciée. Expérience préalable en retail spécialisé ou au sein d'enseignes telles que Maxi Zoo ou Truffaut. Management de la qualité de service. Expérience en animalerie. Maîtrise de la planification des stocks et de la rotation des stocks. Compétences en merchandising. Vous structurez le suivi des activités et commencez à coordonner les projets de service pour nos clients. title: Animateur réseaux magasins (H/F)
description: Le Groupe Cybertek est un acteur majeur dans le secteur de la vente de matériel informatique et High-Tech en France. Créé en 1996, son siège social et ses plateformes logistiques se trouvent à Bordeaux. Cybertek possède 28 magasins sous les enseignes Cybertek et Grosbill, ainsi que cinq sites de commerce en ligne. Employant 270 personnes, Cybertek a réussi à atteindre un chiffre d'affaires annuel de plus de 100 millions d'euros en s’appuyant sur des équipes dynamiques et soudées. Le Groupe Cybertek affirme son engagement en faveur de l’égalité professionnelle entre les femmes et les hommes et veille à promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif, notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap. Vos missions Au cœur de nos magasins répartis sur toute la France lors de vos déplacements quotidiens, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans leur bon fonctionnement, l’accompagnement des équipes et le développement du chiffre d’affaires. Réaliser le suivi des magasins définis : Vérifier et contribuer à la mise en place d’une organisation permettant d’assurer le bon fonctionnement du point de vente (application et respect des procédures internes) ; Veiller et participer à l’amélioration de l’image de marque du point de vente (présentation, ponctualité, propreté, accueil des clients, accueil téléphonique, rappel des clients, relationnel, etc.) ; Contrôler les points de vente (stocks, activités réalisées au sein du point de vente, horaires d’ouverture) ; Contrôler et analyser l’activité commerciale du magasin (devis, commandes, factures, chiffre d’affaires, résultats, objectifs) ; Motiver, accompagner et soutenir les équipes ainsi que le Responsable dans le développement du chiffre d’affaires du point de vente ; Assurer un soutien des équipes par une présence régulière dans chaque point de vente ; Assurer les remplacements en magasin si nécessaires ; Réaliser un entretien mensuel avec chaque Responsable afin d’évaluer l’avancement des objectifs, d’identifier les éventuelles difficultés et de prendre les décisions nécessaires en conséquence ; Suivi des interventions et coordination avec la Direction : Réaliser un rapport sur chaque passage et contrôle d’un point de vente Analyser les données ; Assurer un point régulier avec la Direction au cours d’entretiens ponctuels, par téléphone plusieurs fois par semaine ; Organiser une réunion tous les quinze jours afin de réaliser un point détaillé sur chaque point de vente et de définir les futures interventions ; Réaliser une réunion mensuelle avec la Direction afin de produire un bilan du mois écoulé et de définir les objectifs du mois suivant ; Animer une réunion mensuelle avec les différents services du siège social du Groupe Cybertek en lien avec les magasins, afin d’identifier les difficultés rencontrées et d’améliorer la communication et la coordination entre les différents services (SAV, Technique, Stock, Administratif, etc.) ; L’animation commerciale : Animer les magasins et organiser les journées portes ouvertes (salons, partenariats, etc.) ; Assurer le facing des magasins et veiller à la bonne présentation de l’offre produit et des produits en démonstration ;Assurer le suivi et le reporting des incentives et des différentes opérations commerciales. Vos compétences Vous justifiez d’une expérience dans le suivi et le contrôle de points de vente, idéalement dans le secteur de l’informatique ou de l’high-tech. Rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse des performances commerciales, le suivi des stocks et le contrôle du respect des procédures. Vous savez accompagner et soutenir les équipes et les Responsables de magasin dans l’atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en identifiant les éventuels axes d’amélioration. Autonome, réactif(ve) et force de proposition, vous appréciez le travail de terrain, les déplacements et les échanges avec les différents services. Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et contribuer activement à la performance et au bon fonctionnement de nos points de vente ? Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que Contrôleur(se) Magasins ! Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Directeur Exploitation Datacenters – Infrastructures Critiques (H/F)
description: Head of DC Operations (H/F) Région parisienne Votre mission Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne. Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance. Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes. Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service. Important – Nature du profil recherché Nous recherchons un/e professionnel/le de l'exploitation technique de datacenters ( Data Center Operations / Critical Facilities ), et non un Directeur des Systèmes d'Information ou un Directeur des infrastructures IT. Une expérience concrète du pilotage opérationnel des infrastructures physiques critiques est indispensable : installations électriques (HT/BT), UPS, groupes électrogènes, systèmes de refroidissement (CVC), maintenance préventive et corrective, gestion des incidents et continuité de service. Les profils exclusivement orientés IT, systèmes, réseaux, cloud, hébergement ou gestion de projets informatiques ne correspondent pas au périmètre du poste. Vos responsabilités Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires. Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites. Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures. Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives. Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques. Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences. Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action. Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes. Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge. Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites. Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise. Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques. Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité. Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques. Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires. Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives. Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service. Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients. Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients. Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires. Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations. Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires. Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre. Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients. Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables. Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes. Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation. Votre profil Formation et expérience Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide. Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques. Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable. Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité. Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles. Compétences techniques Bonne maîtrise des enjeux d'exploitation des data centers et compréhension des architectures électriques, mécaniques, CVC, de protection incendie, de GTB/BMS et des systèmes de contrôle. Maîtrise du pilotage de la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire. Connaissance des SLA, KPI de disponibilité, capacité, qualité de service et performance énergétique. Capacité à analyser et challenger les risques techniques, les plans de maintenance et les investissements. Maîtrise des enjeux budgétaires OPEX/CAPEX et des exigences réglementaires applicables. Qualités personnelles Leadership et capacité à manager des responsables expérimentés. Crédibilité technique et sens des responsabilités. Capacité à structurer une organisation, harmoniser les pratiques et conduire le changement. Aptitude à fédérer les équipes et à développer la coopération transverse. Capacité de décision, d'arbitrage et de priorisation. Sang-froid en situation de crise, rigueur et orientation résultats. Sens du client et capacité à construire des relations de partenariat durables. Langues : français courant et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Les enjeux de réussite Au cours des premiers mois, vous aurez notamment pour objectifs de construire une feuille de route opérationnelle claire, de consolider le pilotage par les indicateurs, de hiérarchiser les risques et de définir les moyens nécessaires à leur traitement. Vous contribuerez également à renforcer la cohésion managériale, à harmoniser les pratiques entre les sites et à accompagner l'évolution de l'organisation dans une logique durable de performance et d'amélioration continue. Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise des infrastructures critiques au service d'un environnement exigeant, avec une forte dimension managériale, stratégique et transverse ? title: Telecom security trainer
description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces. Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub). Job Description Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide. Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies. This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning. Responsibilities Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives. Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team. Adapt existing online curriculum, presentations, exercises, and lab materials for engaging live classroom delivery. Explain signaling flows, trust boundaries, protocol vulnerabilities, attack scenarios, and defensive controls clearly and accurately. Facilitate hands-on exercises in authorized, controlled lab environments and help participants troubleshoot technical issues. Answer participant questions on telecom security, including detection, mitigation, and operational defense strategies. Check participants’ understanding through practical exercises, discussion, and knowledge checks. Coordinate classroom and lab readiness with P1 Security and the client before delivery. Gather participant feedback and share recommendations to improve course content and delivery. Respect client confidentiality, intellectual property, and agreed rules of engagement throughout each mission. Required qualifications Deep telecom security expertise in one or more of the following domains: SS7 / SIGTRAN: MAP/CAP signaling, common abuse scenarios, and signaling security controls. Related course: TS-201 — 2G, 3G and SS7 Mobile Network Security. LTE / Diameter: S6a, Gx, and Gy interfaces, protocol vulnerabilities, and defensive measures. Related course: TS-401 — LTE Security and Insecurity. GTP-C: Versions 1 and 2, control-plane procedures, security risks, and mitigation strategies. Related training tracks: TS-201 — 2G/3G and TS-401 — LTE / EPC, depending on the mission scope. IMS / SIP: Signaling fundamentals, protocol weaknesses, and protection mechanisms. Related course: TS-250 — IMS Security. 5G: Service-based architecture (SBA), HTTP/2 and JSON-based APIs, and interconnect security involving N32 and the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP). Related course: TS-501 — 5G Telecom Security hands-on course. You do not need to cover every domain to apply. Specialists in one or several domains are welcome. Missions will be matched to your demonstrated expertise; please indicate the courses and topics you are confident teaching independently. Proven experience delivering technical training, workshops, or hands-on instruction to engineering or SOC teams. Ability to explain complex technical concepts, manage classroom discussion, and adapt to mixed levels of experience. Practical experience analyzing telecom signaling traces and using packet-analysis tools such as Wireshark. Confidence working with Linux-based lab environments and troubleshooting connectivity or exercise issues. Professional preparation, reliable delivery, and clear communication with clients and the P1 Security team. Willingness and ability to travel internationally for short-term onsite engagements: typically around five days per mission including travel, with some engagements requiring up to two weeks onsite. Preferred qualifications Experience in telecom security consulting, penetration testing, incident response, signaling monitoring, or mobile core network operations. Familiarity with 3GPP security specifications and relevant GSMA signaling security guidance. Experience with signaling firewalls, roaming and interconnect security, or telecom threat detection. Experience adapting digital learning content into instructor-led courses and practical exercises. Familiarity with virtualized or containerized lab environments and scripting for lab preparation. Experience teaching international audiences or working across different cultural and organizational contexts. Language requirements Fluent professional English, with the ability to deliver technical instruction and facilitate discussions. Additional languages are a plus, including French. Engagement details Contract type: Freelance, on a per-mission basis. Delivery location: Onsite at client locations worldwide. Mission duration: Typically around five days including travel; some engagements may require up to two weeks onsite. Headquarters: Paris, France. Training materials: Established curriculum and lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform, adapted for each classroom engagement. Commercial arrangements: Scope, preparation time, delivery dates, fees, and travel and accommodation arrangements to be agreed for each mission. Hiring process First contact call (10-20min) Direct manager call (30min) Capability assessment exercice (depending on position) C-level & Director call (30 min) Contact If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field. To apply, please send your CV or professional profile and a short introduction highlighting your telecom security expertise and training experience. Include the protocols and courses you can teach, examples of previous workshops or audiences, your availability, your location and travel flexibility, and your indicative daily rate. Please do not include confidential client information. Website - www.P1sec.com Linkedin - https://www.linkedin.com/company/p1security/?originalSubdomain=fr Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Technicien essais R&D
description: Rejoignez une entreprise à la pointe de l'innovation ! Eco-Tech Ceram conçoit, finance et met en œuvre des solutions de décarbonation de la chaleur industrielle : valorisation de la chaleur fatale, électrification des procédés (Power-to-Heat) et stockage thermique. Nos technologies : l’ Eco-Stock® (stockage thermique haute température), l’E-Burner® (générateur d'air chaud électrique), l’E-Boiler (chaudière électrique) et échangeurs de récupération — fournissent aux industriels une chaleur propre et compétitive, sous forme d'air chaud, d'eau chaude ou de vapeur. Collecter, exploiter et analyser les résultats d’essais, puis contribuer à leur restitution afin de soutenir les activités de développement et d’amélioration des solutions. Participer à l’amélioration continue des équipements, prototypes et bancs d’essais à partir des retours d’expérience terrain. Veiller au respect des règles de sécurité et des procédures lors des interventions, expérimentations et déplacements sur sites industriels. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes R&D, bureau d'études et partenaires externes pour garantir l'avancement des projets et la fiabilité des essais. title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
description: THE POSITION ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory. This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented. Missions : Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge). Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods. Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup. Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods. You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team. Location: Toulouse (city centre) Start: As soon as possible Duration: 6 months Profile Bac+5 - Engineering school / Master in applied mathematics, signal and image processing, machine learning and/or electromagnetics Programming skills (preferably Python), experience with a deep learning framework Knowledge of inverse problems or infrared cameras is a plus Team spirit, proactive attitude and good communication skills in an interdisciplinary team Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
