title: Chief Customer Officer
description: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank. We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job. We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow. We are committed to changing the way things are done. Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position Work from anywhere! Position overview Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible. The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would. You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved. Win the right members, efficiently. You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances. Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless. You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay. Build one Customer organisation, not four. Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call. You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations. How you'll operate This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here. You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them. You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title. You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach. You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger. You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom. What you'll have done 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime). Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either. Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC. Growth and lifecycle: a track record of acquiring, activating, and retaining members in a regulated, KYC-heavy environment, improving approved-to-paid and churn while holding CAC to a level that LTV justifies, not just growth-hacking a free consumer app. Banking-grade product leadership: you have led product management for balance-sheet products such as savings, lending, or structured products, priced with Finance, with PMs who own a product's economics rather than a backlog. Experience with client coverage or relationship-managed models for high-balance and institutional clients is a strong advantage. Commercial and risk fluency: you can build a customer business case that survives scrutiny from Finance, Risk, and Compliance in the same meeting, and you know the difference between growth that's sustainable and growth that's borrowed from tomorrow's risk appetite. A track record of outcomes you can narrate: specific LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, AUM, or contribution numbers you owned, bets you killed when the data didn't support them, and outcomes you can prove. The first 90 days Day 30: The Customer P&L baseline is documented across retail and institutional: customer contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, net paid-member growth, and assets attracted and kept. You have formed your own independent view of where members are won, lost, and under-served, and shared it with the CEO and Board. Day 60: The unified Customer operating model is live: one set of key results across Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design, read weekly from one source. Every mission PM owns a product's contribution and its price, and the roadmap is ranked on what it earns, built with Finance and the line leads. Day 90: At least one measurable improvement in LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, churn, or net new AUM flow is live and attributable to a change you made, not a feature ship, an outcome moved. Every cell in your line has defined key results and an owner who explains the number every week. What this role is not Not a requirements-gathering role. Mission PMs are bankers who own a product's contribution and price, not a backlog. You partner with Technology, Finance, and Operations on execution; you don't run those functions. Not a volume role. If your primary output is card spend, transfer volume, or a shipped list rather than assets held and the margin they earn, we have both failed. Not a reporting layer. If your primary output is a customer-insight deck or a roadmap deck, we have both failed. Not a role that can be done from a distance. Remote-first means distributed, not detached. Other requirements A dedicated workspace. A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area. Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles. Why work for Xapo? Impact Globally, Work Remotely. Shape the Future Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world. Great work-life balance Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge. Expect Excellence Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you'll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals. title: Chef de Projet développement commercial et partenariats
description: Vous savez décrocher votre téléphone et ouvrir une porte fermée, sans introduction, sans lead, sans filet ? Vous préférez construire un marché à partir de zéro plutôt qu'hériter d'un portefeuille tout fait ? Vous voulez que votre rémunération reflète exactement ce que vous décrochez, sans plafond ? Si vous avez répondu oui aux trois questions, ce poste est fait pour vous. Lisez ce qui suit. QUI SOMMES NOUS KT Groupe a construit son succès sur un marché : le fitness. Salles de sport premium, clubs, franchises. Ce marché fonctionne, et il continue de croître. Aujourd'hui, la direction ouvre un second moteur de croissance : l'hôtellerie, les résidences de tourisme, les spas, les centres wellness et le sport en entreprise. Un marché sur lequel KT Groupe possède déjà le savoir-faire technique, mais pas encore la présence commerciale. C'est précisément là que vous entrez en jeu. LE POSTE EN UNE PHRASE Vous ne reprenez pas un portefeuille : vous le construisez. Ce n'est pas un poste de gestion, c'est un poste de conquête. Vous allez chercher les projets, vous construisez le réseau de prescription (architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, bureaux d'études, équipementiers, groupes et franchises), et vous conduisez le cycle de vente de la qualification jusqu'à la signature. Vous êtes rattaché à la direction du développement commercial, et vous travaillez au quotidien avec la direction générale, la direction technique et le pôle fitness — votre homologue, sans lien hiérarchique. Vos missions Créer et développer le marché du pôle Construire la cartographie du marché : groupes hôteliers, chaînes, hôtels indépendants haut de gamme, résidences de tourisme, spas, centres wellness, entreprises souhaitant équiper leurs locaux. Identifier les décideurs réels : direction générale, direction technique, direction des opérations, asset managers, responsables de l'expérience client. Aller chercher les projets par prospection directe, LinkedIn, réseau personnel, salons et recommandations. Contribuer à la construction de l'offre du pôle : arguments, références, cas d'usage. Développer les partenariats et la prescription — le levier le plus puissant du poste Identifier, approcher et signer des partenariats avec les prescripteurs du marché : architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, bureaux d'études, équipementiers wellness et spa, groupes et franchises. Construire des accords donnant-donnant, où KT Groupe apporte des marchés à ses partenaires et réciproquement. Faire référencer KT Groupe comme constructeur et aménageur auprès des partenaires. Entretenir la relation dans la durée : un partenariat signé et non animé ne produit rien. Conduire le cycle de vente de bout en bout Qualifier les demandes entrantes et les opportunités sortantes, mener la découverte, préparer les briefs de chiffrage pour la direction technique. Présenter la proposition, négocier et signer. Rester l'interlocuteur unique du premier contact jusqu'à la signature — un principe de maison chez KT Groupe. Préparer et exploiter les salons Constituer en amont le pipeline de rendez-vous du salon Meeting Hôtellerie de mars 2027. Assurer un suivi post-salon aussi rigoureux que la préparation. Tenir la rigueur commerciale Tenir le CRM à jour, réagir vite aux demandes entrantes, participer à la réunion commerciale hebdomadaire. Documenter vos process au fur et à mesure, pour permettre la délégation future. Vos compétences Nous n'attendons pas un CV type. Trois chemins peuvent mener à ce poste, et nous arbitrerons en fonction des candidatures reçues : Confirmé du secteur — hôtellerie, spa, wellness, équipement hôtelier, agencement d'hôtels. Vous apportez un carnet d'adresses immédiatement activable. Confirmé B2B, autre secteur — vente de projets à panier élevé (BTP, agencement, mobilier professionnel, équipement, retail, énergie). Vous apportez une méthode de vente éprouvée sur cycle long et une culture du chiffre. Junior à fort potentiel — deux à trois ans d'expérience commerciale, forte envie, pas encore le réseau. Vous apportez de l'énergie et une capacité à vous former sans habitudes à défaire. Le socle commun, non négociable Vente B2B de projets à cycle long et à panier élevé, à partir de 150 000 €. Capacité à ouvrir un compte à froid, sans lead entrant et sans introduction. Aptitude à lire un besoin d'aménagement, comprendre un plan et dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs techniques. Rigueur dans la tenue d'un CRM et dans le suivi des engagements pris. Qualité de l'écrit professionnel : une proposition mal écrite décrédibilise un projet à 200 000 €. Anglais professionnel apprécié ; permis B et disponibilité pour des déplacements réguliers. Votre savoir-être Le goût de la chasse : vous ne dépendez pas des leads qu'on vous donne. Une posture de conseil : vous aidez un investisseur à réussir un projet, vous ne vendez pas des travaux. De l'exigence et de la fiabilité : ce que vous annoncez, vous le tenez. De la tenue dans la durée : un cycle de vente de 3 à 4 mois demande de la constance. Une ambition assumée : la part variable est déplafonnée, elle est faite pour ceux qui veulent aller la chercher. Avantages Une rémunération pensée pour la performance Le principe est simple et assumé : un fixe qui sécurise, un variable sans plafond qui récompense la performance réelle. Un fixe mensuel selon expérience et valeur apportée. Une prime versée à la signature de chaque projet de construction ou de rénovation, proportionnelle et non plafonnée. Une prime à la signature d'un partenariat structurant, franchise ou groupe. Une commission sur les marchés que vous apportez, selon les règles en vigueur dans l'entreprise. Le fixe couvre vos besoins. Le variable, lui, n'a pas de plafond : une personne performante gagne significativement plus que son fixe. Des moyens et un vrai accompagnement Ordinateur, téléphone, accès CRM, outils de prospection, budget de déplacement, participation aux salons professionnels. Une formation interne : méthode commerciale propriétaire, formation à l'équipement sportif et à l'agencement par le pôle fitness, immersion chantier. Un plan d'intégration structuré sur 90 jours (immersion, structuration, transformation, pilotage), avec des points de situation réguliers avec la direction. Une évolution possible vers responsable du développement du pôle, dès lors qu'une équipe se constitue sous votre responsabilité. Notre état d'esprit Chez KT Groupe, la transparence n'est pas affichée, elle est pratiquée : on dit les choses, y compris quand elles sont difficiles, les chiffres sont partagés. On ne compte pas ses efforts quand un projet est en jeu — et on ne compte pas non plus la reconnaissance. Le niveau d'exigence est élevé sur la qualité livrée, chacun assume ses sujets jusqu'au bout, les décisions se prennent vite. On va sur les chantiers, on voit les sites, on rencontre les clients : rien ne se décide uniquement depuis un bureau. Ce poste n'est pas un poste confortable. Le marché est entièrement à créer, et le premier semestre demande une vraie tolérance à l'incertitude : pas de portefeuille, pas de leads fournis, un rythme de montée en puissance qui dépend largement de vous. Pendant la phase de démarrage du pôle, vous apporterez aussi un renfort ponctuel et cadré dans le temps sur la qualification téléphonique des demandes entrantes du pôle fitness — sans que cela remette en cause votre responsabilité pleine sur votre propre pôle. Si vous cherchez la sécurité d'un portefeuille existant, ce poste n'est pas pour vous. Si vous voulez construire quelque chose et être payé à la hauteur de ce que vous construisez, la suite est pour vous. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Our Seniors typically have at least 6 years’ commercial experience.</li> <li>Practical experience and knowledge of developing real-world solutions.</li> <li>Practical experience of delivering in an agile environment.</li> <li>Strong experience managing and automating cloud-based infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li> <li>Proficiency in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools, ideally Kubernetes (K8s).</li> <li>Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions or Jenkins.</li> <li>Scripting and automation expertise, preferably with Python.</li> <li>Experience with observability tools and monitoring frameworks for system performance optimization.</li> <li>Solid understanding of security best practices across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and microservices.</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in English.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Benefits & Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Annual Company Bonus -</strong> We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.</li> <li><strong>Paid Time Off Package -</strong> We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.</li> <li><strong>Remote Working Allowance -</strong> Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.</li> <li><strong>Training and Development Allowance -</strong> Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare -</strong> It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.</li> <li><strong>Pension & Insurances -</strong> We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Interview Process</strong></p> <p><strong>Talent Call</strong> (30 mins via Zoom)<br>An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Technical Assessment</strong> (1 hour via Zoom)<br>A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your DevOps engineering expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Hiring Manager Interview</strong> (45 mins via Zoom)<br>A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.</p> <p><em>There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project</em></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Ready to Join Us?</strong></h3> <p>If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.</p> <p><br><br><em>Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence. </em></p> <p><em>If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.  </em></p> <p><br><br><br><br><br><br><br></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer - Databases SRE | UK | Remote
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p>This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.</p> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>Grafana Cloud runs Mimir, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope as multi-tenant SaaS databases across AWS, GCP and Azure in regions worldwide. Our highest-SLA customers depend on them to run their businesses. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to keep these systems reliable at scale.</p> <p>The role combines building and operating. You’ll write the software, automation and product changes that make our databases more reliable, including changes to the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases where reliability calls for it. You’ll also be on call for our highest-SLA customers and handle the operational work that comes with it. You’ll bring a production mindset to product engineering and engineering rigor to reliability, and you’ll set technical direction across squads.</p> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build reliability into the product.</strong> Write production code in our services, tooling and the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases that makes our databases more resilient, self-healing and scalable as demand grows quickly.</li> <li><strong>Build automation and platform tooling</strong> that removes toil and scales our reliability practices across regions and cloud providers.</li> <li><strong>Lead technical design.</strong> Author design docs, review others’ designs and PRs, and shape feature design so it’s scalable and operable from day one.</li> <li><strong>Own the SLO framework.</strong> Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models. Use SLO burn and incident learnings to find and fix the causes of failure in the systems themselves.</li> <li><strong>Improve observability and alerting</strong> so we find problems before customers do, and so escalations are actionable rather than noisy.</li> <li><strong>Be on call for our highest-SLA customers.</strong> Act as a technical escalation point for complex customer environments. Lead customer-impacting incident response, including customer bridge calls when needed, and write blameless post-incident reviews that lead to engineering fixes.</li> <li><strong>Handle the operational work that comes from on-call.</strong> This includes investigating customer escalations, following up on incident actions, tuning capacity and configuration, and turning recurring issues into permanent fixes or automation.</li> <li><strong>Multiply the team.</strong> Mentor engineers, teach reliability practices that teams adopt early in development, and work with engineering leadership on roadmaps and product strategy.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <h3><strong>On-Call</strong></h3> <p>Weekday on-call is 12-hour shifts, Monday to Friday, split between North America and Europe so you cover your local working hours. Weekends are covered by a separate 24-hour rotation. You’ll take a weekend roughly once every six to eight weeks.</p> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and owning distributed systems in production.</li> <li>Strong production software skills, ideally in at least one object-oriented language. You write clean, tested code and can make targeted changes in large open-source codebases you didn’t write.</li> <li>Deep understanding of distributed systems: performance, scaling and failure modes. You can reason about how a system will break before it does.</li> <li>Experience running multi-tenant systems at scale on Kubernetes in AWS, GCP or Azure, with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Helm or Jsonnet.</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and implementing SLOs.</li> <li>Experience being on call for production systems. You troubleshoot calmly and methodically under pressure, and you’ve taken part in blameless incident response and written high-quality post-incident reviews.</li> <li>Staff-level technical leadership: driving cross-team projects, setting technical direction and making the engineers around you better.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Linux internals, networking and cloud storage.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, Prometheus or other observability and time-series databases.</li> <li>Open-source contributions.</li> <li>Customer reliability engineering (CRE) or customer-facing escalation experience.</li> </ul> <p>In the UK, the Base compensation range for this role is £103,958 - £124,750.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed <a class="c-link" href="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs" data-sk="tooltip_parent">here</a>.<span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-Remote</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-Remote</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture - </strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. </li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> <div><em>For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our <a href="https://grafana.com/legal/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>. </em></div> <div> </div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations.</li> <li><strong>Elite Executive Communication:</strong> Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate and Co-elevate:</strong> Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications </strong></h3> <ul> <li>Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on AI Prototyping:</strong> Interacting title: User Researcher
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary Dust is hiring a User Researcher to be the connective tissue between our users and the teams building for them. This is a high-leverage, embedded research role — your work will directly shape product decisions, inform GTM positioning, and surface the insights that help us serve customers like Datadog, 1Password, and Cursor at a higher level. You'll be the first dedicated researcher on the team, which means you'll build the function from the ground up, sitting close to the people shipping the product every day. What you'll do Build and own the research function Define the research practice at Dust: methodologies, tooling, cadences, and documentation standards Establish a consistent feedback loop between qualitative insights and product and GTM decisions Create reusable research assets and templates the whole team can leverage Run end-to-end research studies Design and execute qualitative and quantitative studies — interviews, usability tests, concept tests, and surveys Identify the highest-leverage research questions and prioritise ruthlessly against the roadmap Deliver findings in formats that drive action, not just documentation Partner with Product and Design Embed into product and design workflows so research informs decisions before they're made, not after Participate in roadmap discussions as a consistent, evidence-based voice for the user Challenge assumptions with data when it matters — and when it's uncomfortable Support GTM and customer understanding Partner with Sales and Customer Success to surface patterns across customer conversations Help position Dust's value more precisely by understanding how users actually describe their problems and outcomes Contribute to ICP definition and segmentation work grounded in primary research Scale your impact with AI Integrate AI-assisted research tools into your practice to move faster and cover more ground Build systems that allow the team to self-serve research insights without requiring your direct involvement every time Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. Aptitude Strong mixed-methods research skills — you know when to go qualitative, when to go quantitative, and how to triangulate both into a clear point of view Experience running and synthesising user interviews at pace without sacrificing rigour or clarity Ability to translate complex user insights into decision-driving narratives that land with engineers, PMs, and founders alike Track record of research directly influencing product or business decisions — not just documentation that gets filed and forgotten Actively integrates AI tools to increase research velocity and coverage, treating it as a core part of how you work Attitude Genuinely user-obsessed — you bring the user into conversations that aren't explicitly about research Direct communicator who surfaces uncomfortable findings without softening them out of usefulness Low-ego and collaborative — equally comfortable partnering with an AE on a sales call as running a structured usability study Energised by ambiguity and the challenge of building from scratch in a lean environment without a playbook Makes the people around them sharper by actively sharing what they're learning Agency Identifies the most important research questions without waiting to be briefed — you see what's missing and move on it Owns projects end-to-end: from framing the question to delivering the insight to following up on whether it changed anything Builds research infrastructure that creates leverage for others, not just one-off outputs for yourself Comfortable making judgment calls about when research is the right investment and when it isn't Has expanded scope in past roles by solving problems no one assigned them Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager - Zero-Day Protection
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Remote within: US, Canada, UK, Portugal<br><br>About the role</h3> <p>New vulnerabilities can be exploited soon after public disclosure, leaving application owners little time to patch. Cloudflare can drastically reduce this exposure through managed WAF protections, ad-hoc emergency policies, and tools that help customers identify affected applications and remediate them.</p> <p>As Senior Product Manager for Zero-Day Protection, your goal is to help protect more than 20% of the Internet from HTTP-exploitable vulnerabilities and attacks. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer experience for Cloudflare’s zero-day protection products, beginning with WAF Managed Rules. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software.</p> <h1>Responsibilities</h1> <h2>Product strategy and roadmap</h2> <ul> <li>Own the strategy and roadmap for WAF Managed Rules and Cloudflare’s broader zero-day protection experience.</li> <li>Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software.</li> <li>Define how Managed Rules integrates with code scanning and exposure discovery to help customers identify applications affected by newly disclosed vulnerabilities.</li> <li>Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products.</li> <li>Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment.</li> <li>Partner with the Cloudflare Security Research team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Security provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context.</li> <li>Partner with Security, Legal, and external researchers during coordinated disclosure processes to prepare customer protections and communications.</li> <li>Discover and prioritize Enterprise operational needs with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Customer experience</h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end customer journey: identifying affected applications, discovering protections, deploying them safely, testing before enforcement, reviewing security events, investigating incidents, configuring exceptions and confirming remediation</li> <li>Ensure customers can understand what protections they have, what events mean, and what action to take.</li> <li>Establish feedback loops with Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and customers. Turn recurring friction and unmet needs into product priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>Operations and communications</h2> <ul> <li>Support the Cloudflare Security Research team’s vulnerability-response work by providing product context and customer perspective</li> <li>Coordinate responsible disclosure and external vulnerability communications with Security, Legal, and Communications</li> <li>Write technical posts, customer guidance, and product communications for security researchers, customers, press, and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in the broader security community, at conferences, and online as a product and technical spokesperson for Managed Rules and HTTP application vulnerabilities</li> </ul> <h2>Skills Required </h2> <ul> <li>Strong product-management experience, including strategy, roadmap ownership, discovery, prioritization, and cross-functional delivery.</li> <li>Technical fluency to understand HTTP applications, vulnerabilities, exploits, and detection systems.</li> <li>Ability to synthesize input from security research, engineers, customers, and commercial teams into clear product decisions.</li> <li>Customer empathy and strong product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous security environment.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership across Cloudflare Security Research, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Communications, and other product teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Security research, exploit-development, or detection-engineering experience.</li> <li>Experience with WAFs, managed rules, security-rule rollout, false-positive management, application security, threat intelligence, security operations or vulnerability management.</li> <li>Experience with Enterprise security operations, including APIs, automation, auditability, policy controls, logs, and SIEM integrations.</li> <li>Experience with code scanning, software supply-chain security, or exposure discovery.</li> <li>An established presence in the security research community, conference speaking, technical writing, or press engagement.</li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Lisbon </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of 65,000 - 80,000 EURO</li> <li>For <strong>New York City </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $216,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage

title: Senior Product Manager - Threat Intel
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Locations: Austin (Hybrid) </strong></p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>As a Product Manager at Cloudflare, you will be responsible for building products that improve the way that the Internet works. Product Managers at Cloudflare shape high-level product goals but also get our hands dirty. On an average day, you might pitch a concept to senior leadership, collaborate with marketing, work with designers to conduct user research, prototype a new feature, iterate on a spec, analyze usage data, and pair with an engineer on implementation.</p> <p>We are seeking a strategic and technical Senior Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and evolution of our Threat Intelligence portfolio. Your mission is to ensure Cloudflare’s security products and customers can identify, understand, and respond to emerging threats earlier and with greater confidence. You will own the end-to-end roadmap for the platforms, data, and workflows that transform Cloudflare’s unique network signals and security research into timely, actionable intelligence, balancing speed and coverage with accuracy, context, and low false-positive rates.</p> <p>You will translate a rapidly evolving threat landscape, from emerging attacker infrastructure and campaigns to new tactics, techniques, and procedures, into scalable capabilities that improve detection and response across Cloudflare’s security portfolio. You will serve as a bridge between threat researchers, intelligence analysts, engineering teams, and market-facing functions, working closely with Sales, Customer Success, and our customers to understand their challenges and drive adoption. Your success will be measured by the quality, timeliness, and actionability of our intelligence and its impact on customer security outcomes.</p> <h3><strong>You will:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own your space. Enterprise capabilities cut across all of our product verticals, so you should be comfortable working with product managers across the company to prioritize systemic improvements that our enterprise customers need.</li> <li>Be customer obsessed. You will be responsible for directly engaging with customers and understanding how they use our products. You’ll bring these insights back to the team to build a great roadmap. </li> <li>Join pre-sales and post-sales calls with customers, sales, support, etc., to assist with, and help understand all phases of the customer lifecycle</li> <li>Be data driven. You should be comfortable working with data, and analyzing data to quantify the impact of problems and opportunities in your space. </li> </ul> <h3>Key qualifications and skills</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience as a product manager delivering solutions in the cloud at scale for a technical audience </li> <li>Customer focus. At Cloudflare, we serve the needs of customers large and small, and our product managers need to be comfortable understanding how to design for enterprises without compromising the experience for individuals and small businesses. </li> <li><strong>AI Fluency: </strong>Demonstrated experience using AI assistants, coding tools, and agentic workflows to accelerate product work. You should bring hands-on experience in managing complex escalations and leading high-profile engagements (such as Quarterly Business Reviews). This includes delivering product updates to executive stakeholders (both internal and external), maintaining proactive communication during incidents, setting clear and realistic expectations, and driving cross-functional initiatives.</li> <li>Technical Acumen. You must have the ability to grasp complex technical concepts and be able to effectively translate these complex ideas for customers through various channels, including calls, blog posts, and reports. You must be comfortable engaging in deep technical discussions with engineering teams.</li> <li>Preferred: candidate with professional experience in threat intelligence, adversary tactics and common TI frameworks, and/or general intelligence requirements and prioritization concepts.</li> </ul> <div> <p><strong>Compensation</strong><br>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <p><strong>Equity</strong><br>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong><br>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> </div> <div> </div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. title: Key Account Sales Executive
description: <h1 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Key Account Sales Executive – Paris (Office-first)</h1> <p data-lfile-container="61d171d5-b814-4e82-b6c7-fbf6810c9455" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Paris (Office-first)</strong></p> <h3 id="team-description-1">Team description</h3> <p>SumUp already powers over 4 million businesses worldwide. We're now aiming for bigger names, and we're building the team to do it. In France, our Key Account Sales team goes after larger businesses, from hospitality groups to beauty chains and major retailers. You'll choose how you prospect, by phone or in the field, get into their networks and close the deals. As one of the first people on this new team, you'll help work out what it takes to win these accounts, with plenty of opportunities opening up as we grow. The best part? Your variable pay is uncapped, so there's no ceiling on what you can earn.</p> <h3 id="what-youll-do-1">What you'll do</h3> <p>🎯 Identify and reach high-potential businesses, such as hospitality groups, beauty chains and major retailers</p> <p>📞 Run high-volume outreach by phone, in the field and through other channels</p> <p>🤝 Get in front of decision-makers and understand how their business and sites operate</p> <p>🎤 Book meetings and run tailored pitches and demos that show how SumUp can support their business</p> <p>🔥 Own the full sales cycle, from first contact through to closing the deal</p> <p>🚀 Grow your portfolio and network over time, using each win to open the next door</p> <p>📊 Track your performance against targets and use feedback and data to keep improving</p> <h3 id="what-were-looking-for-1">What we're looking for…</h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience in outbound sales, with a track record of hitting targets</li> <li>Comfort with high volumes of outreach, by phone or in the field</li> <li>Real drive and resilience: you stay motivated when deals take time or doors stay closed</li> <li>Confidence and the ability to build strong relationships with business owners and decision-makers</li> <li>Comfort with having freedom in how you work, alongside hands-on coaching and support from your team lead</li> <li>Fluency in French and English</li> </ul> <h3 id="why-you-should-join-sumup-1">Why you should join SumUp</h3> <p>💰 Uncapped variable pay: strong performance can significantly increase your earnings</p> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup</p> <p>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced</p> <p>📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education</p> <p>💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future</p> <p>🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance</p> <p>🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs</p> <p> </p> <h2>About SumUp</h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.</p> <p>Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://youtu.be/9DG64C3moeQ?si=YpcWuBNBTOQPzeLI" target="_blank">our diverse team</a> of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/culture/" target="_blank">Our core values</a> lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.</p> <p>SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/" target="_blank">careers website</a>, and follow our journey on <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/sumup/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a>, <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.instagram.com/insidesumup/" target="_blank">Instagram</a>, and <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.tiktok.com/@insidesumup" target="_blank">TikTok</a>.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><strong>About Workato</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit <span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.workato.com/" data-tooltip-link-label="undefined">workato.com</a>.</span></span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><strong>Why join us?</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a <strong>flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles</strong>. We are driven by <strong>innovation </strong>and looking for<strong> team players </strong>who want to actively build our company. </span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">But, we also believe in <strong>balancing productivity with self-care</strong>. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment <span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="http://www.workato.com/careers">along with a multitude of benefits</a></span> they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives. </span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">Also, feel free to check out why:</span></p> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.businessinsider.com/47-enterprise-startups-to-bet-your-career-on-in-2020-2019-12">Business Insider</a></span> named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.forbes.com/cloud100/#a57477b5f941">Forbes’ Cloud 100</a></span> recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><a style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);" href="https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/technology-media-and-telecommunications/articles/fast500-winners.html"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);">Deloitte Tech Fast 500</span></a> ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><a style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);" href="https://qz.com/work/2053446/the-best-companies-for-working-from-home/"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);">Quartz</span></a> ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers</span></li> </ul></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We’re growing quickly in the Benelux, and we’re hiring Account Executives to grow with us. You’d be joining a team that’s still working out how the region should look, so there’s a lot of room to shape it. You’ll have real say in how we approach accounts, who we work with, and how we build our presence here.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with colleagues across sales, solutions, partnerships and customer success, and with our GSI partners. If you like building relationships that last, and you’d rather help shape a plan than follow one handed to you, we’d love to talk.</p> <p><strong>What you’ve done</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve spent around 8 years selling to businesses, ideally enterprise SaaS or technology, and you know how a complex deal moves through a big organisation.</li> <li>You hit your number, and you can talk through how you did it.</li> <li>You’ve owned customer relationships beyond the signature, and you still hear from your customers years later.</li> <li>You’ve worked alongside GSIs and know that a good partner relationship takes time, trust and being useful to each other.</li> <li>You’ve found new business in tech without waiting for leads to arrive, through outbound, community, or whichever route worked.</li> <li>You’re at home in Salesforce and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and you use your tools to save time rather than to fill a dashboard.</li> </ul> <p>Can you relate to the above? </p> <p><strong>Where you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>Based in the Netherlands, with fluent Dutch and English</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we hope you’re like</strong></p> <ul> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words">You are an enthusiastic, energetic team player who is comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment</li> <li>You care about doing good work and you’re consistent about it</li> <li>You’d like to help build something new and see your impact, rather than slot into a big company with fixed ways of doing things</li> <li>You’re curious and like working through a problem with others to find a good way forward</li> <li>You stay calm and organised when priorities pull in different directions</li> <li>You can work well with a large team spread across locations to win and grow enterprise accounts</li> <li>You’re honest and thoughtful in how you treat prospects and customers, and you bring your values to the way you work</li> </ul> <p>Our process has four stages, including a panel interview, so you’ll meet several of the people you’d be working with. We’ll explain what to expect at each step, and you’re welcome to ask us anything along the way. title: Teamleiter (m/w/d) - Automation & Instandhaltung
description: <section class="section vacancy-detail-intro-section"> <div class="section-inner"> <div class="entry-intro"> <section class="section vacancy-detail-intro-section"> <div class="section-inner"> <div class="entry-intro"> <h2><strong>Kurz und knapp</strong></h2> <p>Als Teamleiter (m/w/d) - Automation & Instandhaltung arbeitest du in unserem neuen Fulfilment Center im Raum Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) mit hochautomatisierten Intralogistiksystemen von Top-Marken wie Apollo, Qimarox und Regal Rexnord. Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für die Instandhaltung während deiner Schicht und führst unser Team aus Maintenance Technicians.</p> <p>Du setzt Prioritäten, sorgst für eine sichere und strukturierte Arbeitsweise und bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Maintenance und Operations. Bei kritischen Störungen übernimmst du die Führung und stellst gemeinsam mit deinem Team sicher, dass unsere Anlagen schnell wieder laufen.</p> <p>Deine Führungskompetenz, dein technisches Verständnis und deine Hands-on-Mentalität sind gefragt, damit täglich rund 10.000 Bestellungen pünktlich bei unseren Kund:innen ankommen.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/50pQKpPc24E" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Führe & entwickle dein Team:</strong> Du führst die Maintenance Technicians während deiner Schicht, coachst sie im Arbeitsalltag und unterstützt ihre Entwicklung.</li> <li><strong>Steuere die Schicht:</strong> Du setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst die Maintenance-Aktivitäten und stellst eine hohe Qualität und Anlagenverfügbarkeit sicher.</li> <li><strong>Manage kritische Störungen:</strong> Du koordinierst dein Team bei technischen Problemen und arbeitest eng mit Operations zusammen, um Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren.</li> <li><strong>Sorge für Sicherheit & Struktur:</strong> Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Sicherheitsstandards sowie eine saubere und strukturierte Arbeitsweise eingehalten werden.</li> <li><strong>Treibe Verbesserungen voran:</strong> Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und setzt Lean-, 5S- und Continuous-Improvement-Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit deinem Team um.</li> <li><strong>Arbeite übergreifend zusammen:</strong> Du stimmst dich eng mit Operations, Maintenance Engineers und externen Maintenance-Partnern ab.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Du hast eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister oder ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Bachelor/Master), z. B. in Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich</li> <li>Du bringst 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem technischen oder Instandhaltungsumfeld mit, idealerweise in einer automatisierten, logistischen oder produzierenden Umgebung</li> <li>Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung, z. B. als Team Lead, Lead Technician, Supervisor oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle</li> <li>Du hast eine Hands-on-Mentalität und verstehst sowohl die technische als auch die operative Seite von Maintenance</li> <li>Du hast Erfahrung mit Lean, 5S und Continuous Improvement und setzt diese Prinzipien gerne praktisch auf der Fläche um</li> <li>Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und behältst auch bei kritischen Störungen den Überblick</li> <li>Du sprichst fließend Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong> Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kannst zusätzlich unser „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm nutzen.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken: </strong>Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche im Schichtsystem) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner: </strong>Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittag- oder Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit - inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns: </strong>Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei - durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: </strong>Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp.</li> </ul> <p> </p> </div> </div> </section> </div> </div> </section> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
