description: Groupe M Service renforce ses équipes et recherche plusieurs Référent(e)s de proximité afin de répondre à ses besoins opérationnels sur différents secteurs d'Île-de-France. Secteurs géographiques concernés Nous recherchons des candidats pour intervenir sur les secteurs suivants : Seine-et-Marne (77) Val-de-Marne (94) Paris (75) Plusieurs postes sont à pourvoir afin de renforcer notre présence sur ces différents secteurs. Chaque référent(e) sera rattaché(e) à un secteur géographique défini en fonction des besoins de l'exploitation. À propos du poste Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité, nous recherchons des Référent(e)s de proximité pour accompagner au quotidien nos conducteurs, nos établissements et nos équipes d’exploitation. Véritables relais opérationnels de terrain , vous veillez au bon déroulement des prestations, au respect des procédures et des consignes de sécurité, ainsi qu’à la qualité du service rendu aux clients et aux usagers. Vous êtes en lien étroit avec les conducteurs, les établissements, le service exploitation et le référent manager. Rejoignez GROUPE M SERVICE, une entreprise dévouée au transport de personnes à mobilité réduite, en tant que référent (e) de proximité. Située à Aulnay-sous-Bois, notre société opère dans l'industrie du transport terrestre de passagers et compte entre 201 et 500 employés engagés. Notre mission est d'assurer le transport des personnes en situation de handicap, en apportant une aide précieuse à ceux qui en ont besoin. Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés par l'assistance aux personnes vulnérables, capables de gérer les défis quotidiens avec compétence et bienveillance. Rejoignez-nous pour faire une différence significative dans la vie de ceux qui comptent sur notre engagement et notre expertise. Vos missions 1. Suivi opérationnel des prestations Contrôler les véhicules à leur arrivée et à leur départ. Vérifier la bonne mise en place des circuits et la disponibilité du matériel nécessaire. Assurer le suivi des nouveaux clients, des modifications de circuits et de l’intégration des nouveaux usagers ou conducteurs. Veiller à la mise à jour des circuits et à la bonne transmission des informations aux conducteurs. Assurer un suivi régulier des conducteurs et du bon déroulement des prestations. Identifier les difficultés opérationnelles et proposer des actions correctives adaptées. Participer aux rendez-vous clients avec la direction et/ou le référent manager. 2. Gestion et accompagnement des conducteurs Récupérer et contrôler les documents obligatoires des conducteurs. Assurer le suivi des VPM, attestations d’honorabilité et autres documents requis. Participer au recrutement des conducteurs. Accueillir et accompagner les nouveaux conducteurs lors de leur intégration. Assurer leur suivi dans le cadre des formations. Réaliser, lorsque nécessaire, des conduites en doublon dans le cadre des intégrations, contrôles, formations ou accompagnements. 3. Suivi des véhicules Organiser et suivre les rendez-vous liés aux contrôles techniques, révisions, entretiens et réparations. Contrôler régulièrement la propreté et l’état général des véhicules. Identifier et signaler les anomalies ou dysfonctionnements. Assurer le suivi des interventions et des échéances de maintenance. Organiser et contrôler la restitution des véhicules. 4. Gestion du matériel Assurer le suivi du matériel confié aux conducteurs : véhicules, téléphones, clés Dallas et autres équipements. Veiller à la bonne utilisation, à la conservation et à l’entretien du matériel. Organiser et contrôler la restitution du matériel lors des changements d’affectation ou en fin de mise à disposition. 5. Qualité, sécurité et respect des procédures Veiller au respect des procédures internes et du règlement intérieur. S’assurer du respect des consignes de sécurité et des exigences propres à chaque établissement. Contrôler la conformité des pratiques et des équipements nécessaires aux prestations. Être attentif à toute situation pouvant présenter un risque pour les usagers, les conducteurs ou les tiers. Signaler immédiatement tout incident, accident, dysfonctionnement, non-conformité ou situation susceptible d'affecter la sécurité ou la continuité du service. Assurer le suivi des réclamations et incidents relevant de votre périmètre. 6. Reporting et communication Compléter et transmettre le reporting hebdomadaire d’activité. Faire remonter les incidents, difficultés opérationnelles, besoins identifiés et actions mises en œuvre. Assurer une communication régulière avec les conducteurs, les établissements, le service exploitation et le référent manager. Garantir une transmission fiable et rapide des informations. Assurer un rôle d’interface entre les différents interlocuteurs afin de contribuer à la continuité et à la qualité du service. Vos compétences Nous recherchons des personnes organisées, réactives et à l’aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs . Vous appréciez le travail de terrain et êtes capables de gérer plusieurs sujets opérationnels en parallèle. Les qualités attendues Sens de l’organisation et des priorités. Réactivité et capacité à gérer les imprévus. Bon relationnel et sens du service. Rigueur dans le suivi administratif. Capacité à faire respecter les procédures et les consignes. Esprit d’équipe et capacité à travailler en transversal. Autonomie et sens des responsabilités. Bonnes capacités de communication et de transmission des informations. Sensibilité particulière aux enjeux de sécurité. Une expérience dans le transport, l’exploitation, la gestion de conducteurs ou la coordination d’équipes est un atout. Vous souhaitez vous investir dans une entreprise dynamique et contribuer à la qualité de nos prestations ? Nos équipes ont besoin de renfort : nous attendons vos candidatures ! Rejoignez Groupe M Service et participez activement au bon fonctionnement de nos équipes sur le terrain. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Intermediate Data Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you'll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service.</p> <p>You'll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You'll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you'll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You'll report to the Director, Data Platform.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow.</li> <li>Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members' merge requests.</li> <li>Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use.</li> <li>Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor.</li> <li>Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely.</li> <li>Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Professional experience shipping production data pipelines in Python.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake is preferred.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with ELT or extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines at scale, including incremental loads, schema changes, backfills, and API ingestion.</li> <li>Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, familiarity with dbt, and solid data modeling fundamentals, including Kimball dimensional modeling.</li> <li>Experience running and troubleshooting data infrastructure, with comfort using Git-based workflows, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and code review.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in your daily work, with an understanding of where they help and where they fall short.</li> <li>Clear written communication, the ability to use GitLab, and comfort working asynchronously in a fully remote organization in line with GitLab's values.</li> <li>Preferred, not required: experience with Snowflake; Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Terraform; SaaS application APIs such as Salesforce, Zuora, or Zendesk; data observability tooling; or Snowflake administration.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Data Platform team within Enterprise Data is responsible for a scalable, reliable and secure data platform for data analytics at GitLab. That includes managing and maintaining the infrastructure we use, both SaaS and self-managed, and building and maintaining the data pipelines that bring data into it. We make data reliable, secure and ready for analytics, data science and AI tools. As more questions go straight to AI tools and agents, the platform underneath has to be more reliable, better governed and more cost-efficient than ever. We're fully remote and globally distributed, and work asynchronously through issues, merge requests and the handbook.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description: 👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey... Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here . What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B! 🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company. 🧮 Pricing at Laka Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do. Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners. We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help. 🤘🏼 The role You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst. What you'll be getting up to: Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment. Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals. Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms. Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data. Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst. You'll be successful by: Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us. Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time. Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year. Requirements 🚀 Sound like you? 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you: Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live. Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other. Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL. Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability. Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team. Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on. Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work. Plus points: Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced. Dutch, German or French. An interest in cycling. Benefits 🌟 Our perks 🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!) 📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join 💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually 🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year 💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future 💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost) 🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours 💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun! 🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!) 👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family 🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts 🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions 🌈 Belonging at Laka We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. title: Projektreferent/in (m/w/d) in Vollzeit
description: WER SIND WIR? Die IMCOG GmbH mit Sitz in Ludwigshafen begleitet Unternehmen bei der Umsetzung des betrieblichen Nachhaltigkeitsmanagements von der Strategieentwicklung und Nachhaltigkeitsberichterstattung bis zur Maßnahmenplanung und Steuerung. Als forschungsorientiertes Unternehmen verbinden wir wissenschaftliche Expertise mit Praxisnähe und haben bereits öffentlich geförderte Entwicklungsprojekte erfolgreich umgesetzt. Unser interdisziplinäres Team entwickelt Lösungen für anspruchsvolle fachliche Aufgaben. WEN SUCHEN WIR? Für ein neues Projekt zur Entwicklung einer KI-gestützten Prüfungsplattform für ESRS-Nachhaltigkeitsberichte haben wir ab sofort eine Stelle als PROJEKTREFERENT/IN (M/W/D) IN VOLLZEIT zu besetzen. Im Rahmen des Projekts entwickeln wir gemeinsam mit Partnern eine neuartige Softwarelösung, die Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften bei der unabhängigen Prüfung von Nachhaltigkeitsberichten unterstützt. Durch den Einsatz Künstlicher Intelligenz sollen komplexe Prüfungsprozesse effizienter, transparenter und nachvollziehbarer gestaltet werden. Hierzu werden insbesondere ESRS-Anforderungen, Prüfungsrisiken, Prüfungshandlungen und Prüfungsnachweise intelligent miteinander verknüpft. WAS SIND IHRE AUFGABEN? Analyse und Weiterentwicklung von Prüfungsprozessen. Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung von Prüfungs-, Daten- und Regelmodellen für die KI-gestützte Analyse von Nachhaltigkeitsberichten. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften, um praktische Prüfungsabläufe kennenzulernen und daraus Anforderungen an die Software abzuleiten. Abstimmung fachlicher Anforderungen mit dem externen Softwareentwicklungsteam sowie Begleitung ihrer technischen Umsetzung. Mitwirkung an der Entwicklung, Erprobung und wissenschaftlichen Bewertung von Softwareprototypen unter praxisnahen Bedingungen. Systematische Untersuchung der Funktionalität, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit KI-gestützter Prüfungshandlungen. WAS BRINGEN SIE MIT? Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Interesse an Wirtschaftsprüfung, Nachhaltigkeitsberichterstattung und digitalen Technologien. Affinität zu Softwareanwendungen, Datenanalysen und Künstlicher Intelligenz. Selbstständige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen fachlichen Disziplinen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse. Erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Wirtschaftsprüfung, prüfungsnahen Beratung oder im Rechnungswesen sind willkommen. Kenntnisse der Nachhaltigkeitsberichterstattung nach CSRD und ESRS sind ebenfalls willkommen. WAS BIETEN WIR IHNEN? Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekt. Die Möglichkeit, eine neuartige KI-gestützte Softwareplattform von der Konzeption bis zur praktischen Erprobung aktiv mitzugestalten. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen in einem engagierten und kollegialen Team. Einen Arbeitsplatz mit sehr hoher Flexibilität, z. B. durch die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice. Eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung. Die Möglichkeit zur Hospitation bei einer TOP25-Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, um praktische Prüfungserfahrung zu sammeln, perspektivisch auch im Bereich der Prüfung von Nachhaltigkeitsberichten. Weiterführende Karriereperspektiven in der Wirtschaftsprüfung, abhängig von der persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung sowie den jeweiligen betrieblichen Möglichkeiten. INTERESSIERT? Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>JDC Warehouse Specialist<br>Position Overview<br>The Warehouse Specialist runs day-to-day warehouse operations at a Nebius data center site. The role receives, stores and issues high-value hardware (GPU racks, servers, network equipment, spare parts), keeps stock and asset records accurate, and provides equipment to data center engineers on time.<br>The specialist is the site's hands-on link to the wider logistics function: Transportation and Transport Coordination for arrivals and pickups, Logistics Planning and 3PL Planning for schedules, Back Office for system records, and the Project Office for new processes and tools.<br>Key Responsibilities<br>1. Receiving & Dispatch<br>•    Receive inbound shipments per the delivery schedule; check seals, packaging and contents against ASN, packing list and PO.<br>•    Record damage and discrepancies with photos on arrival and hand them to Transport Coordination for insurance cases.<br>•    Prepare outbound shipments and RMA returns: picking, packing, labelling, documents; hand over to carriers at the agreed pickup time.<br>•    Follow handling standards for heavy, fragile and high-value equipment.<br>2. Provisioning to Data Center Operations<br>•    Issue equipment and spare parts to DC engineers on time, according to requests and project priorities.<br>•    Stage and kit hardware for rack deployments as agreed with ITDC and Project Managers.<br>•    Keep a clear view of what is available on site and flag shortages to the Team Lead and Logistics Planning.<br>3. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe. ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie. ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris) . Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans , inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment. ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027. Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap , dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control” Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire. Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables. La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;"> Missions / Activités principales : Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire. En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel. title: CDI - Sales / Account Executive (Paris/ IDF)
description: En rejoignant l’équipe Sales de Matera, tu auras l’opportunité d’échanger chaque jour avec des interlocuteurs très différents ! Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Au sein de notre département Sales, tu retrouves : les SDR, dont l’objectif est de qualifier les prospects et d’organiser des démos avec les Sales Executive Sales Executive, dont l’objectif est d’accompagner les prospects sur la suite du cycle de vente jusqu’à la signature du contrat. Pour signer un contrat avec une copropriété, il faut obtenir la majorité des votes des copropriétaires lors de l'Assemblée Générale annuelle ( cycle de vente est long et complexe - 3 mois en moyenne). Les missions au quotidien : Gérer la relation avec les prospects : Réaliser les démos avec les leads qualifiés par les SDR, et fixer clairement les prochaines étapes du cycle de vente, Comprendre le rôle de tes interlocuteur·rices au sein de la copropriété, ainsi que les besoins et les problématiques rencontrées par tes prospects pour adapter l'offre proposée (Matera Plateforme, Syndic Coopératif, ou Local) et les convaincre que Matera est la bonne solution, Établir une relation de confiance avec les copropriétaires, les présidents et les membres du conseil syndical, Convaincre de façon directe et indirecte la majorité de la copropriété, Pitcher la solution lors des Assemblées Générales pour obtenir la signature du contrat et faire la passation avec le département Care Analyser des leviers pour améliorer la conversion, Faire remonter les retours des prospects / clients pour participer à l’amélioration du produit, Nous aider dans l'organisation d’événements clients, Participer à l'amélioration continue du discours et des process en interne. Onboarding et montée en compétences : Sur les 6 premiers mois : tu vas monter en compétences sur la qualification des leads, le pitch aux prospects inbound et outbound, les produits de Matera, l’accompagnement dans le changement de syndic pour tes clients, les techniques de vente et tu vas te familiariser avec le monde de la copropriété (droit et compta notamment). Ensuite : prise en main complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'à la signature des contrats - organisation et pitch lors des AG. Les avantages Les plus : Package : 40€ à 65K selon profil et expérience, 2 semaines d'onboarding pour comprendre le fonctionnement et les valeurs de Matera, et un onboarding spécifique à ton métier, Un career path pour t’accompagner dans ton évolution professionnelle : accompagnement hebdomadaire par taon manager, 2 performances reviews par an, et politique de mobilité interne, Politique de rémunération et de BSPCEs transparente, Politique d’accompagnement à la parentalité : une reprise en douceur à 80% pendant 4 semaines (payées à 100%), ainsi que 5 jours de congés supplémentaires par an pour enfant malade, Temps de Trajet Responsable (TTR) : 1 jour de congé supplémentaire par an, découpable en 2 demi-journées et rémunéré comme un congé payé, pour inciter à choisir des modes de transports responsables, Congés menstruels : 1 jour de congé payé supplémentaire par mois, pour mieux gérer les règles douloureuses, Sport : accès à Gymlib pour faire du sport à petits prix, Des bons plans culture avec la plateforme Leeto (réductions cinéma, musées, parcs d'attraction...). La base légale : Congés payés et RTT (selon statut) Mutuelle & Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50% Prise en charge de la prévoyance à 100% Prime vacances (SYNTEC) Prise en charge des transports à 50% Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis Les informations pratiques : Localisation : Paris Télétravail : au moins 2 jours de présence au bureau, mais attention, des déplacements en IDF sont à prévoir pour ce poste (pour pitcher en AG). Type de contrat : CDI Statut : cadre Date de prise de poste : Dès que possible Idéalement, Tu as plusieurs années d’expérience sur les métiers de la vente, Tu aimes la vente en B2C et aller au contact de tes clients, Tu es déterminé·e, et as une bonne capacité d'exécution : tu es motivé·e par l'atteinte de tes objectifs et peux gérer un volume élevé de leads, Tu as un fort esprit d’équipe, trouves des solutions rapidement. Tu as une excellente communication orale et écrite : tu sais vulgariser des notions parfois complexes, et aller à l'essentiel. Tu hésites entre les challenges de la vente complexe en B2C et le plaisir de parler à des individus très différents pour les fédérer autour d’un projet ? Tu apprécies autant les outils digitaux que rencontrer tes prospects là où ils se trouvent ? Tu rêves d’une équipe où tout le monde s’entraide pour atteindre et dépasser ses objectifs, sans oublier de passer de bons moments ensemble, pendant ou après les heures de bureau ? De participer à la création d’un leader européen des services immobiliers ? Ne cherche plus et postule pour nous rejoindre ! Le processus de recrutement : 1️⃣ Premier entretien téléphonique de 20 à 30 mn avec notre recruteuse, 2️⃣ Entretien avec Inès, Head of SDR, et Paul, Team Lead (n+1), pour une mise en situation (45 en visio) 3️⃣ Entretien Edgar, Head of AE, et Justine, VP Sales, ainsi que ton équipe (1h au bureau) 4️⃣ Prise de références puis offre À savoir : 🕑 Nous nous efforçons de faire un retour sur ta candidature le plus rapidement possible (sous une semaine). Que le retour soit positif ou négatif, tu recevras un mail de notre part - pense à regarder tes spams au cas où. ☝️ Si tu as besoin de prédispositions particulières pour réaliser les entretiens dans les meilleures conditions, tu peux le notifier lors de ta candidature et en informer l’équipe Recrutement. title: Senior Backend Engineer, Development Health
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer on Development Health, you'll help make the systems that engineering teams rely on more reliable, maintainable, and easier to extend. You'll build and improve the automation, tooling, and data that help teams spot problems early and ship with less friction.</p> <p>As customer zero for GitLab, we support engineering workflows on GitLab's own product at scale. You'll use the product in demanding, real-world ways, surface the friction and gaps you find, and contribute to improvements that get built into the product for GitLab's customers.</p> <p>You'll support work such as:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Health alerting and remediation routing for GitLab's core continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines</li> <li value="2">Flaky and slow test detection systems</li> <li value="3">Engineering analytics and reporting that engineering teams use to make decisions</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Own and evolve core Development Health systems, from design through production.</li> <li value="2">Improve the reliability, maintainability, and test coverage of long-lived automation, and reduce reliance on undocumented knowledge by documenting and simplifying legacy systems.</li> <li value="3">Partner with engineering managers and product teams to identify workflow pain points and turn them into well-scoped, measurable improvements.</li> <li value="4">Work with data to show whether changes improve engineering health, and use it to prioritize.</li> <li value="5">Mentor intermediate engineers through code review, design feedback, and pairing.</li> <li value="6">Communicate clearly in writing and asynchronously, including status, tradeoffs, and proposals for stakeholders across Engineering.</li> <li value="7">Monitor the health of production systems, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to root cause analysis.</li> <li value="8">Use artificial intelligence (AI) agents and assistants to analyze issues and problem areas to help shape the team's product roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Substantial experience as a backend or tooling engineer, with a track record of owning production systems end to end.</li> <li value="2">Strong proficiency in Ruby, or the ability to become productive quickly.</li> <li value="3">Experience maintaining or modernizing legacy codebases safely.</li> <li value="4">Comfort with CI/CD systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation at scale.</li> <li value="5">Independent problem-solving and clear, concise written communication: you spot problems early, raise risks proactively, and drive work to completion without close direction.</li> <li value="6">Experience writing automated unit and integration tests and taking part in collaborative code review.</li> <li value="7">Experience using AI coding assistants to speed up development while critically reviewing their output.</li> <li value="8">Optional experience: Rails; developer productivity, engineering analytics, or internal tooling; GitLab's product and open source contribution workflow; data pipelines or metrics reporting; or agent-based workflows that run in production.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>Development Health is part of Developer Experience. Our work is mostly internal, and our customers are GitLab team members across an engineering organization of hundreds of engineers.</p> <p>We're all-remote, asynchronous by default, and documentation-driven, in line with GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. title: Commercial Account Executive, Netherlands
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. About the role We are hiring for our second Commercial Account Executive to help grow the Commercial business across the Netherlands. You will help grow the Commercial business in your market by building strong relationships, creating new logo momentum, and working closely with partners and the wider team to expand Horizon3’s reach. We are looking for experienced sellers who enjoy building. They should be proactive, thoughtful, and comfortable helping markets develop. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. title: Software Engineer Intern - Ads
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mirakl:</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.<br><br>Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).<br><br>With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.</p> <p>For more information: <a href="http://www.mirakl.com">www.mirakl.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Mirakl in Numbers:</strong></p> <ul> <li>🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40</li> <li>👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo</li> <li>🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France</li> <li>⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <p>Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.</p> <p>Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:</p> <ul> <li>💡<strong> Work Hard Together:</strong> Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success</li> <li>🏆 <strong>Get Things Done: </strong> We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results</li> <li>🚀 <strong>Go Above & Beyond:</strong>  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence</li> <li>🎓 <strong>Succeed Through Expertise:</strong> Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture</li> <li>🤝 <strong>Satisfy & Empower Clients:</strong> We're committed to our clients' success</li> </ul></div><h3><strong>1. The Team You'll Join</strong></h3> <div class="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1"> <div class="min-w-0 break-words text-base text-foreground"> <div class="flex flex-col gap-y-4"> <div class="font-conversation"> <div class="w-full"> <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words font-normal first:pt-0 last:pb-0 py-1 @sm:pt-2 @sm:pb-[10px] @sm:leading-relaxed text-base leading-relaxed text-foreground">You’ll join one of the <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Mirakl Labs Ads teams</strong> for a <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">six-month internship starting in January or February 2027</strong>, based in <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Paris or Bordeaux</strong>. You’ll be part of a cross-functional <strong class="font-semibold text-foreground">Squad</strong> made up of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers, and a QA Engineer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="flex items-center gap-1"> </div> <h3><strong>2. Your Impact</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute to the development and enhancement of an AI agent that autonomously generates and executes test scenarios, covering new feature validation, regression testing, and exploratory testing.</li> <li>Help design, write, and run test cases to evaluate the agent’s performance.</li> <li>Explore different technical approaches and contribute to benchmarking their results.</li> <li>Work under the guidance of experienced engineers and QA team members</li> <li>Contribute to the project using existing programming skills</li> </ul> <h3><strong><br>3. What You'll Bring to the Role</strong></h3> <p><strong>Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently pursuing a degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related field (engineering school, university, or career change), and looking for a 6-month internship</li> <li>First hands-on development experience through an internship, academic project, apprenticeship, or personal project</li> <li>Good understanding of a programming language</li> <li>Proficient in working with LLMs and developing skills and/or agents</li> <li>Appreciation for software quality best practices: testing, clean code, design patterns</li> <li>Strong team player with a genuine enthusiasm for knowledge sharing and problem-solving<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>4. Tech Stack</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Back-end:</strong> Java 21, Spring Boot</li> <li><strong>Front-end:</strong> ReactJS</li> <li><strong>Data & Messaging:</strong> Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL</li> <li><strong>Tooling & Practices:</strong> CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring</li> </ul> <h3><strong>5. Languages</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>French:</strong> Fluent</li> <li><strong>English:</strong> Professional proficiency (written and spoken)</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>Compensation, Perks & Benefits</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Pay Range:</strong> €1,200 – €1,400 per month</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>Our Hiring Process</strong></h3> <p>We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.</p> <p>Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter</strong>, then an <strong>AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma</strong>, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.</li> <li><strong>Recruiter interview (30 min)</strong> — conversation about your background, motivations, and an introduction to Mirakl</li> <li><strong>Hiring Manager interview (45 min)</strong> — technical discussion </li> <li><strong>STAR interview (1h)</strong> — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture</li> </ol><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.</em></p> <p><em>As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in English and <a href="https://www.mirakl.com/fr-FR/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">here</a> in French. </em></p> <p><em>We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our </em><a href="https://info.mirakl.com/ai-guidelines-for-candidates-and-interviews" target="_blank"><em>AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews</em></a><em>.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Data Analyst, Marketing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p><strong>THE IDEAL CANDIDATE</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>The ideal candidate is a self-starter and problem-solver, skilled at leveraging technology and data to deliver top-tier analytics solutions. They thrive on addressing complex business challenges and are consistently effective in making high-judgment decisions at a rapid pace, even in the face of ambiguity and uncharted scenarios. Additionally, the ideal candidate is energized by a work environment where strategy, innovation, and decision-making are intentionally distributed, where transparency, agility, and data-driven insights are highly valued, and where colleagues at all levels hold each other to exceptionally high standards to serve Quince customers.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the US team to understand what exists that we need to replicate and the gaps that we need to build upon</li> <li>Develop and maintain automated reports to track Marketing KPIs:</li> <ul> <li>New/Returning Customers, LTV/CAC, Total vs. inc. ROAS</li> <li>Performance Marketing Channel: Paid Social, SEM, App, Affiliates etc.</li> <li>CRM: Customer cohort, Database health + Lifecycle stages</li> </ul> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Conduct ad-hoc analyses to identify channel inefficiencies, scaling opportunities, areas for improving MER / Total ROAS.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering and Performance team to deliver experimentation and incrementality studies: Geo-Lift tests, Channel Incrementality, Brand lift, MMM validation. </li> <li>Partner with product, engineering and CRM to deliver:</li> <ul> <li>A data driven customer lifecycle programme including key drivers of high-value customers </li> <li>A/B and multivariate tests across lifecycle touchpoints that optimize revenue per visit, and Incremental LTV / Revenue</li> <li>A multi-category approach to cross selling, identifying triggers and next best actions based on customer behaviour</li> </ul> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Implement data quality, governance (inc. GDPR) and AI usage best practices in collaboration with the US. </li> <li>Be an integral part of the international team and contribute to their growth.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, or similar). Master’s degree is a plus. </li> <li>7+ years in a data analytics/product analytics role, ideally with a focus on supply chain within an e-commerce or technology company.</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BIm Mixpanel).</li> <li>Knowledge of statistical analysis and A/B testing; familiarity with Python or R is a plus.</li> <li>Ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights, with a focus on detail, accuracy, and clarity.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present data insights and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>Based in Berlin / London with the ability to come into the Berlin / London office 4 days per week</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in running Geo-lift tests across Europe</li> <li>Previous e-commerce / multi-category experience</li> <li>Strong Performance marketing (attribution) + CRM measurement background</li> <li>Able to translate data analysis into action through storytelling and visualization</li> <li>Understanding of core marketing metrics and how they interact to deliver profitable growth: LTV/CAC, ROAS, MER</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3604"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3662">Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. </p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4074">Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing <a href="https://forms.gle/DpJ11jHa1WbqfUWB9">this accommodation form</a>. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4428">Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4604"><em data-renderer-mark="true">Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds</em></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4641">At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="5364"> </p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Legal Engineer
description: About Grubel Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window. To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands. Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen. Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg. About the role You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice. Working directly with Grubel’s founding team, you will shape our research, development, and product: Translate complex legal processes into agentic workflows, evaluate our systems for legal soundness and utility, and work with customers to set our product and engineering standards. You need not write code, but you’re passionate about understanding our technology deeply. Working in a fast-moving team at the intersection of AI research, legal practice, and technology excites you. What you’ll work on Designing realistic tasks, datasets, and evaluation rubrics for training and evaluation of our legal AI systems Translating complex legal processes into agentic workflows together with our researchers and engineers Evaluating system outputs for legal accuracy, usefulness, and failure modes Leading enterprise pilots and implementations Supporting customer discovery, demonstrations, and go-to-market initiatives You may be a good fit if You have law degree and strong academic record You have experience practicing law—whether at a law firm, in-house, or in another legal setting You are proactive, self-directed, and comfortable taking broad ownership at an early-stage company You are curious about how AI systems work and comfortable working closely with researchers and engineers Logistics Munich or Tübingen. We value working together in person, prefer candidates based near one of our offices, and expect at least one day per week in the office. We plan to establish a Zurich office in 2027. Full time employment Competitive salary plus a stock option grant in Grubel, Inc., our US parent company. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. Bring what prospects say back to the France team, product, and marketing, and use those insights to improve targeting and messaging. What makes you a great fit You do not need sales experience. You care about the quality of the opportunity, not just the number of meetings on a calendar. You take feedback directly, own your results, and keep moving when the answer is no. You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego.
