title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
description: We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits. We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform. Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers. We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable. Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker. Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery. We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output. What you'll do: Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. The balance will depend on which squad you join, but keeping the codebase healthy and customers unblocked is part of the job Contribute to improving our CI/CD practices and deployment pipeline as we work toward more frequent, more reliable releases Keep performance in mind across the stack Build and maintain integrations with Learning Management Systems using LTI and partner APIs Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, bringing both quality standards and a pragmatist's sense of what's worth the effort What you bring: You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and Ruby on Rails is your home stack: you've shipped production code with it, you know its conventions, and you're comfortable in its edges You write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought. RSpec and Capybara are part of your regular toolkit, and you write tests that actually catch things rather than just confirm the happy path You are user-oriented: when you're deciding how a feature should work, your first instinct is to think about the person using it, not the implementation that's most convenient You've worked in a legacy codebase before and come through it well. You know what to fix, what to leave, and how to leave things better than you found them without getting stuck in a refactoring spiral You understand CI/CD well enough to work within good practices and to nudge a codebase toward them when they're missing You communicate clearly, give honest feedback in code reviews, and take it just as well. You’re collaborative without needing everyone to agree with you You are pragmatic and document your decisions; you'd rather make a thoughtful trade-off and write it down than chase the perfect solution indefinitely Familiarity with Ember.js or migration scenarios from it to Hotwire is a genuine advantage here; experience with AI dev tooling, Azure, or observability practices would serve you well too What you get: Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite) 25 paid holidays per year A day off for your birthday Advantageous pension scheme 3 days of volunteering leave per year €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription Free access to our office gym Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS) Compensation: €60K – €75K • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. title: Financial Administrator
description: Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋 Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis ! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it. I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it. We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. Financial administration can often be limited to a narrow scope of topics within a larger team. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it. What you'll do: Send out sales invoices on time. This includes setting up new customers and uploading invoices to procurement portals such as Ariba and PaymentWorks Set up and maintain customer subscriptions in the ERP system based on signed contracts, and create invoices and credit notes for all legal entities Keep track of unpaid invoices, send payment reminders to institutions that haven’t paid, and flag invoices that stay unpaid Partner with Sales and Partner Success to address billing and payment queries Ensure supplier invoices and expenses are processed on time Prepare the weekly payment run for approval Compare bank transactions with our accounting records and resolve any discrepancies Manage the Finance mailbox: customer invoice and payment questions, supplier requests, supplier onboarding forms, and internal requests that come in through the ticketing system Support month-end close and annual accounts Write down how finance processes work in the Finance database in Notion, and update it when you improve them What you bring: You stay accurate and organised during busy periods. At month-end you keep daily work running smoothly while closing the month. You follow things through to the end, in a friendly way. Late payments, missing details or an invoice that needs to match a contract: you stay on it until it’s sorted, and people enjoy working with you. You take ownership of your work from start to finish. You plan your own week, set your own priorities and keep things moving. You speak up when something in the numbers looks off, so we can fix it together. You enjoy working with tools and software, and like finding new ways to get more out of them. You’re comfortable building things as you go. You ask good questions, fill in the gaps and make sure you know the next steps before you start. You have at least one year of experience in a finance or similar administrative role (two or more is a plus), including hands-on work with billing or subscriptions. We care more about your experience than your degree. You’ve worked with an accounting system or ERP, such as Exact Online, NetSuite, Dynamics or SAP. Experience with Exact Online, Moss or procurement portals is a bonus You write and speak English fluently, as we use it for all internal and external work. You’re available 24 to 32 hours per week and can work from our Amsterdam office 2-3 days a week. title: Senior Product Analyst
description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 We're looking for a sharp, curious, and impact-driven Product Analyst to help us build products our customers love. You'll join the Product Analytics team at Manychat, working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to bring data into every decision we make.This role is perfect for someone who loves turning data into quick action: zooming in to uncover the signal in the noise, and zooming out to see the big picture. If you thrive at the intersection of product thinking and data, excited about working in a fast-scaling SaaS product, and want to have a positive impact on the daily lives of more than one million creators, influencers, and brands, we'd love to meet you. WHAT YOUʼLL DO 🚀 Drive insights that matter: Translate complex data into compelling stories that guide product decisions and strategy. Shape success metrics and influence the roadmap: Partner with PMs to define KPIs, metric trees, and measurable goals that connect product impact to business outcomes. Surface insights that size opportunities, highlight trade-offs, and sharpen prioritization. Guide experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests. Build trusted data: Collaborate with engineers and data teams to ensure reliable, scalable data models and tracking. Make data accessible: Create dashboards, enable self-service, and drive data literacy across product teams. TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE 💥 Experience: 4+ years in product analytics or similar area, ideally in SaaS or consumer-facing products. Technical skills: Strong SQL and Python for data analysis; proficiency with BI tools (e.g. Tableau) is expected. Metric trees & product mindset: Comfortable building and working with metric trees, and translating data into hypotheses, opportunities, and product decisions. Experimentation (a plus): Familiarity with A/B testing and experimental design is a bonus. Stats comfort: Solid grasp of statistics and how to separate signal from noise. Communication & confidence: Clear and compelling storytelling – you can influence PMs, engineers, and leaders alike. Comfortable challenging assumptions and pushing back on stakeholders when the data tells a different story. AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to speed up analysis, generate hypotheses, write/debug SQL and Python, and streamline reporting. Ways of working: Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to drive initiatives independently. WHAT WE OFFER 🤗 Important: We are NOT offering relocations for this position. Here’s how we care about your growth, well-being, and comfort: Annual professional development reimbursement. Generous time-off policy to balance your work and life. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents. Hybrid format to split your time between the comforts of home and collaborative spaces. title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/f/x)
description: About Virtual Identity Virtual Identity (VI) is a digital agency built on Human-Centered Business Growth: combining empathy for people with insight from data to drive real digital success. With around 140 colleagues across Freiburg, Munich, Vienna, and Porto (and remote), we cover the full spectrum from Consulting and UX Research to UX/UI Design, Software Development, and Digital Marketing — always learning in close collaboration with our clients. As a Forward Deployed Engineer at VI, you sit at the intersection of client, product, and engineering. You're not building in isolation from a backlog handed down by someone else — you go into deep, sustained virtual immersion with the client, understand their real operational problems, and ship working software that solves them, fast. You prototype, integrate, and iterate directly with the people who will use what you build, then help harden it into something production-ready with our delivery teams. You also bring a well-founded understanding of agentic engineering — not just using AI coding assistants, but genuinely understanding how agents plan, use tools, and fail, and applying that thinking to how you build, integrate, and automate in the field. This role suits someone who's equally comfortable in a client workshop, a codebase, and a data pipeline — and who gets energy from ambiguity rather than needing it resolved before starting. What you will do: Embed with client teams to observe workflows, diagnose bottlenecks, and identify where custom software can create outsized impact. Rapidly prototype and deploy solutions — internal tools, integrations, automations, data pipelines — directly in the client's environment. Translate messy, real-world requirements into working code without waiting for a fully specified brief. Own the full loop: build, deploy, get feedback from actual users within days, iterate. Use agentic engineering practices — not just AI-assisted coding, but designing workflows, automations, and integrations that leverage agents as a core part of the solution, where it genuinely helps the client. Work closely with VI's UX, consulting, and cloud-native engineering teams to transition prototypes into scalable, supportable production systems. Navigate client infrastructure, security constraints, and existing systems (cloud platforms, APIs, legacy tools) pragmatically. Act as a trusted technical voice in client conversations — you can whiteboard an architecture and defend it in the same meeting. Travel to client sites as needed (frequency depends on engagement). What we expect: Strong full-stack or cloud-native engineering experience, with a track record of shipping real software, not just prototypes that die in a demo. Comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders and translating their problems into technical solutions on the fly. Solid grounding in at least one modern backend stack and one frontend stack, plus working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Experience with APIs, data integration, and automation — you can connect systems that were never designed to talk to each other. Real, well-founded knowledge of agentic engineering — you understand the underlying concepts (agent planning, tool use, context management, orchestration, evaluation), not just the tool names, and you've applied that thinking to real work, not side projects. A bias toward action: you'd rather build a rough version and test it with real users than perfect a spec. Strong communication skills — you can explain a technical trade-off to a client stakeholder without jargon. Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; forward deployed work is inherently unstructured. Willingness to travel to client sites. Experience in an agency, consultancy, or client-facing technical role (nice to have). Familiarity with UX research or design collaboration workflows (nice to have). Exposure to enterprise integration patterns or legacy system modernization (nice to have). Hands-on experience building or deploying agentic systems for a client, not just personal productivity use (nice to have). A relevant degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — but we care more about what you've built (nice to have). What you can expect from us Exciting projects with well-known brands, a team of motivated colleagues who genuinely enjoy working together, and continuous learning through our VI Academy. Whether you're based in one of our offices or working fully remote, we give you the room to grow — professionally and personally. Sound like your kind of place? We'd love to hear from you. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements. Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software. As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service. title: Senior Materials Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As Senior Materials Engineer (all genders) you will lead material selection for the propulsion battery system of VÆRIDION's CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will identify the best material for each application, from composites and metals to adhesives, gaskets, and insulation materials, and own the material requirements and evidence that support each choice. Through trade studies, characterization, and close supplier engagement, you will make sure that every material in the propulsion battery system performs safely in normal operation, under abuse, and during thermal runaway. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will work closely with Mechanical Design and Materials & Processes, and support the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, and Cell Technology teams wherever material choices matter, including thermal adhesives, electrical bonding, and insulation. As development matures, you will hand over qualification and process ownership to Materials & Processes while remaining the technical authority on material behaviour. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead material selection for the propulsion battery system, including composites, metals, adhesives, gaskets, seals, potting compounds, and thermal and electrical insulation materials. Lead structured material trade studies that balance mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, weight, cost, and supply chain considerations. Own material requirements for normal operation, abuse, and failure cases, including thermal runaway, fire, venting, crash, vibration, humidity, and fluid exposure. Evaluate high-temperature and fire protection materials, such as phenolic and high-char-yield composites, silicone systems, ceramics, and intumescent materials, for thermal runaway containment. Provide material property data and guidance on material-driven design features to the Mechanical Design team. Support material choices for thermal adhesives, gap fillers, electrical bonding, and insulation together with the Thermal Systems, HV Electrical Systems, and Airborne Electronics teams. Draft test requests (TRQs) for material characterization and work with the test team and suppliers to execute them. Analyse test data and derive design-relevant material properties and conclusions. Own technical relationships with material suppliers, including requirements alignment, data requests, and the evaluation of new material candidates. Define material specifications and approved-material definitions together with Materials & Processes. Contribute to material qualification and certification substantiation, transferring ownership to Materials & Processes as development matures. Assess material compatibility and durability over the service life, including chemical compatibility with coolants and electrolytes, galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, moisture uptake, outgassing, and property retention after thermal cycling and accelerated aging, as well as resistance to thermal runaway vent gases and ejecta, working with the Materials & Processes Engineer where processing such as cure state or surface preparation affects the result. Lead failure investigations and root cause analyses where material behaviour is a contributor. Consider regulatory constraints such as REACH and RoHS in material selection. Act as the technical authority on materials in design reviews and technical discussions with suppliers and partners. Mentor engineers and build materials expertise across the Technology division. Your Profile: Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science & Engineering. 5+ years of experience in materials engineering, preferably in aerospace, battery systems, or other safety-critical industries. Deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships in polymers, composites, metals, and ceramics. Proven ability to select the best material for a given application, based on data and first principles. Experience with material characterization methods such as mechanical testing, DSC, TGA, DMA, cone calorimetry, and microscopy. Experience planning tests, interpreting results, and correlating them with design requirements. Strong knowledge of thermoset and thermoplastic composites, adhesives, and elastomers. Knowledge of high-temperature material performance and fire, smoke, and toxicity behaviour is desirable. Experience leading technical work with material suppliers. Familiarity with CS-23, DO-160, DO-311A, and CMH-17 is beneficial. Working proficiency with 3D CAD, such as CATIA, SolidWorks, or Siemens NX, is beneficial. title: Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As a Senior Battery Management System (BMS) Hardware Engineer (all genders), you will own the development of safety-critical electronics for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. You will design compact, high-density mixed-signal hardware that accurately monitors, controls and protects large lithium-ion battery assemblies during charging, ground operation and flight. This is a hands-on role covering the complete hardware lifecycle: requirements, architecture, circuit design, prototype bring-up, verification, qualification, production release and certification evidence. Working closely with BMS software, battery systems, safety, PCB layout, mechanical integration, thermal systems, testing and manufacturing, you will turn the propulsion battery’s safety and control concepts into flight-ready, certifiable electronic hardware. Your Day-to-Day: Own the architecture and detailed design of battery management units, cell-monitoring electronics and associated sensing, communication and protection circuits. Translate system, interface and safety requirements into complete, traceable and verifiable hardware requirements. Design accurate measurement circuits for cell voltage, temperature, pack voltage, current and other battery sensors. Develop high-density mixed-signal electronics incorporating battery-monitoring AFEs, balancing circuits, microcontrollers, watchdogs, memory, isolated communications and power supplies. Define the PCB architecture and layout constraints for multilayer HDI assemblies, including fine-pitch components, microvias, grounding, signal and power integrity, EMC, thermal management, creepage and clearance. Perform circuit simulation, tolerance analysis, worst-case circuit analysis, component derating, FMEA/FMECA and reliability assessment. Work with Systems and Safety Engineering to implement fault detection, diagnostic coverage, independence and safe-state behaviour in accordance with the allocated Design Assurance Level. Develop and maintain DO-254/ED-80 lifecycle evidence, including hardware requirements, design data, traceability, verification results, review records and problem reports. Lead prototype bring-up, debugging, integration and fault-injection testing using cell simulators and flight-representative hardware. Support DO-160G environmental and EMC qualification, DO-311A battery-system testing and transfer into repeatable production through DFM, DFT and manufacturing-test development. Collaborate closely with BMS software, battery systems, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, testing, manufacturing and certification teams. Lead hardware design reviews, resolve test and production failures and mentor less-experienced engineers. Your Profile: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or a related field. Seven or more years of experience developing complex electronic hardware from architecture through verification and production release. Proven experience with BMS hardware, battery-monitoring electronics or comparable high-channel-count, safety-critical mixed-signal systems. Strong expertise in precision analogue measurement, ADC signal chains, filtering, current and voltage sensing, galvanic isolation and fault-tolerant power supplies. Demonstrable experience designing high-density multilayer electronics, including HDI technology, fine-pitch BGA/QFN devices, microvias, power distribution, grounding and thermal constraints. Strong digital-hardware knowledge involving microcontrollers, memories, watchdogs, CAN/CAN FD, SPI, I²C and isolated serial interfaces. Hands-on experience developing airborne electronic hardware under DO-254/ED-80 is essential. Experience at DAL B or DAL A and supporting formal certification reviews is strongly preferred. Proficiency with professional ECAD and simulation tools such as Altium Designer, Cadence, Siemens EDA, LTspice or equivalent. Altium experience is preferred. Confident laboratory skills and experience with prototype bring-up, automated testing, environmental qualification, failure analysis and electronics manufacturing. Familiarity with CS-23, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-160G and DO-311A is advantageous. Fluent English is essential; German is beneficial. You will own everything electrical on and within these units, from cell interconnections and busbars to protection and safety devices, internal HV and LV wiring, and the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces. Through electrical modelling and analysis, you will close the design before it moves to test and provide the engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is electrically safe, robust, and certifiable. Within the Airborne Electronics team, you will collaborate with Electronic Hardware Design and Power Electronics, and work closely with the Electrical Systems Architect and the HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration, Thermal Systems, Cell Technology, Safety, and Certification teams to ensure that the design of each unit is fully aligned with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION's mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the electrical/electrothermal design of HV equipment for an 800 V class propulsion battery system, covering topology, segregation, protection, isolation, precharge, and safe disconnection within each unit. Align the electrical design of each unit with the propulsion battery system and the aircraft electrical system, working closely with the HV Electrical Systems team and the Electrical Systems Architect. Design cell interconnections and busbars as well as develop the cell connection system together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team. Specify and select protection and safety devices, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge components, current sensors, manual service disconnects, and the HV interlock loop, working with Airborne Electronics colleagues where solid-state power controllers (SSPCs) are used. Define the HV power and LV communication connector interfaces of each unit together with the HV Electrical Systems team. Lead or support component specification, selection, and supplier engagement depending on the component, together with the responsible teams. Develop or assist with electrical models of the full battery pack to close the design before testing, and support propulsion battery system modeling of performance and failure cases together with the HV Electrical Systems team. Perform electrical/electrothermal analyses, including short-circuit and fault current, protection coordination, insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, partial discharge at altitude, voltage drop, and Joule losses as input to the Thermal Systems team. Own the grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design within each unit. Define the physical layout and routing of electrical components together with the Mechanical Design & Integration team. Perform safety analyses such as FMEA for each unit or support the Safety team in system-level safety assessments. Draft test requirements (TRQs) for electrical verification, independently or together with the respective teams as required. Create and maintain schematics, wiring diagrams, requirements, and interface definitions under configuration control, and contribute to design reviews and certification evidence. Proven experience in the electrical design of HV battery packs, power distribution units, or junction boxes. Strong understanding of HV DC distribution and protection, including contactors, fuses, pyrofuses, precharge circuits, insulation monitoring, HV interlock, and fault coordination. Experience designing busbars and cell interconnections, including current-carrying capacity, thermal derating, and short-circuit withstand. Experience with insulation coordination, creepage and clearance, and partial discharge, ideally for equipment operating at altitude. Proficiency with electrical modeling and analysis tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, Simscape Electrical, PLECS, or equivalent. Proficiency with ECAD tools such as Zuken E3.series, Siemens Capital, EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, or equivalent. Experience with grounding, bonding, shielding, and EMC design. Experience writing requirements and test requirements, and correlating analysis results with test data. Experience with safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, and FHA is desirable. title: Workplace Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Places Team</strong> at Cloudflare is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic <strong>Workplace Operations Manager</strong> to lead and elevate the day-to-day operations of our Austin hub. In this role, you’ll be the go-to person for creating a smooth, welcoming, and highly functional workplace—partnering with global counterparts to share best practices and continuously enhance our spaces.</p> <p>You’ll gather feedback from employees and guests to shape how the hub evolves, contribute to future buildouts, and collaborate with teams across IT, Legal, Physical Security, EBC, and more. You're comfortable navigating fast-paced environments, solving problems on the fly, and thinking creatively about how to improve systems and experiences. With a hospitality mindset and strong communication skills, you take pride in delivering excellent service and building a space that reflects our culture and values.</p> <p>This role reports to the <strong>Regional Manager, Workplace Operations</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong><em>Workplace Experience:</em></strong> Ensure our hub is a functional, inspiring space that reflects our culture and supports hybrid work. Act as the first point of contact for employee workplace needs, solving issues quickly and thoughtfully.</li> <li><strong><em>Stay Connected Across Channels:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Maintain clear, responsive communication with the local team across platforms like chat, email, and in-person touchpoints—ensuring everyone stays informed, supported, and aligned on workplace updates and needs.</li> <li><strong><em>Track and Report Workplace Metrics: </em></strong>Monitor key data points such as space utilization, occupancy, and service ticket volume to support data-driven decision-making and long-term planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support Workplace Programs: </em></strong>Help drive local implementation of global workplace programs—from our food program (think snack stocking, team lunches, and special food moments) and sustainability initiatives to employee engagement efforts.</li> <li><strong><em>Support Internal Events & Experiences:</em></strong> Plan and execute a range of onsite events—including team onsites, in-person weeks, executive briefings, customer meetings, and cultural moments—both independently and in collaboration with the Global Events & Experiences team, ensuring each gathering is seamless, engaging, and reflective of our culture.</li> <li><strong><em>Safety & Compliance:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Partner with Security and Legal teams to maintain a safe and compliant workplace. Support emergency preparedness efforts, safety drills, and incident response protocols.</li> <li><strong><em>Scale Smartly</em></strong><strong>: </strong>As the hub grows, help onboard new team members, support hiring needs for workplace roles, and participate in long-term workplace planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support the Regional Places Team:</em></strong> Assist with administrative tasks such as responding to tickets, managing emails and inquiries, and providing holiday coverage to ensure seamless team operations across regions.</li> <li><strong><em>Lead Onsite Operations:</em></strong> Own the day-to-day management of the workplace—from front desk services, greeting guests/employees/visiting employees, and mail handling to office supplies, swag, deliveries, and space readiness. You’ll make sure everything flows, looks great, and feels seamless for employees and visitors alike.</li> <li><strong><em>Be the go-to for Vendors and Places Team:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Liaise with building management, building security, and external vendors (cleaning crews, caterers, property managers, etc.) to keep our operations running efficiently. Oversee vendor performance and contracts, lead RFPs when needed, and track workplace budgets responsibly.</li> <li><strong><em>Create a World-Class Environment:</em></strong> Champion an inspiring, inclusive, and vibrant office culture. Plan and execute engaging onsite events, team celebrations, catering, and daily amenities that make coming into the office exciting, productive, and memorable for our team.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Have 5+ years of experience leading workplace operations teams, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including 3+ years of people management experience.</li> <li>Are people-first and service-minded, with a friendly, professional presence that makes everyone feel welcome</li> <li>Know how to juggle vendors, projects, and priorities—and still sweat the small stuff</li> <li>Bring sharp budget management skills and make thoughtful, cost-effective decisions</li> <li>Communicate clearly and confidently across all levels and time zones using Google Workspace</li> <li>Are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—you spot what needs doing before anyone else does</li> <li>Thrive in fast-moving environments, stay calm under pressure, and love finding creative solutions</li> <li>Have experience collaborating cross-functionally with teams like IT, Security, People Ops, and more</li> <li>Bring a hospitality mindset and a passion for building inspiring, functional spaces where people love to work</li> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday).</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Manager Organisational Transformation
description: About the job Please note that fluency in Dutch is mandatory for this role. Do you have a passion for organisational design and a drive to boost effectiveness? At Valcon, we are looking for experienced candidates with an ambition to improve organisational effectiveness and a passion for organisational design. Besides a proven track record in this domain, we value strong team players with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to carry out great ideas in practice. You fit in our team when you have highly developed analytical and conceptual thinking skills and when you can easily draw insights and conclusions from complex matters. What will you do? Your primary focus lies in the organisational transformation process, where translation of ambition and strategy to an effective organisational design take a centre stage. In close collaboration with our clients, you analyse challenges and identify improvement potential in the integral organisational design, such as processes, systems, functions and organisational structure. You play an important role in advancing Valcon’s capabilities with a strong emphasis on the People & Organisational Transformation domain. Your responsibilities will include: Managing organisational changes, from problem analysis, optimisation of processes to designing and implementing new business models. Developing different organisational transformation strategies and approaches (making an ambition strategy, design and guiding principles, organisational structure and required communication and engagement plans) that fits the client’s challenge best. Managing and regulating Organisational Transformation projects, with high emphasis on both delivery as stakeholder management. Building and maintaining a relevant network with current and new clients. Managing and guiding consultants during projects and in their personal development. Co-develop one of the industries in which Valcon is present. Building and promoting ‘Valcon’; focus on expanding the People & Organisational Transformation competence team, and primary Organisational Transformation. What do you bring to the table? A completed bachelor’s and master’s degree with a numerical component. At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy. At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models. The ability to translate strategic goals into implications for employees. We don’t stop at design; we support our clients through implementation. Our integrated transformation projects connect strategy, data, AI and organisational change. An interest in data, AI, change management and the human side of change is therefore essential. Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders. Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills. Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships. Fluent in Dutch and English. What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritises and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the number of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organises both professional and social events. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly using the button on this page or get in touch with our recruitment team to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first. title: Senior Named Account Executive ( Northern VA/DC Metro)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. The role involves handling multiple accounts and will require high degrees of attention to detail and coordination with customers, partners, and internal resources. Lastly, the AE should thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where initiative is celebrated and enthusiasm for the possible is expected.</li> </ul> <h3>Enterprise Account Team Core Values:</h3> <ul> <li>Be Successful – Success comes from hitting your goals on a consistent basis. Often the Enterprise Account Executive will have to make strategic decisions on engagement, terms, and support. Be the person who actively seeks to assist the team, shares knowledge, and extends your personal network. We are successful when we are all overachieving as a group.</li> <li>Proactively manage and grow a portfolio of assigned Enterprise level clients.</li> <li>Close new and expansion business monthly, quarterly, and annual basis, meeting or exceeding assigned quota.</li> <li>Manage customer relationships and assume ownership of deadlines and deliverables to ensure Cloudflare is correctly positioned to win business.</li> <li>Develop C level and Decision Maker relationships within accounts for the purpose of establishing strategic alignment to customer’s transformative objectives.</li> <li>Develop pipeline by maintaining a high level of activity/outreach directly and indirectly, deeply understanding the customers goals and objectives, and analyzing where Cloudflare can add value.</li> <li>Maintain accurate forecasts and report to the sales leader on the status of New and Expansion opportunities for weekly sales meetings. Leverage MEDDPIC framework in SFDC document weekly progress.</li> <li>Accountable to reverse closure steps and establish jointly owned timelines with Customers. Understand the purchasing process fully and be able to document progress against required steps to closure.</li> <li>Organize and deliver executive level presentations, proposals, commercial terms with Customers.</li> <li>Leverage the Executive Briefing Center and process to establish key sponsorships and support of accounts with Cloudflare Executives.</li> <li>Build and maintain relationships with channel partners to establish joint value propositions and Customer value.</li> <li>Participate in team meetings and deliver GTM guidance on how to better partner with accounts.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li><strong>This is a remote role but the location requirement is that you reside in the DC Metro area</strong></li> <li>6+ years of experience coupled with proficiency in Cloud Networking and Security Technology with industry awareness.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of meeting and exceeding quota.</li> <li>Expert Sales Acumen (Discovery, Position, Compete, Negotiate, Close, Expand).</li> <li>Ability to lead a multidisciplinary team over a long term account horizon.</li> <li>Able to identify key players in organizations and possess the ability to convert business issues into solutions.</li> <li>Comfortable selling to obtain new business or expand existing business. Strong closing skills are essential.</li> <li>Ability to build meaningful relationships quickly.</li> <li>Someone who acts with integrity and honesty in all situations.</li> <li>Be able to demonstrate a positive attitude internally and externally.</li> <li>Expert at building rapport and owning the room.</li> <li>Aggressiveness in execution and planning.</li> <li>Ability to take successes and challenges in stride.</li> <li>Discipline to work w/o instant gratification.</li> <li>Someone who is bold in their actions and never satisfied with complacency.</li> <li>A strong will and fortitude to work a plan in the face of challenge.</li> <li>A business professional who loves the sales profession.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <h4>For Washington DC, based hires: Estimated annual salary of $269,000 - title: Senior Network Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Atlanta, GA</li> <li>Denver, CO</li> <li>Seattle, WA</li> <li>Toronto, ON</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until December 01, 2026.</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare operates one of the world's largest and most interconnected networks, spanning 335+ cities across every region of the globe. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our Edge Network & Backbone team — someone who brings deep operational experience, an AI-first mindset, and the instinct to mentor and lift the engineers around them. In your first year, this role is deliberately hands-on: you'll be in the operational trenches, owning complex faults, driving capacity work, and setting the standard for how we run the network. Beyond that, you'll help shape how the team works — building AI-enabled tooling and agents that reduce toil, accelerate troubleshooting, and make the whole team more effective. This is a North American based role, but you'll be joining one global team: the sun never sets on Cloudflare, and our engineers hand off work across every time zone to keep the network running around the clock.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own the technical operation, engineering, and architecture of Cloudflare's global network, including planning, installation, and day-to-day management of hardware and software across the edge and backbone.</li> <li>Serve as a hands-on operational anchor for the team — diagnosing and resolving complex network faults, owning incident response end-to-end including on-call rotation, and contributing to post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.</li> <li>Build production AI agents for network operations. Design, ship, and own LLM-powered tools that integrate with our operational systems of record via tool calling. Ship them with evals, observability of agent decisions, cost tracking, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where autonomous action carries blast radius.</li> <li>Apply AI to accelerate troubleshooting. Use and extend our internal AI platform (Workers AI, AI Gateway) to speed up root cause analysis, pattern recognition across faults, and operational decision-making under pressure.</li> <li>Architect network improvements that lower latency, reduce packet loss, and increase scale — optimising end user experience across Cloudflare's global infrastructure.</li> <li>Mentor and develop junior engineers on the team, setting technical standards, conducting structured troubleshooting sessions, and building a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams on cross-functional network projects, contributing to design documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles that outlast any individual contributor.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Proven track record in large-scale network engineering and operations.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript and/or Go sufficient to build, debug, and maintain agent code, not just to glue scripts together.</li> <li>Working knowledge of agent integration patterns: function/tool calling, MCP or equivalent, retrieval over operational corpora (runbooks, postmortems, change history), and prompt iteration with evals.</li> <li>Experience reasoning about agent failure modes in production: hallucination guards, fallback paths, rollback, blast-radius control.</li> <li>Deep expertise in BGP and anycast routing, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex routing issues in a production environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of MPLS and Segment Routing.</li> <li>Proficiency across multiple network vendor operating systems (Juniper, Cisco, Arista, or similar).</li> <li>Experience with network automation frameworks such as SaltStack, Ansible, or equivalent, and a strong instinct for solving operational problems through code.</li> <li>Ability to prioritise effectively and lead calmly when faced with high-pressure scenarios.</li> <li>An effective communicator who can adapt their style to any audience — whether guiding a junior engineer through a fault or presenting a network architecture decision to senior leadership.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Shipped LLM-powered tooling into production use by a team other than your own, with measurable operational impact.</li> <li>Professional-level network certification (JNCIP, CCNP, or equivalent or higher).</li> <li>Experience with optical transport technologies such as CWDM and DWDM.</li> <li>Linux system administration.</li> <li>Experience writing network configuration and design documentation at an architectural level.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000</li> <li>Washington, based hires: Estimated annual salary of $172,000 - $237,000.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudfla

title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Climate Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.</p> <p>Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.</p> <p>The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.</p> <h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.</p> <p>You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.</p> <p>Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.</p> <p><strong>Things We ❤️</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.</li> <li>Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.</li> <li>Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.</li> <li>Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.</li> <li>Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.</li> <li>Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.</li> <li>Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.</li> <li>Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.</li> <li>Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.</li> <li>Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.</li> <li>Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.</li> <li>Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.</li> <li>Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Should Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.</li> <li>A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.</li> <li>Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.</li> <li>Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.</li> <li>The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.</li> <li>Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.</li> <li>A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.</li> <li>An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.</li> <li>Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.</li> <li>Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.</li> <li>Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.</li> </ul> <p>Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.</p> <h2><strong>How We Work</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Your day-to-day work will center on a close partnership with the Climate Manager, with collaboration across engineering as needed.</li> <li>You will have substantial autonomy and will be expected to keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.</li> <li>We build and launch incrementally, using feedback to guide the next step.</li> <li>In Amsterdam, we come to the office two to three times a week to collaborate, whiteboard, and spend time together.</li> <li>Flexport’s broader technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Kubernetes, GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake. We welcome candidates from different technology backgrounds.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in It for You?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct ownership of products that help customers make better supply chain and environmental decisions.</li> <li>The opportunity to shape Climate technology with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Flexport.</li> <li>Equity participation and a defined pension contribution scheme.</li> <li>25 vacation days based on full-time employment.</li> <li>Fully paid premiums for Flexport’s collective health insurance plan.</li> <li>Catered lunches, breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office.</li> <li>Covered home-to-office commuting costs for employees living outside Amsterdam.</li> <li>Employee assistance and parental leave benefits.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. Please see our Privacy Notice available at <a href="http://www.flexport.com/privacy" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.flexport.com/privacy&source=gmail&ust=1613840050053000&usg=AFQjCNHD63svlkD-hWHlGuGOM_bSYVrnpw">www.flexport.com/privacy</a> for additional information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression. Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols. Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms. Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar). Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Management experience English is mandatory; French or German is a plus. title: Triage audicien - Drachten, Friesland
description: Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak? Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Je kunt rekenen op: · Premium hooroplossingen · Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant · Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek · Warme leads via onze partner Audibene · Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie · Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap · De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak · Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé Voor wie is dit een mooie stap? Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen. Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied. Wat bieden wij jou? Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je. Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes. En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past. Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen? Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
