Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).</li> <li>Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Fluent in English and Vietnamese to engage with customers in Vietnam</strong></li> <li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.</li> <li>Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li>Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.</li> <li>Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).</li> <li>Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.</li> <li>Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.</li> <li>Ability to travel as required.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Business Intelligence Data Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>What is Contentstack?</strong></p> <p>Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.</p> <p>While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.</p> <p>Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.</p> <p>Learn more at <a class="c-link c-link--focus-visible" href="http://www.contentstack.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://www.contentstack.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.contentstack.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>Who Are We?</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go!</span></p></div><h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What Are We Looking For?</span></h2> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Business Intelligence Data Architect</strong> to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack.</p> <p>In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making.</p> <p>If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead analytical architecture and governance:</strong> Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. Establish conventions for model grain, naming, ownership, lineage, and documentation, and lead architectural design reviews.</li> <li><strong>Build governed data models and semantic layers:</strong> Design and implement reusable business entities, semantic models, and enterprise metrics that support consistent reporting, self-service analytics, applications, and AI-enabled workflows.</li> <li><strong>Establish analytics engineering best practices:</strong> Set standards for dbt development, testing, Git workflows, CI/CD, deployment reliability, model performance, and observability to improve scalability and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Enable secure, reliable data access:</strong> Design governed access patterns for applications, AI agents, and self-service tools consuming Snowflake data, including role-based access control (RBAC), APIs, service layers, and query optimization.</li> <li><strong>Partner across the business:</strong> Work closely with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive stakeholders to translate business requirements into trustworthy data models and scalable analytics solutions.</li> <li><strong>Mentor and enable the team:</strong> Guide analytics engineers on modular architecture, semantic implementation, reusable modeling patterns, and modern analytics engineering practices.</li> <li><strong>Drive platform evolution:</strong> Evaluate tools, semantic technologies, governance capabilities, and architectural improvements that support long-term scalability while reducing technical debt.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What Really Gets Us Excited About You</span></h2> <ul> <li>5-8 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, including at least 3 years in an architect capacity with direct ownership of an analytical platform.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on expertise in Snowflake architecture, including virtual warehouse design, RBAC, materialization strategies, dynamic tables, and query performance optimization.</li> <li>Expert-level experience with dbt, including staging/intermediate/mart conventions, Jinja macros, incremental models, testing, documentation, and reusable modeling patterns.</li> <li>Strong understanding of dimensional and semantic modeling, with the ability to select and justify approaches based on business and analytical needs.</li> <li>Proven experience designing and deploying production semantic layers and governed metrics across BI platforms, analytics applications, and AI-enabled workflows, including text-to-SQL and MCP-based integrations.</li> <li>Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python, along with familiarity with dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Git, CI/CD, and cloud-native analytics environments.</li> <li>Experience designing secure data access patterns for applications consuming Snowflake data, including APIs, service layers, RBAC, query performance, and governed semantic access.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain architectural decisions to technical teams, executive leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams across the US, Europe, and India.</li> <li>Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced certification; dbt Certified Data Architect or Analytics Engineer certification.</li> <li>Experience with Snowflake Cortex and Snowpark ML for in-warehouse AI/ML workloads.</li> <li>Experience working with Salesforce as a source system, including dimensional modeling for go-to-market (GTM) data.</li> <li>Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures that connect large language models to governed analytical data.</li> <li>Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI.</li> <li>Experience implementing data governance frameworks, including data catalogs, column-level lineage, and row-level security.</li> <li>You value a fun, collaborative, and innovative culture!</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Do We Offer?</strong></p> <p><strong>Interesting Work |</strong> <span style="font-weight: 400;">We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the “challenge yourself” role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you’re doing it. </span></p> <p><strong>Tribe Vibe </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict “no a**hole policy” and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.</span></p> <p><strong>Bragging Rights</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> |</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> We are dreamers and dream makers. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>One Team One Dream </strong></span><span style="font-weight: 400;">|</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> This is one of our values, and it shows. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it’s a great time to be joining…</span></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">To review our Privacy Policy, please click <a href="https://www.contentstack.com/legal/privacy-notice-for-candidates/" target="_blank">here</a>.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.  Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.  </li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong>. title: AI Engineer
description: About Us: Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the role: We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to build and run the agents at the heart of Tebi OS. You’ll design, ship, evaluate and scale our Product Agents, along with the data pipelines, tools and infrastructure that make them reliable in production. The ideal candidate started in data or ML engineering and has since moved into AI engineering, building LLM-powered agents for real users. You enjoy turning messy financial and operational data into context an agent can reason over and act on with confidence and you are passionate about solving product challenges through AI. You’ll work closely with product and engineering to put intelligence into the hands of hospitality teams. That could be an agent that answers questions about a restaurant’s finances in real time, one that automates repetitive back-office tasks, or internal tools that help us move faster. What you’ll do: Design, build and operate production agents: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, multi-step reasoning, and integration with Tebi’s backend services Build the data foundations agents rely on, including real-time and batch pipelines over financial and operational data, retrieval layers, and well-modeled datasets agents can query safely and accurately Turn APIs and internal services into well-defined agent tools, and own the contracts between agents and the rest of the platform Set up evaluation for agent behavior: offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, regression testing on prompt and model changes, and feedback loops that improve agents over time Own observability for agents in production by tracing sessions, tool calls and model calls, and tracking latency, cost, error rates and quality Work with product teams to find where agents can meaningfully improve the customer experience or internal workflows, and say clearly where they can’t Make sure agents handle data securely and responsibly, with sensible guardrails, access controls, and protection against prompt injection and data leakage What you’ll bring: 7+ years in software engineering, with a solid base in data or ML engineering Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM agents to production, not just prototypes. You’ve dealt with flaky tool calls, runaway loops, hallucinated arguments and token budgets, and you have opinions on how to handle them. Strong data modeling and data warehousing fundamentals, plus experience with ingestion, transformation and data quality Strong SQL, and experience with pipeline tools (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and analytical or cloud data platforms (e.g. ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake) Experience evaluating and monitoring LLM systems, and an understanding of the full lifecycle from experiment to deployment to ongoing improvement Backend engineering skills: you’re comfortable building the API endpoint that exposes an agent’s output to the frontend, or the service an agent calls as a tool Clear communication, including the ability to explain trade-offs in latency, cost, accuracy and complexity to product partners A product mindset. You care about how your work lands with users, and you’re keen to meet customers face to face to understand their needs. This probably isn't the role for you if you have been working with AI agents to improve your day to day working flows but you haven’t built an Agent in the production. People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers . Benefits: Start-up Equity Competitive Salary Lunch Provided in Office Team building events Unlimited time off What is Restaurant Software? Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it. From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy. How we use AI at Tebi We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed. At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Kundenverantwortlicher (m/w) "Geldanlage" 80% - 100%
description: Die Brevalia AG ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen, welches sich auf die individuelle und umfassende Beratung von in der Schweiz lebenden Privatpersonen fokussiert und dank seiner FINMA-Lizenz als Vermögensverwalterin agieren kann. Für den weiteren Ausbau wenden wir uns an eine sehr proaktive und gut vernetzte Persönlichkeit, welche die nächste Wachstumsphase der Firma mit verantworten will. Aufgaben Als Kundenverantwortliche/r beraten und betreuen Sie Ihre Kunden selbständig in den Themenbereichen der Geldanlage (Vermögensverwaltung und Anlageberatung inkl. Aktien, Obligationen, Fonds/ETF’s sowie Derivate/Strukturierte Produkte), deren Finanzierungsbedürfnissen (Hypotheken und Lombardkredite) und decken auch die Grundbedürfnisse bezüglich Vorsorge (keine Versicherungen) Steuern und Güter & Erbrecht ab. Sie koordinieren zusammen mit internen/externen Fachexperten die zeitgerechte, umfassende Bearbeitung der Kundenbedürfnisse aller Finanzthemen und sorgen damit für ein hochwertiges Beratungserlebnis. Eine Ihrer Hauptaufgaben wird die proaktive Neukundenakquisition sein, um Ihren Kundenstamm auf- und auszubauen. Dabei werden Sie vom Team unterstützt und Ihre Stellvertretung ist jederzeit sichergestellt. Qualifikation Sie sind seit mind. 5 Jahren als Kundenberater/in für Schweizer Kunden tätig, betreuen eigene Kunden und verfügen nach Ihrer Grundausbildung über mindestens einen Weiterbildungsabschluss (AZEK, CFA, MAS PB&WM, MAS Financial Consulting). Mit Ihrem Fachwissen und Ihrer kundenorientierten Art konnten Sie sich in den letzten Jahren bei Kunden wie auch Kollegen einen Namen als wissender Leistungsträger aufbauen und streben heute eine Position an, in welcher Sie Ihre Kontakte, Ihre Erfahrungen und Ihr Wissen einbringen können sowie in der Sie weiter gefördert werden. Zudem konnten Sie sich in den letzten Jahren über die proaktive Neukundenakquisition beweisen und verfügen über ein gutes Netzwerk, da Sie sich neben Ihrer beruflichen Tätigkeit in diversen Netzwerken persönlich engagieren. Sie wollen sich aktiv einbringen und Verantwortung übernehmen. Benefits Wir bieten Ihnen die Chance, dass Sie sich auf die umfassende Beratung und Betreuung konzentrieren und ohne Verkaufsziele, Mehrwert für Ihre Kunden schaffen können. Dazu bieten wir ein umfassendes Dienstleistungsangebot, viele Fachexperten und etablierte Beziehungen zu Partnerinstituten. Unsere moderne IT-Infrastruktur sowie unsere moderne Arbeitsweise unterstützten Sie in der Akquisition sowie in der Kundenbetreuung. Zudem können Sie jederzeit ortsunabhängig arbeiten. Sie arbeiten in einem spannenden Arbeitsumfeld in einem kleinen Team in welchem sehr persönlich und menschlich agiert wird. Der Wissenstransfer zwischen den Persönlichkeiten ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil unseres Angebots, um ein fruchtbares Klima zu schaffen. Sie erhalten die Chance, in einem kleinen Unternehmen sehr viel mitzugestalten, zu bewegen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich weiterzuentwickeln. Ihr Arbeitsplatz in der Stadt Zürich ist nicht an starre Arbeitszeiten gekoppelt, wir leben eine Kultur des Vertrauens, der gegenseitigen Rücksichtnahme, der offenen Kommunikation und der Leistungsfokussierung. Ihre persönlichen Ziele sind die Grundlagen der persönlichen Weiterentwicklung, welche wir laufend zusammen besprechen und in deren Erreichung wir Sie aktiv unterstützen. Trauen Sie sich diese unternehmerische Aufgabe zu? Dann lassen Sie uns darüber sprechen, wie wir gemeinsam Grosses bewegen können. Ihre Kontaktaufnahme mit Ihren Bewerbungsunterlagen ist der erste Schritt in die Richtung Ihrer spannenden Zukunft. Zeigen Sie uns, warum Sie unser Team gut ergänzen und kontaktieren Sie uns. title: Director, Business Development - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><u><strong>About The Team<br><br></strong></u>Anduril's Growth organization identifies, shapes, captures, and grows new opportunities for the company.<br><br>This role sits within the <strong>Connected Warfare Division</strong>. Connected Warfare builds the software and hardware substrate for global, multi-domain command and control (C2) — joint, time-sensitive, connected mesh ecosystems that link every robot, human, and sensor across every domain to close kill chains and enable mission autonomy. The division includes the Voyager team, which delivers ruggedised computing and communications platforms for the network edge.<u><strong><br><br></strong></u><strong><u>About the Job</u></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>This is a sales role. You are here to hunt and close new business for Connected Warfare across Europe and the Middle East.</strong></li> <li>Based in continental Europe, you'll report to the Head of Growth for Anduril's International Connected Warfare business. You carry initial responsibility for the region, with scope to expand as the business scales.</li> <li>European defence environments come with sovereign requirements, legacy architectures, and security constraints. You will know these pain points cold and demonstrate how Anduril integrates with — and supercharges — the systems customers already operate.</li> <li>The work is matrixed: you'll pull on programs, engineering, capture, software, finance, partners, and customers to win. The deliverable is unambiguous: pipeline, partners, and signed contracts. This is an <strong>individual-contributor role</strong> — no direct reports. Your impact is measured in the business you build and the contracts you close</li> </ul> <p><u><strong>What You’ll Do<br></strong></u></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive go-to-market.</strong> Stand up and execute the Connected Warfare growth strategy across Europe and the Middle East. Identify, qualify, shape, and close complex opportunities with Allied nations, navigating international procurement cycles and sovereign requirements to secure long-term programs of record.</li> <li><strong>Generate and capture new business.</strong> Run a dual-track motion: hunt and close net-new customers across the region while partnering with delivery teams to scale and expand current contracts.</li> <li><strong>Map customer requirements.</strong> Build a working understanding of regional defence requirements, security constraints, and legacy architectures. title: Senior Financieel Strategisch Adviseur | Gemeente Zwolle
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Gemeente Zwolle op zoek naar een Senior Financieel Strategisch Adviseur. Binnen de afdeling Concernstaf werk je aan een strategische en impactvolle opgave: het ontwikkelen van een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een horizon van tien jaar en een bijbehorend financieel sturingskader. De gemeente staat de komende jaren voor grote investeringen op het gebied van woningbouw, gebiedsontwikkeling, onderwijshuisvesting en infrastructuur. Tegelijkertijd vragen financiële schaarste, beperkte uitvoeringscapaciteit en netcongestie om scherpe keuzes en integrale afwegingen. In deze opdracht zorg je voor een toekomstbestendige financiële aanpak die inzicht geeft in investeringen, risico’s, financiële consequenties en prioriteiten binnen de gemeentelijke investeringsportefeuille. Deze interim opdracht is interessant voor een ervaren strategisch financieel adviseur met ruime ervaring binnen gemeentelijke organisaties, financiële sturing en investeringsvraagstukken in het fysieke domein. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een looptijd van tien jaar. Je ontwikkelt een financieel sturingskader voor gemeentelijke investeringen, inclusief financiële uitgangspunten en besluitvormingscriteria. Je ontwikkelt een methodiek voor integrale prioritering van investeringsprojecten op basis van financiële, bestuurlijke en organisatorische factoren. Je adviseert over de aansluiting van het MIP en het sturingskader op de planning- en controlcyclus (P&C-cyclus). Je verzorgt de implementatie, overdracht en documentatie zodat de organisatie zelfstandig kan doorwerken met de ontwikkelde instrumenten. Wat vragen wij? Eisen: Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-bacheloropleiding. Je hebt minimaal 10 jaar ervaring als strategisch financieel adviseur of in een vergelijkbare financieel-strategische adviesfunctie. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen een gemeentelijke organisatie. Aanvullende wensen: Je hebt ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieel instrumentarium. Je hebt ruime kennis van en ervaring met gemeentefinanciën. Je hebt ervaring met financiële vraagstukken binnen het fysieke domein, zoals gebiedsontwikkeling, woningbouw of infrastructuur. Je hebt gewerkt binnen een groeiende gemeente met meer dan 100.000 inwoners. Je hebt ervaring met advisering aan bestuur, directie en senior management. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen en opleveren van een Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP). Competenties Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je hebt gevoel voor politiek-bestuurlijke verhoudingen en stakeholders. Je bent daadkrachtig, resultaatgericht en brengt complexe opgaven tot een concreet eindresultaat. Je werkt zelfstandig en zoekt op het juiste moment actief de samenwerking op. Informatie Start: Zo snel mogelijk Aantal uur: 24 tot 36 uur per week Lengte opdracht: 6 maanden met optie tot verlenging Locatie: Zwolle Vorm: ZZP Geïnteresseerd? Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 9 november 9.00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Wij geven je op korte termijn een inhoudelijke reactie op jouw interesse in de interim opdracht. Contact Voor meer informatie over deze opdracht kunt u contact opnemen met Nicholas Schoonhoven, Managing Consultant Interim Management, 06 13 15 68 11, Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Our mission is to empower life scientists to probe intelligent networks, accelerate biomedical discoveries for the benefit of patients, and create a future more exciting than the present. Our interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers are constantly pushing the boundaries of engineering for life’s complexities. We are ambitious, fast-growing and love to explore. The company’s cutting-edge products are used in laboratories and pharma companies worldwide. 3Brain is headquartered in Switzerland nearby Zurich, has a Data Science and Discovery Unit in Genova, Italy, and an operational unit in the US. Tasks For the next expansion step, 3Brain is looking for a full-time Hardware electronics engineer to reinforce our R&D team. You will help develop embedded systems for high-speed data acquisition devices, including tasks such as system engineering, schematics design and layout, testing and verification. You will also contribute to the current device’s life-cycle management, including activities such as automation, production testing and optimization. A young, fast-growing company with plenty of opportunities for personal growth and development. Great challenges and adventures in both technical and economical fields. title: Senior Business Development Lead
description: About the role As a Senior Business Development Lead at SkyNRG, you’ll build and grow partnerships with large corporate customers looking to address the emissions associated with their business travel and air freight. You’ll be responsible for developing new customer relationships and growing existing ones, from understanding a company’s sustainability goals and business needs to shaping proposals, negotiating agreements and closing deals. Working with senior decision makers and colleagues across SkyNRG, you’ll help customers understand how SAF certificates (SAFc) can form part of their approach to reducing aviation-related emissions. This is a senior commercial role for someone who enjoys building relationships, navigating complex sales processes and turning customer interest into long-term partnerships. You’ll combine strategic account development with a hands-on approach to progressing opportunities and delivering commercial results. Your responsibilites Win new strategic customers and grow existing partnerships. Build relationships with senior stakeholders and guide them through their SAF journey. Lead commercial opportunities from first conversation through to signed agreement, nurturing the relationship at every stage and ensuring a high-quality customer experience. Develop account and engagement plans for high-priority customers and partners. Create new opportunities through networking, outreach, events, and referrals. Share customer and market insights to help continuously improve our commercial approach and propositions. Management of industry initiatives and client-facing campaigns. Work closely with colleagues across SkyNRG to ensure customers receive a seamless experience. Your profile We're looking for someone who is commercially sharp, curious by nature, and motivated by helping organisations make meaningful progress towards their sustainability goals. Must-Haves 8+ years of experience in a consultative B2B business development, sales, or commercial role, preferably within SAF, energy, carbon, or similarly complex or emerging markets. A proven track record of developing new business and converting strategic opportunities into commercial partnerships. Experience building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers. Experience leading complex commercial discussions and contract negotiations involving multiple stakeholders. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Experience working with CRM systems and data-driven business development processes. The ability and motivation to quickly build expertise in SAF, SAF certificates, and the evolving regulatory landscape. A continuous improvement mindset, and willingness to act as an ambassador for SkyNRG and its values: Driven, Genuine, Change-maker Nice-to-Haves Experience in SAF, aviation, carbon markets or related sectors. Experience working in a scale-up or fast-growing business. Experience with HubSpot. A relevant professional network that can help open doors and create opportunities. About SkyNRG Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel. Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions. Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards. title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
description: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01 Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten. Over de functie Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar): Werk je in dagdienst Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01 Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek. In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028): Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces. Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta. Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren. Jouw profiel SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen Welkome extra kennis en ervaring: Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management Over DSL-01 In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta. DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten. De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart. We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal. Waarom deze rol? Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken. Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek. Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart. NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌ Solliciteer Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart. NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌ Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com . 📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken. title: Embedded Engineer
description: Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. The role As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers. What you will do Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses. Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition. Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer. Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition. Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface. Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery. Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer. Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool. Your profile MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field. ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation. Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux. Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ). Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware. Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks. Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet. Experience with Git and collaborative code review. Full professional proficiency in English. We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you. Bonus Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition. Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering. High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development. Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data. Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment. Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team. What we offer Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet. A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product. Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven. A competitive salary for the Dutch market. description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! The team is organized in subteams, each with its own lead, and you are the person who keeps them aligned. What you'll do Lead and grow the team Run regular 1:1s, ensure growth of the engineers in your team, review progress, and make promotion and ranking decisions together with engineering leadership. Coach and develop subteam leads, and set up the subteam structure as the team grows. Keep a distributed team connected and productive: clear working agreements, transparent planning, and a culture where people raise problems early. Hire Own hiring for the team end to end: define the profiles, screen candidates, run interviews, review coding challenges, and close offers together with Talent Acquisition. Keep a high bar while hiring at pace (our current target is around two new engineers per month), and make sure every new joiner has an onboarding plan and a buddy. Escalate early and clearly when priorities conflict, and communicate decisions to the go-to-market organization. Deliver for strategic enterprise customers Take responsibility for the engineering side of large enterprise go-lives: requirements engineering, solution design, test and fix cycles, and go-live readiness. Work directly with project managers and, where needed, with customer stakeholders and their IT teams, and give clear, regular engineering updates. Close gaps in the product rather than per customer, so the next enterprise customer arrives on a platform that already handles their case. You have a strong backend engineering background and can still read, review, and discuss production code and system design with senior engineers. You have hired many engineers yourself, you know what a high bar looks like, and you can run a structured interview process. You have delivered complex software for enterprise customers, including demanding go-lives, and you are comfortable in a room with customer stakeholders. You prioritize ruthlessly, communicate trade-offs clearly, and can hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives while keeping the relationship. You develop people: you give direct feedback, set measurable goals, and help engineers grow into leads. title: AI Security Research & Red Team Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled AI Security Research & Red team engineer<strong> </strong> to join our Red Team within the Security Threat Detection, Response and Emulation organization. This is a critical role that will be at the forefront of protecting our company and customers from malicious threats. You will be responsible for driving security research, exercises, and activities that emulate real world attackers and attacks to drive improvements in Cloudflare’s security posture focusing on AI, Agents, harnesses and LLM’s. </p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>AI Security and Vulnerability Research: </strong>Stay current with emerging threats and perform deep-dive research to identify AI-specific vulnerabilities and risks in addition to general vulnerabilities across Cloudflare’s products and services.</li> <li><strong>Agentic testing and adoption: </strong>As a core function, identifying AI-related attack surfaces through rigorous testing of agentic implementations and LLM usage which will help  define requirements and implementation guidance while proactively. </li> <li><strong>Adversary Simulation:</strong> Execution of full-chain red team operations targeting Cloudflare’s global infrastructure, corporate networks, and product ecosystems.</li> <li><strong>Efficacy Testing:</strong> Establish a rigorous framework for testing "Security Efficacy"—measuring exactly how well our WAF, EDR, and SIEM detections perform against known TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures).</li> <li><strong>Purple Teaming:</strong> Foster a highly collaborative relationship with the Blue Team (Detection & Response) to ensure findings are translated into immediate defensive improvements.</li> <li><strong>Mentorship & Growth:</strong> Be a technical leader, providing technical expertise while fostering a culture of curiosity, ethical hacking and partnering to improve Cloudflare’s security posture. </li> <li><strong>Executive Reporting:</strong> Translate complex technical exploits into risk-based narratives for leadership, helping prioritize engineering resources where they matter most.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partnerships</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Security Incident Response Team (SIRT):</strong> You will act as the "sparring partner" for SIRT. By conducting unannounced exercises, you help them refine their playbooks, test their on-call rotations, and ensure their forensic tooling is effective under pressure.</li> <li><strong>Threat Detection & Threat Engineering:</strong> You will partner closely with these teams to bridge the gap between adversary simulation and defensive coverage. public markets.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. title: Customer Reliability Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></h3> <h3><strong>Why This Role Exists</strong></h3> <p>Cloudflare built its reputation helping build a better Internet, defending millions of sites, giving away SSL and DDoS mitigation when the industry charged premium prices. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p> <p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p> <p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p> <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p> <p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p> <p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p> <p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p> <h3><strong>What You Might Work On</strong></h3> <p><strong>Rapid response:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li> <li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li> <li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Proactive engineering:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li> <li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li> <li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</p> <p><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</p> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</p> <p><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. Share insights from customer-facing incidents to improve product documentation and operational readiness.</p> <p><strong>Product and platform depth.</strong> Maintain deep, current expertise across Cloudflare's product portfolio: edge networking, DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, Zero Trust, Workers, and our developer platform. Anticipate customer impact from new releases and architecture changes. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will interview the team to understand each workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation targets, and ship tooling that demonstrably reduces the time it takes to close a QAR cycle, produce an audit evidence package, or manage a batch of access provisioning requests. You will work in close partnership with the DCSC coordinators, and existing automation developers, and will own the DCSC operational tooling roadmap.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Portal Automation & User List Extraction</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Browser Automation: Design and maintain automated scripts (Playwright, Puppeteer, or equivalent) that log into vendor data center portals, extract user access lists, and feed structured output into the DCSC Portal and comparison pipelines replacing manual portal-by-portal data collection across 105+ portals covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> <li>Ticket Intelligence: Build automation that reads incoming Jira onboarding and offboarding tickets and generates structured, portal-specific action checklists reducing coordinator cognitive load and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ability to write maintainable, documented code that non-engineers can operate.</li> <li>LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent) into production workflows for classification, drafting, summarization, or anomaly detection tasks.</li> <li>Data Engineering Fundamentals: Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data at scale, diffing datasets, normalizing inconsistent formats, and producing clean outputs for downstream audit use.</li> <li>API & Workflow Integration: Experience building integrations with ticketing or ITSM systems (Jira preferred) via REST API, including automated ticket creation, status updates, and attachment handling.</li> <li>Systems Thinking: Ability to map an end-to-end manual workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation insertion points, and ship incrementally without waiting for a perfect solution.</li> <li>Workflow Archaeology: Comfortable extracting process knowledge from subject-matter experts through structured interviews turning tribal knowledge into documented, automatable workflows.</li> <li>Bias Toward Simplicity: Strong product intuition for the minimum viable automation that delivers real time savings, rather than over-engineering for edge cases.</li> <li>Compliance Awareness: Appreciation for the stakes of accuracy in a compliance context, understanding that an incorrect ACL diff or a missing evidence artifact has real audit consequences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communication: Able to explain automation design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including compliance coordinators and GRC partners.</li> <li>Ambiguity Tolerance: Vendor portals don't come with documentation. Workflows are passed down verbally. You need to be energized by figuring things out from scratch.</li> <li>Preferred Qualifications</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar edge compute platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) at an operational level — not as an auditor, but enough to understand why evidence integrity matters</li> <li>RPA tooling experience (UiPath, Power Automate) as fallback for portals that defeat headless browsers</li> <li>Prior work in infrastructure operations, data center, or physical security environments</li> <li>Experience building internal tooling or developer-facing portals (not just scripts)</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1

This person will help Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, and Developer GTM leadership identify the right customer opportunities, organize technical GTM work, and turn high-value customer engagement into repeatable programs and operating rhythms.</p> <p>The Developer GTM Strategy & Incubation function exists to evolve the way the Developer GTM team works, designing systems, processes, and GTM motions that accelerate consumption at Cloudflare. process improvements, turn technical activity into clear business narratives, and incubate new motions until they are measurable and ready for durable ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with our covering analysts and shareholders.</li> <li>Articulate the Cloudflare investment narrative — our connectivity cloud strategy, the Workers and Developer Platform story, and our long-term financial model — in a way that is both compelling and credible.</li> <li>Plan and execute the calendar of investor events: sell-side conferences, one-on-ones, on-site investor visits, and our annual Investor Day.</li> <li>Prepare the CEO, CFO, and other senior executives for every investor interaction with tailored briefing materials, talking points, and Q&A prep.</li> <li>Develop and maintain core IR collateral: investor presentation, fact sheets, IR website content, and board-of-directors investor update materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Investor Day and special projects</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-lead the planning and execution of our annual Investor Day — invite tracker and registration management, co-author all presentation content and prepared remarks across all presenters, own the supporting documentation, validation, day-of logistics, and post-event follow-through.</li> <li>Lead select strategic finance projects: peer benchmarking analyses, long-range financial modeling, competitive analyses, and ad-hoc executive-level financial analyses.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional partnership and analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a trusted partner to Finance, Accounting, Legal, Communications, FP&A, and the executive team — the person who knows where every number comes from and what it means.</li> <li>Monitor and synthesize analyst coverage, peer performance, investor sentiment, market dynamics, and industry trends; provide actionable insights to the CFO, CEO, and Board of Directors.</li> <li>Build and maintain the internal analytical infrastructure that powers the function — the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation systems that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Drive the IR function's use of AI-native tooling and automation, treating modern tools as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, accuracy, and stakeholder communications.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></h4> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a strategic thinker with deep financial acumen, exceptional written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and a genuine intellectual curiosity about both the business and the public markets. Comfort debating modeling assumptions and valuation mechanics.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills</strong> — including the ability to draft in the voice of senior executives, translate complex technical or financial concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences, and operate confidently in high-stakes external communications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced financial modeling skills </strong>— fluency in building, maintaining, and stress-testing operating models, share-count and dilution forecasts, guidance sensitivity analyses, and consensus benchmarks.</li> <li><strong>An ownership mindset</strong> — comfort owning a process end-to-end, driving operational structure in a fast-paced environment, and operating with the integrity and accuracy demanded by external disclosure.</li> <li><strong>High-trust collaboration</strong> — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, CEO, Board, Legal, Accounting, FP&A) and external stakeholders (sell-side analysts, institutional investors).</li> <li><strong>AI-native curiosity and skill </strong>— fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
