We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. Why a designer now We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market. That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind. Role and Responsibilities As our Senior Product Designer , you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster. You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set. Journeys and engagement Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit. Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky. Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data. Growth surfaces Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels. Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from. Craft and UI ownership You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence. During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent. Design system and enablement Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan. Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with. How you work You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision. You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision. You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign. On a typical week On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience. On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves. In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details. On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined. We offer A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution; Competitive, benchmarked compensation; The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work; Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals; Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team; A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company; A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam; 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice; Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year; Pension plan; 5 Mental health days per year; Access to OpenUp mental health platform; Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read; All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card); MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work; Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities; Free access to the office gym. Apply for the job Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer ? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate. P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. Who you are You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if: You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech. You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around you. You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas . You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion. You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence. You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard. You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same. You see feedback as a way to improve the work , hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so. You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
description: SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen. Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren. Wat je gaat doen Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten. Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen. Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag. Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert. Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit. Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan. 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen. Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage. De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt. Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives. Dit ben jij Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol. Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen. Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré. Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool. Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré. Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen. Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen. Waarom Follo? Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact. Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong. AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows. Sterke merken, echte vraagstukken: jouw analyses sturen de beslissingen van ambitieuze adverteerders. Werken aan internationale, award-waardige cases in een bureau met Europese ambities. title: Meeloopstage Cash Control/ Finance
description: Wil jij ontdekken hoe de financiële motor achter een internationale logistiek dienstverlener draait? Ben je nauwkeurig, analytisch en krijg je energie van cijfers die kloppen? Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. De ideale kandidaat Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy. Je bent nauwkeurig en analytisch ingesteld en werkt makkelijk met Excel en grotere datasets. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, in woord en geschrift. Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een stagevergoeding van € 650 per maand (bij fulltime). Een leerzame stage met veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid, verantwoordelijkheid en eigen initiatief. Werken vanuit ons Basecamp: een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een gym, restaurant en de DH Academy. Professionele begeleiding en de kans om echt iets bij te dragen. Een fijne werksfeer met de Rotterdamse mentaliteit. Enthousiast? Klinkt dit als jouw stage? Solliciteer dan direct via de knop op deze pagina. Wil je eerst meer weten? title: Senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen (m/v/x)
description: Ben jij een ervaren bèta-academische professional die klaar is voor een nieuwe uitdaging? Wil je bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van 's werelds meest innovatieve simulatie- en trainingssystemen binnen de militaire (en civiele) luchtvaartwereld? Wil jij je technische kennis en ervaring inzetten voor het initiëren en realiseren van complexe, multidisciplinaire projecten in een high-tech omgeving? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Wat ga je doen? Als senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen richt je je op het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten. Een belangrijk onderdeel van deze functie is het optreden als Subject Matter Expert (SME) in je vakgebied, waarbij je je kennis en expertise deelt met collega's, klanten adviseert en bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van projectteams, het adviseren van klanten en het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk. Je takenpakket omvat onder andere: Het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen, waaronder het genereren van ideeën voor nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en het realiseren van samenwerking met andere disciplines; Het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten, waaronder het uitwerken van projectplannen, het inventariseren en analyseren van projectrisico's en het adviseren van klanten over alternatieven; Het leiden van projectteams, waaronder het geven van leiding aan projectmedewerkers, het bewaken van de voortgang en resultaten van de projecten en het zorgen voor de kwaliteit van de uitvoering; Het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk, waaronder het initiëren en onderhouden van samenwerkingsverbanden, het creëren van mogelijkheden en het uitbrengen van proposals; Het adviseren van klanten, waaronder het opbouwen van een zodanige relatie met de klant dat de klant kan worden ondersteund bij een verscheidenheid aan vraagstukken en het geven van advies over alternatieven; Het bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van afdelingsbeleid, waaronder het realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het adviseren van afdelingsmanagement en businessmanager. Je werkt samen met collega's uit andere teams aan diverse soorten projecten die hoogwaardige technologische simulatie- en trainingsoplossingen leveren aan eindgebruikers in de luchtvaartoperatie. Je hebt frequent contact en interactieve werksessies met hen om tot grensverleggende totaaloplossingen te kunnen komen. Jouw enthousiasme en de wil om je te verdiepen in de operationele wereld van deze gebruikers is daarbij een must. Dat doe je niet enkel vanaf je bureau maar ook bij de operationele gebruikers op locatie, en regelmatig samen met industrie en kennispartners wereldwijd! Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in Informatica, Lucht- en Ruimtevaarttechniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbare studierichting; Ruime (>10 jaar) werkervaring in een technische of wetenschappelijke discipline, met een focus op simulatie, training of een verwant gebied, zoals luchtvaart, ruimtevaart, defensie of andere industrieën waarin complexe systemen en processen worden gesimuleerd. Sterke affiniteit en ervaring in het militaire domein is een pre; Affiniteit met innovatieve M&S technologie, zoals real-time simulatie technologie, AR/VR/MR, IoT, data- en softwarearchitecturen en netwerken; Interesse of ervaring in het verbinden van systemen en het waarborgen van interoperabiliteit, bijvoorbeeld door het werken met netwerkprotocollen of architecturen; Kennis van softwareontwikkeling (zowel de implementatie als procesmatig); Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal; Ervaring met projectmanagement, leidinggeven aan projectteams en het schrijven van proposals. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5400 en €7100 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) , afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring; 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken experts op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, opleiding en training, kunstmatige intelligentie, psychologie, en lucht- en ruimtevaart. Het team waarin je terecht komt is het team Trainingssystemen. We zijn expert op het gebied van de volledige life-cycle van simulatiemiddelen – van verwerving, tot ontwerp en ontwikkeling, tot VV&A en kwalificatie, tot uiteindelijke operatie – gedreven vanuit een diepgaande kennis van M&S-technologie en –gebruik in combinatie met operationele expertise en klantdomeinkennis. De afdeling beschikt over onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een Battle Lab en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons! Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? title: Business Development Manager
description: Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen. Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl? Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben. Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht. So gestaltest du Lösungen mit, die wirtschaftlich und operativ funktionieren. Wachstum vorantreiben: Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, verstehst ihre Herausforderungen und arbeitest mit dem Commercial-Team daran, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und bestehende Partnerschaften auszubauen. title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.</li> <li value="2">Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.</li> <li value="3">Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.</li> <li value="4">Collaborate with <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/product/">Product</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/">Development</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/">Infrastructure</a>, <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-success/">Customer Success</a>, and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/">Sales</a> teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.</li> <li value="5">Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them.</li> <li value="6">Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.</li> <li value="7">Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through <a class="textLink" href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w">pairing sessions</a> and <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/#support-stable-counterpart">stable counterpart</a> relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.</li> <li value="2">Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.</li> <li value="3">Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.</li> <li value="4">Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.</li> <li value="5">Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.</li> <li value="6">Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.</li> <li value="7">Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.</li> <li value="8">Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be part of our broader Support Engineering organization, working closely with other Support Engineers through regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack conversations to stay connected while collaborating asynchronously across time zones. We balance autonomy with accountability, giving you flexibility to structure your shift in a way that fits your life while ensuring we can reliably address customer issues. Thanks to GitLab’s <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/all-remote/values/#transparency">Transparency</a> value, you can see what we are working on in our<a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/"> Support Team</a> page. Additionally, you can see our <a class="textLink" href="https://about.gitlab.com/direction/">company roadmap</a> and <a class="textLink" href="https://www.youtube.com/@Gitlab">meetings</a> to see what we are working on at any time.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Intern Power Electronics Engineer
description: With over 140 years of Swiss engineering heritage, Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in high-power electrical and electronic equipment. Our solutions power railways, renewable energy, DC and AC networks, and industrial systems worldwide trusted for their precision, reliability, and innovation. At the heart of modern rail infrastructure, our Traction Power Systems unit delivers cutting-edge DC and AC traction substations, protection systems, power conversion and digital monitoring solutions. Join us to shape the future of sustainable mobility with technology that keeps cities and countries moving. As an intern within our Traction Power Systems R&D team, you will support the development and validation of power electronic converters and control solutions used in railway and industrial applications. You will work alongside experienced engineers on innovative projects involving power conversion, control algorithms, testing, and system analysis. The internship has the duration of 6 months and is expected to start in January 2027, but if that is not the best for you, let us know your availability. Key responsibilities Support the design and analysis of power electronic converters. Assist in the development and validation of control algorithms. Participate in laboratory testing, measurements, and troubleshooting activities. Analyze simulation and test results and prepare technical reports. Contribute to continuous improvement and innovation projects within the team. Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams. Requirements Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. Strong interest in power converters, control systems, and electrical energy conversion. Basic knowledge of power electronics and control theory. Familiarity with simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or similar is an advantage. Curious, autonomous, and eager to learn in a hands-on engineering environment. Good communication skills in English. Benefits A challenging internship in an international engineering environment. Exposure to real-world power electronics and railway technology projects. Mentorship from experienced R&D engineers. Opportunity to develop practical skills in power conversion and control systems. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Executive (Eastern Europe)
description: About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory (Eastern/Central Europe) focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities. title: Ingénieur MES (h/f)
description: Contexte Dans le cadre de projets de transformation digitale au sein d’un groupe international du secteur des sciences de la vie, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement pour accompagner l’évolution et le déploiement de solutions informatiques industrielles sur plusieurs sites en Europe. Vous interviendrez sur la qualification d’une solution MES (Manufacturing Execution System), destinée à soutenir et à optimiser les processus de production, tout en garantissant sa conformité aux exigences qualité et réglementaires du secteur. Votre rôle et missions Votre rôle En tant qu’Ingénieur(e) MES – Qualification & Déploiement, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la qualification du système et l’accompagnement de son déploiement sur différents sites européens. Vous veillerez à la fiabilité, à la conformité et à la bonne intégration de la solution dans les environnements industriels concernés. À l’interface entre les équipes IT, les équipes de production, les interlocuteurs qualité et les équipes projet, vous contribuerez à sécuriser les différentes étapes du cycle de vie de la solution, de la préparation des activités de qualification jusqu’à sa mise en service opérationnelle. 🎯 Missions 🔹 Qualification & validation du système MES * Participer à la définition et à l’exécution de la stratégie de qualification et de validation du logiciel MES. * Rédiger, revoir et exécuter les protocoles de tests et la documentation de validation. * Préparer et réaliser les tests fonctionnels, les tests d’intégration et les tests de non-régression. * Identifier, documenter et suivre les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution. 🔹 Déploiement international * Participer au déploiement de la solution MES sur plusieurs sites en Europe. * Accompagner les équipes locales dans la préparation, l’exécution et la validation des activités de déploiement. * Contribuer à l’adaptation de la solution aux spécificités opérationnelles des différents sites, dans le respect des standards définis. 🔹 Documentation & conformité * Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique et qualité liée aux activités de qualification. * Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de qualification et de déploiement. 🔹 Collaboration & support * Collaborer avec les équipes IT, qualité, production et métiers afin de garantir une compréhension commune des besoins. Votre profil : Formation supérieure en informatique, systèmes industriels, automatisation, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent. Expérience en qualification logicielle, validation des systèmes informatisés ou validation de solutions MES. Bonne compréhension des environnements industriels réglementés, idéalement dans les secteurs pharmaceutique, biotechnologique ou des sciences de la vie. Connaissance des méthodologies de validation et des bonnes pratiques documentaires. Expérience dans la rédaction et l’exécution de protocoles de tests, ainsi que dans la gestion des anomalies. Une expérience dans le déploiement de solutions sur plusieurs sites constitue un atout important. Capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs techniques, qualité et métiers dans un environnement international. Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, indispensable pour évoluer dans un contexte international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements ponctuels sur les différents sites européens, selon les besoins du projet. 🏆 Conditions du poste * 📍 Localisation : Suisse romande * 🕒 Taux d’occupation : 100 % * 💼 Type de contrat : Mission de consulting * 📅 Démarrage : Flexible / Janvier 2027 * 🌍 Environnement : International et multisite * ✈️ Déplacements : Possibles en Europe selon les besoins du projet Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)
description: Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Op de Global Marketingafdeling houden we ons o.a. bezig met Brand Management, Product Management, Social Media en Influencer Marketing. Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE. Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen. We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt. YOU Je volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau; Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels; Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn; Gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief; Bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen; Bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt). OUR OFFER Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie; Een B Corp gecertificeerde werkgever; Een inspirerende werkomgeving; Collega’s die investeren in jouw talent; De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen; De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers; Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback; Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand; Personeelskorting op de volledige KEUNE-collectie. KEUNE We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vandaag, 104 jaar later en een koninklijk predicaat rijker, hoort KEUNE bij één van de hardst groeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Ieder jaar openen we een nieuwe eigen vestiging. We produceren op een duurzame en diervriendelijke manier en zijn B Corp-gecertificeerd. Maar bij KEUNE gaat het niet alleen om het creëren van mooie producten - het gaat om ons verhaal en onze visie. KEUNE staat onder leiding van Philip Berlijn, die zich richt op het bouwen van een sterk merk en het creëren van een bedrijfscultuur die draait om samenwerken, duurzaamheid en het tonen van karakter. title: Commercial Account Executive, UK
description: Get to Know Us Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organisations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organisations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. Role Description Help shape the next stage of Horizon3.ai’s UK growth. Based in the Netherlands with regular UK travel, you’ll bring autonomous pentesting to new customers and help them reduce real-world security risk. If you thrive on opening doors, building partnerships and turning opportunities into wins, this is a chance to make a visible impact as we expand our UK Commercial team. We currently require our Amsterdam team to come to the office 2 - 3 days per week. What You’ll Do Grow Horizon3.ai’s UK Commercial business by winning new customers, developing productive channel partnerships and helping organisations realise value from our cybersecurity solutions. Win new accounts and expand our customer base by introducing disruptive cybersecurity software solutions to the UK market. Build and convert a qualified pipeline, owning the sales cycle from qualification and proof of value through negotiation and close, with the goal of exceeding quota consistently quarter over quarter. Turn channel partnerships into revenue by proactively engaging regional resellers and developing joint opportunities. Demonstrate Horizon3.ai solutions in virtual and in-person meetings, connecting technical capabilities to customer needs and business outcomes. Drive the post-proof of value ROI process, helping customers understand business value while building relationships that support satisfaction and retention. Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline data and forecasts in Salesforce so opportunities, risks and next steps are clearly understood. Work independently to progress opportunities while collaborating with distributed sales, support and customer success teams to deliver a coordinated customer experience. What You’ll Bring At least 5 years of successful cybersecurity sales experience, with a track record of driving growth, introducing disruptive software solutions and consistently exceeding quarterly quotas. Previous experience selling technical solutions into the UK market. Experience establishing and monetising channel partnerships; existing relationships with key regional resellers are essential. Proficiency across the full sales process, including qualification, proof of value, forecasting, negotiation, deal closure and post-proof of value ROI management. The ability to present and demonstrate cybersecurity solutions effectively, both virtually and in person. Strong CRM discipline and experience maintaining accurate pipeline records and forecasts in Salesforce (SFDC). Familiarity with Challenger Question-Based Selling-type methodologies and sales tools such as Outreach , LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo and Slack. The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. Fluency in English; additional language skills are welcomed. Travel Required We are a hybrid company, and this job will require you to spend 3 days based at our Amsterdam city centre sales hub. The role may require up to 40% of travel within the assigned territory to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager. Perks of Horizon3.ai Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Remote Work: We are a 100% remote company. Enjoy the flexibility to work in the way that supports you and brings out your best. Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave. You Belong Here Horizon3.ai is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3.ai , every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3.ai , where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. title: Data Scientist Marketing
description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right. That’s where you come in. As our Data Scientist, Marketing , you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it: Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days. Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher. Keep the models running in production and monitor data and model health to find where to intervene, using Claude Code to move faster and validating everything it produces. You’ve built predictive models with traditional machine learning, such as XGBoost. You’ve written Python and built the data pipelines a model needs, including when none existed. You’ve shipped ML models to production and kept them running. You’ve done deep dives into data and model health to find what needs intervention. You use AI tools like Claude Code in your daily work and know where they stop. You are fluent in English. Curious to see how we make life easy? - try the bunq app , it only takes 5 minutes to sign up. Your space to perform We give you the space and the tools you need to succeed 💪 🤟 Great, international colleagues who share your mindset 👩‍💻 Hybrid setup: after 3 months in-office, work 2 days remote, 3 days in-office weekly. 🧳 Digital Nomad Program: After your first year, enjoy up to 20 days per year to work while traveling, combining flexibility with strong team collaboration 🚀 We reward tenure with a dedicated travel budget: €1.5k after 2 years and €3k after 4 years to visit another core office. 📚 We support growth with bunq Academy and €1500 annual learning budget 🧘 €60 monthly allowance via Alleo by Epassi, rolling over monthly and resetting annually 🚌 Travel expenses are covered whether you come walking or by bike, bus or car (though we prefer green choices 🌳) 💻 A MacBook so you can Get Shit Done with us 🥦 Delicious lunches from our fabulous in-house chefs with vegan and vegetarian options 💰 An optional pension plan with monthly contribution from bunq 💸 Monthly contribution to your phone and internet bills 🍻 Friday drinks and other celebrations - bunq style All new hires are subject to Pre-employment Screening (PES), which includes checks conducted by our third-party partner, Zinc. This is part of our commitment to a secure and trustworthy workplace Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoeren en klanten nog beter kan ondersteunen met duidelijke inspectierapportages en onderhoudsadviezen. Wij vragen HBO studie in de richting van Technische bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen; Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Over Voortman Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer, Environment Automation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you’ll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.</p> <p>In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. </p> <p>Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.</p> <p>Some examples of the projects you could work on:</p> <ul> <li>Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes</li> <li>Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab</li> <li>Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)</li> <li>Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants</li> <li>Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale</li> <li>Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response</li> <li>Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)</li> <li>Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure:</strong> Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Debug & Resolve Production Issues: </strong>Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.</li> <li><strong>Automate Operations at Scale: </strong>Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.</li> <li><strong>Monitor & Predict Capacity: </strong>Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.</li> <li><strong>Respond & Lead During Incidents: </strong>Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.</li> <li><strong>Architect & Collaborate: </strong>Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Production-Scale Experience: </strong>Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.<br><strong>Terraform & IaC Mastery:</strong> Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.<br><strong>Kubernetes in Production: </strong>Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.<br><strong>Programming & Code Analysis: </strong>Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.<br><strong>Large Scale Operations Background: </strong>Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. Desired Experience You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately Exa is an equal opportunity employer. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them. title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan. Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out. Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions. Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found. What we're looking for You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system. Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats. Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance. Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++). You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production. You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale. Bonus Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers Example projects Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely. Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency. Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well. Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result. Logistics Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich. Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p><strong>This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands. </strong></p> <p>Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.</p> <p>As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products</li> <li>Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences</li> <li>Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads</li> <li>Establish and manage to SLAs within your team</li> <li>Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team</li> <li>Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future.
